            f"κ {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · векторы P_gen {counts['P_gen']} / P_sim {counts['P_sim']}"
            f" / P_hw {counts['P_hw']}"
        )
        self._fill_projection_table(self._projection)
        report = self._report_text(section)
        self._report.setPlainText(report)
        self._status_label.setText(report)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("" if self._projection.ready else _ERROR_STYLE)

    def _fill_projection_table(self, projection: ProjectionResult) -> None:
        rows = [
            entry
            for target in ("P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw")
            for entry in projection.vectors.get(target, [])
        ]
        self._projection_table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, entry in enumerate(rows):
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 0, _plain(entry.parameter_id))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 1, _plain(entry.klass))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 2, _plain(entry.target))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 3, _plain(", ".join(entry.keys) or _EMPTY))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 4, _plain(str(entry.value)))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 5, _plain(entry.unit or _EMPTY))
        self._projection_table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._projection_table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _report_text(self, section: ProfileSection, *, applied: bool = False) -> str:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        lines = [
            f"заказчик: {section.customer or _EMPTY}",
            f"NDA: {'да' if section.nda else 'нет'}",
            f"параметров: {metrics.total}, без класса: {metrics.unmarked}",
            f"κ = {metrics.kappa_text}, κ+ = {metrics.kappa_plus_text}",
        ]
        if self._unknown:
            lines.append(f"неизвестных полей сохранено: {len(self._unknown)}")
            lines.extend(f"  {item.path}.{item.name}" for item in self._unknown)
        if self._projection.uncovered:
            lines.append(f"не покрыто векторами: {len(self._projection.uncovered)}")
        for item in self._projection.issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        for item in self._issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        if not self._projection.ready:
            lines.append("проекция заблокирована: разметьте классы и векторы")
        elif applied:
            lines.append("профиль записан в проект")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _set_error(self, message: str, *, blocking: bool = True) -> None:
        if blocking:
            self._apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._status_label.setText(message)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)

    # --- файлы ----------------------------------------------------------

    def import_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Читает профиль из файла и применяет его к проекту."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            chosen = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self,
                "Импорт профиля",
                str(self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            self._set_error(f"не удалось прочитать {target}: {exc}")
            return False

        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._suppress = True
        self._editor.setPlainText(text)
        self._suppress = False
        self._dirty = True
        if not self.check_text():
            return False
        if not self.apply_text():
            return False
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(
            f"импортировано: {target.name}; неизвестных полей {len(self._unknown)}"
        )
        return True

    def export_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Пишет профиль с версией и хэшем, соблюдая изоляцию NDA."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / "profile.json"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт профиля",
                str(suggested),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            payload = export_profile_payload(self.section, destination=target)
        except NdaViolation as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт запрещён", str(exc))
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)
            return False
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(dump_profile_export(payload), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспортировано: {target} · {payload['hash']}")
        return True


def _combo(options: tuple[str | None, ...], value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
    combo = QComboBox()
    for option in options:
        combo.addItem(option or _EMPTY, option)
    index = combo.findData(value)
    combo.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
    return combo


def _plain(text: str) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
    return item


def _cell(text: str, parameter: ProfileParameter) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = _plain(text)
    if parameter.klass is None:
        item.setBackground(_UNMARKED_COLOR)
        item.setToolTip("класс не указан: проекция заблокирована")
    return item


def _value_text(parameter: ProfileParameter) -> str:
    if parameter.range is not None:
        return f"{parameter.range[0]}…{parameter.range[1]}"
    return str(parameter.value)


def _describe_issues(issues: list[Issue]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"{item.path}: {item.message}" for item in issues)


def _section_text(section: ProfileSection) -> str:
    """Читаемый JSON раздела для редактора."""
    payload = section.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"

{"contents": """"Вкладка профиля заказчика: JSON, таблица параметров и проекция (T3-02…T3-05).

Правка JSON применяется к документу целиком: раздел проходит ту же проверку

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,

    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from simorph.core.errors import ProjectError, ProjectValidationError
from simorph.core.issues import Issue
from simorph.core.models.profile import ProfileParameter, ProfileSection
from simorph.core.profile import (
    BLOCK_TITLES,
    NdaViolation,
    ProjectionResult,
    UnknownField,
    completeness,
    export_profile_payload,
    import_profile_payload,
    parse_profile_json,
    project_profile,
)
from simorph.core.profile.exporting import dump_profile_export
from simorph.settings import ApplicationSettings
from simorph.ui.commands import DocumentStore
from simorph.ui.json_editor import JsonEditor

__all__ = ["ProfileEditor"]

#: Задержка проверки JSON после правки, мс.
CHECK_DELAY_MS = 300

#: Подписи колонок таблицы параметров.
_PARAMETER_COLUMNS = ("№", "Блок", "Класс", "Вектор", "Ключи проекции", "Значение", "Ед.")

#: Подписи колонок таблицы проекции.
_PROJECTION_COLUMNS = ("Параметр", "Класс", "Вектор", "Ключи", "Значение", "Ед.")

#: Пустой вариант в выпадающих списках класса и вектора.
_EMPTY = "—"

#: Фон параметра без класса.
_UNMARKED_COLOR = QColor("#7a3a37")
_UNMARKED_COLOR.setAlpha(90)

#: Цвет текста ошибки.
_ERROR_STYLE = "color: #e5534b;"


class ProfileEditor(QWidget):
    """Редактор раздела ``profile``."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: DocumentStore,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._store = store
        self._settings = settings
        self._suppress = False
        self._dirty = False
        self._unknown: list[UnknownField] = []
        self._issues: list[Issue] = []
        self._projection = ProjectionResult()
        self.setObjectName("editor_profile")

        self._editor = JsonEditor()
        self._editor.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)

        self._table = QTableWidget(0, len(_PARAMETER_COLUMNS))
        self._table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(list(_PARAMETER_COLUMNS))
        self._table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self._table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)

        self._projection_table = QTableWidget(0, len(_PROJECTION_COLUMNS))
        self._projection_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(list(_PROJECTION_COLUMNS))
        self._projection_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._projection_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)

        self._report = QPlainTextEdit()
        self._report.setReadOnly(True)
        self._report.setLineWrapMode(QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.WidgetWidth)

        right = QTabWidget()
        right.addTab(self._table, "Параметры")
        right.addTab(self._projection_table, "Проекция")
        right.addTab(self._report, "Отчёт")

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(self._editor)
        splitter.addWidget(right)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 3)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 2)

        self._kappa_label = QLabel("")
        self._kappa_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._status_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._kappa_label)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)

        self._check_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._check_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._check_timer.setInterval(CHECK_DELAY_MS)
        self._check_timer.timeout.connect(self.check_text)

        self._store.add_listener(self._on_document_changed)
        self.destroyed.connect(self._on_destroyed)
        self.refresh()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._apply_button = QPushButton("Применить JSON")
        self._apply_button.setToolTip("Проверить JSON и записать профиль в проект")
        self._apply_button.clicked.connect(self.apply_text)

        import_button = QPushButton("Импорт…")
        import_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.import_file())
        export_button = QPushButton("Экспорт…")
        export_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.export_file())

        fold_button = QPushButton("Свернуть блоки")
        fold_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._editor.fold_all())
        unfold_button = QPushButton("Развернуть")
        unfold_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._editor.unfold_all())

        self._nda_badge = QLabel("NDA")
        self._nda_badge.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #ffffff; background-color: #8b3a3a; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 3px;"
        )
        self._nda_badge.setVisible(False)

        for widget in (
            self._apply_button,
            import_button,
            export_button,
            fold_button,
            unfold_button,
            self._nda_badge,
        ):
            row.addWidget(widget)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def section(self) -> ProfileSection:
        return self._store.document.profile

    @property
    def editor(self) -> JsonEditor:
        return self._editor

    @property
    def table(self) -> QTableWidget:
        return self._table

    @property
    def projection_table(self) -> QTableWidget:
        return self._projection_table

    @property
    def projection(self) -> ProjectionResult:
        return self._projection

    @property
    def unknown_fields(self) -> list[UnknownField]:
        return list(self._unknown)

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    def _on_document_changed(self, _document: object) -> None:
        self.refresh()

    def _on_destroyed(self) -> None:
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Отписывается от документа: вкладка закрыта."""
        self._check_timer.stop()
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Перестраивает таблицы и, если JSON не правился, текст редактора."""
        if not self._dirty:
            self._suppress = True
            self._editor.setPlainText(_section_text(self.section))
            self._suppress = False
        self._nda_badge.setVisible(self.section.nda)
        self._rebuild_table()
        self.check_text()

    # --- JSON -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:
        if self._suppress:
            return
        self._dirty = True
        self._check_timer.start()

    def check_text(self) -> bool:
        """Проверяет текст без записи в документ; ``False`` при ошибке."""
        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)
        except ProjectValidationError as exc:
            self._editor.clear_error()
            self._set_error(_describe_issues(exc.issues))
            return False
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._editor.clear_error()
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._apply_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._update_preview(imported.section)
        return True

    def apply_text(self) -> bool:
        """Записывает профиль из JSON в документ одной командой undo."""
        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False
        try:
            self._store.set_value("profile", imported.section.model_dump(mode="python"))
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._dirty = False
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(self._report_text(self.section, applied=True))
        return True

    # --- таблица параметров ---------------------------------------------

    def _rebuild_table(self) -> None:
        parameters = self.section.parameters
        self._table.blockSignals(True)
        self._table.setRowCount(len(parameters))
        for row, parameter in enumerate(parameters):
            self._table.setItem(row, 0, _cell(parameter.id, parameter))
            block = parameter.block
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 1, _cell(BLOCK_TITLES.get(block or "", block or _EMPTY), parameter)
            )
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 2, self._class_combo(row, parameter.klass))
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 3, self._target_combo(row, parameter.target))
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 4, _cell(", ".join(parameter.projection) or _EMPTY, parameter)
            )
            self._table.setItem(row, 5, _cell(_value_text(parameter), parameter))
            self._table.setItem(row, 6, _cell(parameter.unit or _EMPTY, parameter))
        self._table.blockSignals(False)
        self._table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _class_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "C", "E", "M", "N"), value)
        if value is None:
            combo.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {_UNMARKED_COLOR.name()};")
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "class", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _target_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw"), value)
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "target", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _set_parameter_value(self, row: int, field: str, value: Any) -> None:
        try:
            self._store.set_value(f"profile.parameters.{row}.{field}", value)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._rebuild_table()
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)

    # --- предпросмотр ---------------------------------------------------

    def _update_preview(self, section: ProfileSection) -> None:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        self._projection = project_profile(section)
        counts = self._projection.counts()
        self._kappa_label.setText(
            f"κ {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · векторы P_gen {counts['P_gen']} / P_sim {counts['P_sim']}"
            f" / P_hw {counts['P_hw']}"
        )
        self._fill_projection_table(self._projection)
        report = self._report_text(section)
        self._report.setPlainText(report)
        self._status_label.setText(report)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("" if self._projection.ready else _ERROR_STYLE)

    def _fill_projection_table(self, projection: ProjectionResult) -> None:
        rows = [
            entry
            for target in ("P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw")
            for entry in projection.vectors.get(target, [])
        ]
        self._projection_table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, entry in enumerate(rows):
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 0, _plain(entry.parameter_id))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 1, _plain(entry.klass))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 2, _plain(entry.target))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 3, _plain(", ".join(entry.keys) or _EMPTY))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 4, _plain(str(entry.value)))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 5, _plain(entry.unit or _EMPTY))
        self._projection_table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._projection_table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _report_text(self, section: ProfileSection, *, applied: bool = False) -> str:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        lines = [
            f"заказчик: {section.customer or _EMPTY}",
            f"NDA: {'да' if section.nda else 'нет'}",
            f"параметров: {metrics.total}, без класса: {metrics.unmarked}",
            f"κ = {metrics.kappa_text}, κ+ = {metrics.kappa_plus_text}",
        ]
        if self._unknown:
            lines.append(f"неизвестных полей сохранено: {len(self._unknown)}")
            lines.extend(f"  {item.path}.{item.name}" for item in self._unknown)
        if self._projection.uncovered:
            lines.append(f"не покрыто векторами: {len(self._projection.uncovered)}")
        for item in self._projection.issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        for item in self._issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        if not self._projection.ready:
            lines.append("проекция заблокирована: разметьте классы и векторы")
        elif applied:
            lines.append("профиль записан в проект")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _set_error(self, message: str, *, blocking: bool = True) -> None:
        if blocking:
            self._apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._status_label.setText(message)

class ProfileEditor(QWidget):

            self._apply_button,

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def section(self) -> ProfileSection:

    def table(self) -> QTableWidget:

    def projection_table(self) -> QTableWidget:

    @property
    def projection(self) -> ProjectionResult:
        return self._projection

    @property
    def unknown_fields(self) -> list[UnknownField]:
        return list(self._unknown)

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    def _on_document_changed(self, _document: object) -> None:
        self.refresh()

    def _on_destroyed(self) -> None:
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Отписывается от документа: вкладка закрыта."""
        self._check_timer.stop()
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Перестраивает таблицы и, если JSON не правился, текст редактора."""
        if not self._dirty:
            self._suppress = True
            self._editor.setPlainText(_section_text(self.section))
            self._suppress = False
        self._nda_badge.setVisible(self.section.nda)
        self._rebuild_table()
        self.check_text()

    # --- JSON -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:
        if self._suppress:
            return
        self._dirty = True
        self._check_timer.start()

    def check_text(self) -> bool:
        """Проверяет текст без записи в документ; ``False`` при ошибке."""
        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)
        except ProjectValidationError as exc:
            self._editor.clear_error()
            self._set_error(_describe_issues(exc.issues))
            return False
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._editor.clear_error()
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._apply_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._update_preview(imported.section)
        return True

    def apply_text(self) -> bool:
        """Записывает профиль из JSON в документ одной командой undo."""
        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False
        try:
            self._store.set_value("profile", imported.section.model_dump(mode="python"))
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._dirty = False
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(self._report_text(self.section, applied=True))
        return True

    # --- таблица параметров ---------------------------------------------

    def _rebuild_table(self) -> None:
        parameters = self.section.parameters
        self._table.blockSignals(True)
        self._table.setRowCount(len(parameters))
        for row, parameter in enumerate(parameters):
            self._table.setItem(row, 0, _cell(parameter.id, parameter))
            block = parameter.block
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 1, _cell(BLOCK_TITLES.get(block or "", block or _EMPTY), parameter)
            )
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 2, self._class_combo(row, parameter.klass))
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 3, self._target_combo(row, parameter.target))
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 4, _cell(", ".join(parameter.projection) or _EMPTY, parameter)
            )
            self._table.setItem(row, 5, _cell(_value_text(parameter), parameter))
            self._table.setItem(row, 6, _cell(parameter.unit or _EMPTY, parameter))
        self._table.blockSignals(False)
        self._table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _class_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "C", "E", "M", "N"), value)
        if value is None:
            combo.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {_UNMARKED_COLOR.name()};")
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "class", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _target_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw"), value)
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "target", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _set_parameter_value(self, row: int, field: str, value: Any) -> None:
        try:
            self._store.set_value(f"profile.parameters.{row}.{field}", value)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._rebuild_table()
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)

    # --- предпросмотр ---------------------------------------------------

    def _update_preview(self, section: ProfileSection) -> None:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        self._projection = project_profile(section)
        counts = self._projection.counts()
        self._kappa_label.setText(
            f"κ {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · векторы P_gen {counts['P_gen']} / P_sim {counts['P_sim']}"
            f" / P_hw {counts['P_hw']}"
        )
        self._fill_projection_table(self._projection)
        report = self._report_text(section)
        self._report.setPlainText(report)
        self._status_label.setText(report)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("" if self._projection.ready else _ERROR_STYLE)

    def _fill_projection_table(self, projection: ProjectionResult) -> None:
        rows = [
            entry
            for target in ("P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw")
            for entry in projection.vectors.get(target, [])
        ]
        self._projection_table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, entry in enumerate(rows):
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 0, _plain(entry.parameter_id))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 1, _plain(entry.klass))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 2, _plain(entry.target))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 3, _plain(", ".join(entry.keys) or _EMPTY))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 4, _plain(str(entry.value)))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 5, _plain(entry.unit or _EMPTY))
        self._projection_table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._projection_table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _report_text(self, section: ProfileSection, *, applied: bool = False) -> str:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        lines = [
            f"заказчик: {section.customer or _EMPTY}",
            f"NDA: {'да' if section.nda else 'нет'}",
            f"параметров: {metrics.total}, без класса: {metrics.unmarked}",
            f"κ = {metrics.kappa_text}, κ+ = {metrics.kappa_plus_text}",
        ]
        if self._unknown:
            lines.append(f"неизвестных полей сохранено: {len(self._unknown)}")
            lines.extend(f"  {item.path}.{item.name}" for item in self._unknown)
        if self._projection.uncovered:
            lines.append(f"не покрыто векторами: {len(self._projection.uncovered)}")
        for item in self._projection.issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        for item in self._issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        if not self._projection.ready:
            lines.append("проекция заблокирована: разметьте классы и векторы")
        elif applied:
            lines.append("профиль записан в проект")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _set_error(self, message: str, *, blocking: bool = True) -> None:
        if blocking:
            self._apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._status_label.setText(message)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)

    # --- файлы ----------------------------------------------------------

    def import_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Читает профиль из файла и применяет его к проекту."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            chosen = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self,
                "Импорт профиля",
                str(self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            self._set_error(f"не удалось прочитать {target}: {exc}")
            return False

        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._suppress = True
        self._editor.setPlainText(text)
        self._suppress = False
        self._dirty = True
        if not self.check_text():
            return False
        if not self.apply_text():
            return False
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(
            f"импортировано: {target.name}; неизвестных полей {len(self._unknown)}"
        )
        return True

    def export_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Пишет профиль с версией и хэшем, соблюдая изоляцию NDA."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / "profile.json"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт профиля",
                str(suggested),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            payload = export_profile_payload(self.section, destination=target)
        except NdaViolation as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт запрещён", str(exc))
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)
            return False
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(dump_profile_export(payload), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспортировано: {target} · {payload['hash']}")
        return True


def _combo(options: tuple[str | None, ...], value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
    combo = QComboBox()
    for option in options:
        combo.addItem(option or _EMPTY, option)
    index = combo.findData(value)
    combo.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
    return combo


def _plain(text: str) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
    return item


def _cell(text: str, parameter: ProfileParameter) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = _plain(text)
    if parameter.klass is None:
        item.setBackground(_UNMARKED_COLOR)
        item.setToolTip("класс не указан: проекция заблокирована")
    return item


def _value_text(parameter: ProfileParameter) -> str:
    if parameter.range is not None:
        return f"{parameter.range[0]}…{parameter.range[1]}"
    return str(parameter.value)


def _describe_issues(issues: list[Issue]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"{item.path}: {item.message}" for item in issues)


def _section_text(section: ProfileSection) -> str:
    """Читаемый JSON раздела для редактора."""
    payload = section.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"

        fold_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._editor.fold_all())
        unfold_button = QPushButton("Развернуть")
        unfold_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._editor.unfold_all())

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def section(self) -> ProfileSection:

    @property
    def editor(self) -> JsonEditor:

    def table(self) -> QTableWidget:

    def projection_table(self) -> QTableWidget:

    def projection(self) -> ProjectionResult:

    def unknown_fields(self) -> list[UnknownField]:

    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    def _on_document_changed(self, _document: object) -> None:
        self.refresh()

    def _on_destroyed(self) -> None:
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Отписывается от документа: вкладка закрыта."""
        self._check_timer.stop()
        self._store.remove_listener(self._on_document_changed)

    def refresh(self) -> None:

        if not self._dirty:
            self._suppress = True
            self._editor.setPlainText(_section_text(self.section))

        self.check_text()

    def _on_text_changed(self) -> None:

    def check_text(self) -> bool:

        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)

            self._editor.clear_error()
            self._set_error(_describe_issues(exc.issues))
            return False
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._editor.clear_error()
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._apply_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._update_preview(imported.section)
        return True

    def apply_text(self) -> bool:
        """Записывает профиль из JSON в документ одной командой undo."""
        try:
            payload = parse_profile_json(self._editor.toPlainText())
            imported = import_profile_payload(payload)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            line = getattr(exc, "line", None)
            if line is not None:
                self._editor.highlight_error(line, getattr(exc, "column", 1))
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False
        try:
            self._store.set_value("profile", imported.section.model_dump(mode="python"))
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._set_error(str(exc))
            return False

        self._dirty = False
        self._unknown = list(imported.unknown)
        self._issues = list(imported.issues)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(self._report_text(self.section, applied=True))
        return True

    # --- таблица параметров ---------------------------------------------

    def _rebuild_table(self) -> None:
        parameters = self.section.parameters
        self._table.blockSignals(True)
        self._table.setRowCount(len(parameters))
        for row, parameter in enumerate(parameters):
            self._table.setItem(row, 0, _cell(parameter.id, parameter))
            block = parameter.block
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 1, _cell(BLOCK_TITLES.get(block or "", block or _EMPTY), parameter)
            )
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 2, self._class_combo(row, parameter.klass))
            self._table.setCellWidget(row, 3, self._target_combo(row, parameter.target))
            self._table.setItem(
                row, 4, _cell(", ".join(parameter.projection) or _EMPTY, parameter)
            )
            self._table.setItem(row, 5, _cell(_value_text(parameter), parameter))
            self._table.setItem(row, 6, _cell(parameter.unit or _EMPTY, parameter))
        self._table.blockSignals(False)
        self._table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _class_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "C", "E", "M", "N"), value)
        if value is None:
            combo.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {_UNMARKED_COLOR.name()};")
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "class", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _target_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw"), value)
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "target", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _set_parameter_value(self, row: int, field: str, value: Any) -> None:
        try:
            self._store.set_value(f"profile.parameters.{row}.{field}", value)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._rebuild_table()
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)

    # --- предпросмотр ---------------------------------------------------

    def _update_preview(self, section: ProfileSection) -> None:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        self._projection = project_profile(section)
        counts = self._projection.counts()
        self._kappa_label.setText(
            f"κ {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · векторы P_gen {counts['P_gen']} / P_sim {counts['P_sim']}"
            f" / P_hw {counts['P_hw']}"
        )
        self._fill_projection_table(self._projection)
        report = self._report_text(section)
        self._report.setPlainText(report)
        self._status_label.setText(report)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("" if self._projection.ready else _ERROR_STYLE)

    def _fill_projection_table(self, projection: ProjectionResult) -> None:
        rows = [
            entry
            for target in ("P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw")
            for entry in projection.vectors.get(target, [])
        ]
        self._projection_table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, entry in enumerate(rows):
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 0, _plain(entry.parameter_id))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 1, _plain(entry.klass))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 2, _plain(entry.target))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 3, _plain(", ".join(entry.keys) or _EMPTY))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 4, _plain(str(entry.value)))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 5, _plain(entry.unit or _EMPTY))
        self._projection_table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._projection_table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _report_text(self, section: ProfileSection, *, applied: bool = False) -> str:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        lines = [
            f"заказчик: {section.customer or _EMPTY}",
            f"NDA: {'да' if section.nda else 'нет'}",
            f"параметров: {metrics.total}, без класса: {metrics.unmarked}",
            f"κ = {metrics.kappa_text}, κ+ = {metrics.kappa_plus_text}",
        ]
        if self._unknown:
            lines.append(f"неизвестных полей сохранено: {len(self._unknown)}")
            lines.extend(f"  {item.path}.{item.name}" for item in self._unknown)
        if self._projection.uncovered:
            lines.append(f"не покрыто векторами: {len(self._projection.uncovered)}")
        for item in self._projection.issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        for item in self._issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        if not self._projection.ready:
            lines.append("проекция заблокирована: разметьте классы и векторы")
        elif applied:
            lines.append("профиль записан в проект")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _set_error(self, message: str, *, blocking: bool = True) -> None:
        if blocking:
            self._apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._status_label.setText(message)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)

    # --- файлы ----------------------------------------------------------

    def import_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Читает профиль из файла и применяет его к проекту."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            chosen = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self,
                "Импорт профиля",
                str(self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            self._set_error(f"не удалось прочитать {target}: {exc}")
            return False

        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._suppress = True
        self._editor.setPlainText(text)
        self._suppress = False
        self._dirty = True
        if not self.check_text():
            return False
        if not self.apply_text():
            return False
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(
            f"импортировано: {target.name}; неизвестных полей {len(self._unknown)}"
        )
        return True

    def export_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Пишет профиль с версией и хэшем, соблюдая изоляцию NDA."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / "profile.json"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт профиля",
                str(suggested),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            payload = export_profile_payload(self.section, destination=target)
        except NdaViolation as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт запрещён", str(exc))
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)
            return False
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(dump_profile_export(payload), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспортировано: {target} · {payload['hash']}")
        return True


def _combo(options: tuple[str | None, ...], value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
    combo = QComboBox()
    for option in options:
        combo.addItem(option or _EMPTY, option)
    index = combo.findData(value)
    combo.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
    return combo


def _plain(text: str) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
    return item


def _cell(text: str, parameter: ProfileParameter) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = _plain(text)
    if parameter.klass is None:
        item.setBackground(_UNMARKED_COLOR)
        item.setToolTip("класс не указан: проекция заблокирована")
    return item


def _value_text(parameter: ProfileParameter) -> str:
    if parameter.range is not None:
        return f"{parameter.range[0]}…{parameter.range[1]}"
    return str(parameter.value)


def _describe_issues(issues: list[Issue]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"{item.path}: {item.message}" for item in issues)


def _section_text(section: ProfileSection) -> str:
    """Читаемый JSON раздела для редактора."""
    payload = section.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"

"""Вкладка профиля заказчика: JSON, таблица параметров и проекция (T3-02…T3-05).

Вкладка показывает раздел ``profile`` в трёх видах:

- JSON профиля с подсветкой, сворачиванием блоков и переходом к ошибке;
- таблицу параметров: класс и целевой вектор правятся прямо в ней и сразу
  попадают в документ (одна команда undo на правку);
- проекцию в ``P_gen``/``P_sim``/``P_hw`` и показатели κ/κ+.

Правка JSON применяется к документу целиком: раздел проходит ту же проверку
схемой, что и при открытии проекта, поэтому невалидный JSON не может попасть
в файл (G3-02). Неизвестные поля при импорте не теряются — они уходят в
``extra`` и возвращаются при экспорте (T3-01).
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

            )
            self._table.setItem(row, 5, _cell(_value_text(parameter), parameter))
            self._table.setItem(row, 6, _cell(parameter.unit or _EMPTY, parameter))
        self._table.blockSignals(False)
        self._table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            4, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _class_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "C", "E", "M", "N"), value)
        if value is None:
            combo.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {_UNMARKED_COLOR.name()};")
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "class", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _target_combo(self, row: int, value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
        combo = _combo((None, "P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw"), value)
        combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index, target=row, widget=combo: self._set_parameter_value(
                target, "target", widget.currentData()
            )
        )
        return combo

    def _set_parameter_value(self, row: int, field: str, value: Any) -> None:
        try:
            self._store.set_value(f"profile.parameters.{row}.{field}", value)
        except ProjectError as exc:
            self._rebuild_table()
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)

    # --- предпросмотр ---------------------------------------------------

    def _update_preview(self, section: ProfileSection) -> None:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        self._projection = project_profile(section)
        counts = self._projection.counts()
        self._kappa_label.setText(
            f"κ {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)"
            f" · векторы P_gen {counts['P_gen']} / P_sim {counts['P_sim']}"
            f" / P_hw {counts['P_hw']}"
        )
        self._fill_projection_table(self._projection)
        report = self._report_text(section)
        self._report.setPlainText(report)
        self._status_label.setText(report)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("" if self._projection.ready else _ERROR_STYLE)

    def _fill_projection_table(self, projection: ProjectionResult) -> None:
        rows = [
            entry
            for target in ("P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw")
            for entry in projection.vectors.get(target, [])
        ]
        self._projection_table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, entry in enumerate(rows):
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 0, _plain(entry.parameter_id))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 1, _plain(entry.klass))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 2, _plain(entry.target))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 3, _plain(", ".join(entry.keys) or _EMPTY))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 4, _plain(str(entry.value)))
            self._projection_table.setItem(row, 5, _plain(entry.unit or _EMPTY))
        self._projection_table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        self._projection_table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch
        )

    def _report_text(self, section: ProfileSection, *, applied: bool = False) -> str:
        metrics = completeness(section)
        lines = [
            f"заказчик: {section.customer or _EMPTY}",
            f"NDA: {'да' if section.nda else 'нет'}",
            f"параметров: {metrics.total}, без класса: {metrics.unmarked}",
            f"κ = {metrics.kappa_text}, κ+ = {metrics.kappa_plus_text}",
        ]
        if self._unknown:
            lines.append(f"неизвестных полей сохранено: {len(self._unknown)}")
            lines.extend(f"  {item.path}.{item.name}" for item in self._unknown)
        if self._projection.uncovered:
            lines.append(f"не покрыто векторами: {len(self._projection.uncovered)}")
        for item in self._projection.issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        for item in self._issues:
            lines.append(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
        if not self._projection.ready:
            lines.append("проекция заблокирована: разметьте классы и векторы")
        elif applied:
            lines.append("профиль записан в проект")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _set_error(self, message: str, *, blocking: bool = True) -> None:
        if blocking:
            self._apply_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._status_label.setText(message)
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)

    # --- файлы ----------------------------------------------------------

    def import_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Читает профиль из файла и применяет его к проекту."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            chosen = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self,
                "Импорт профиля",
                str(self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            self._set_error(f"не удалось прочитать {target}: {exc}")
            return False

        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._suppress = True
        self._editor.setPlainText(text)
        self._suppress = False
        self._dirty = True
        if not self.check_text():
            return False
        if not self.apply_text():
            return False
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(
            f"импортировано: {target.name}; неизвестных полей {len(self._unknown)}"
        )
        return True

    def export_file(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Пишет профиль с версией и хэшем, соблюдая изоляцию NDA."""
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / "profile.json"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт профиля",
                str(suggested),
                "Профиль (JSON);;JSON (*.json)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        try:
            payload = export_profile_payload(self.section, destination=target)
        except NdaViolation as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт запрещён", str(exc))
            self._set_error(str(exc), blocking=False)
            return False
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(dump_profile_export(payload), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспортировано: {target} · {payload['hash']}")
        return True


def _combo(options: tuple[str | None, ...], value: str | None) -> QComboBox:
    combo = QComboBox()
    for option in options:
        combo.addItem(option or _EMPTY, option)
    index = combo.findData(value)
    combo.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
    return combo


def _plain(text: str) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
    return item


def _cell(text: str, parameter: ProfileParameter) -> QTableWidgetItem:
    item = _plain(text)
    if parameter.klass is None:
        item.setBackground(_UNMARKED_COLOR)
        item.setToolTip("класс не указан: проекция заблокирована")
    return item


def _value_text(parameter: ProfileParameter) -> str:
    if parameter.range is not None:
        return f"{parameter.range[0]}…{parameter.range[1]}"
    return str(parameter.value)


def _describe_issues(issues: list[Issue]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"{item.path}: {item.message}" for item in issues)


def _section_text(section: ProfileSection) -> str:
    """Читаемый JSON раздела для редактора."""
    payload = section.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"

1: """Изоляция NDA-профилей (T3-06, FR-PRF-08).
2: 
3: Профиль под NDA экспортируется только в защищённый каталог: список таких
4: каталогов задаётся переменной ``SIMORPH_NDA_ROOTS`` (та же, что использует
5: маскирование путей в логах). Если профиль не помечен как NDA, но ссылается
6: источником на защищённый каталог, экспорт тоже запрещён — иначе путь утечёт
7: в общий JSON.
8: 
9: Проверка возвращает замечания, а не бросает исключение: интерфейс
10: показывает их рядом с кнопкой экспорта, CLI печатает и завершается кодом 1.
11: """
12: 
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: import os
16: from collections.abc import Iterable
17: from pathlib import Path
18: 
19: from simorph.core.issues import Issue, IssueCode, issue
20: from simorph.core.models.profile import ProfileSection
21: from simorph.logging_setup import NDA_ROOTS_ENV
22: 
23: __all__ = [
24:     "NdaViolation",
25:     "check_nda_export",
26:     "is_nda_path",
27:     "nda_roots",
28: ]
29: 
30: 
31: class NdaViolation(Exception):
32:     """Экспорт NDA-профиля за пределы защищённого каталога."""
33: 
34: 
35: def nda_roots(explicit: Iterable[str | Path] | None = None) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
36:     """Защищённые каталоги: явный список или ``SIMORPH_NDA_ROOTS``."""
37:     if explicit is not None:
38:         candidates = [Path(str(item)) for item in explicit]
39:     else:
40:         raw = os.environ.get(NDA_ROOTS_ENV, "")
41:         candidates = [Path(part) for part in raw.split(os.pathsep) if part.strip()]
42:     return tuple(item.expanduser() for item in candidates)
43: 
44: 
45: def _resolved(path: Path) -> Path:
46:     try:
47:         return path.expanduser().resolve(strict=False)
48:     except OSError:  # pragma: no cover - защита от недопустимых путей
49:         return path.expanduser()
50: 
51: 
52: def is_nda_path(
53:     path: str | Path,
54:     roots: Iterable[str | Path] | None = None,
55: ) -> bool:
56:     """Лежит ли путь внутри защищённого каталога."""
57:     resolved_roots = nda_roots(roots)
58:     if not resolved_roots:
59:         return False
60:     target = _resolved(Path(str(path)))
61:     for root in resolved_roots:
62:         try:
63:             if target == _resolved(root) or target.is_relative_to(_resolved(root)):
64:                 return True
65:         except ValueError:  # pragma: no cover - разные диски на Windows
66:             continue
67:     return False
68: 
69: 
70: def check_nda_export(
71:     section: ProfileSection,
72:     destination: str | Path | None = None,
73:     *,
74:     roots: Iterable[str | Path] | None = None,
75: ) -> list[Issue]:
76:     """Проверяет, можно ли экспортировать профиль в указанное место."""
77:     resolved_roots = nda_roots(roots)
78:     issues: list[Issue] = []
79: 
80:     if section.nda:
81:         if not resolved_roots:
82:             issues.append(
83:                 issue(
84:                     IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
85:                     "profile.nda",
86:                     f"профиль помечен как NDA, но каталог не задан ({NDA_ROOTS_ENV})",
87:                 )
88:             )
89:         if destination is None:
90:             issues.append(
91:                 issue(
92:                     IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
93:                     "profile.nda",
94:                     "NDA-профиль экспортируется только в защищённый каталог:"
95:                     " укажите путь назначения",
96:                 )
97:             )
98:         elif not is_nda_path(destination, resolved_roots):
99:             issues.append(
100:                 issue(
101:                     IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
102:                     "profile.nda",
103:                     f"экспорт NDA-профиля за пределы защищённого каталога запрещён:"
104:                     f" {destination}",
105:                 )
106:             )
107:         return issues
108: 
109:     for index, parameter in enumerate(section.parameters):
110:         source = parameter.source
111:         if source and is_nda_path(source, resolved_roots):
112:             issues.append(
113:                 issue(
114:                     IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
115:                     f"profile.parameters.{index}.source",
116:                     "источник параметра лежит в NDA-каталоге:"
117:                     " профиль должен быть помечен как NDA",
118:                 )
119:             )
120:     return issues

7: в общий JSON.

10: показывает их рядом с кнопкой экспорта, CLI печатает и завершается кодом 1.

16: from collections.abc import Iterable

34: 
35: def nda_roots(explicit: Iterable[str | Path] | None = None) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
36:     """Защищённые каталоги: явный список или ``SIMORPH_NDA_ROOTS``."""
37:     if explicit is not None:
38:         candidates = [Path(str(item)) for item in explicit]
39:     else:
40:         raw = os.environ.get(NDA_ROOTS_ENV, "")
41:         candidates = [Path(part) for part in raw.split(os.pathsep) if part.strip()]
42:     return tuple(item.expanduser() for item in candidates)
43: 
44: 
45: def _resolved(path: Path) -> Path:
46:     try:
47:         return path.expanduser().resolve(strict=False)
48:     except OSError:  # pragma: no cover - защита от недопустимых путей
49:         return path.expanduser()

51: 
52: def is_nda_path(

55: ) -> bool:

57:     resolved_roots = nda_roots(roots)

78:     issues: list[Issue] = []

82:             issues.append(

87:                 )
88:             )
89:         if destination is None:
90:             issues.append(
91:                 issue(
92:                     IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,

106:             )
107:         return issues
108: 
109:     for index, parameter in enumerate(section.parameters):
110:         source = parameter.source
111:         if source and is_nda_path(source, resolved_roots):
112:             issues.append(

1: """Команды ``simorph profile``: project и export (T3-05, T3-07).
2: 
3: Команды работают headless: тот же расчёт κ/κ+ и ту же проекцию, что
4: показывает интерфейс. Экспорт пишет обёртку с версией и хэшем и уважает
5: NDA-каталог.
6: """
7: 
8: from __future__ import annotations
9: 
10: import argparse
11: import json
12: import logging
13: import sys
14: from pathlib import Path
15: from typing import Any
16: 
17: from simorph.cli.exit_codes import ExitCode
18: from simorph.cli.project import add_common_options
19: from simorph.core.profile import (
20:     check_nda_export,
21:     completeness,
22:     export_profile_payload,
23:     import_profile_text,
24:     project_profile,
25: )
26: from simorph.core.profile.exporting import dump_profile_export
27: 
28: __all__ = ["build_profile_parser", "run_profile_command"]
29: 
30: 
31: def build_profile_parser(subparsers: Any) -> None:
32:     """Регистрирует подкоманды ``profile``."""
33:     profile = subparsers.add_parser("profile", help="операции с профилем заказчика")
34:     add_common_options(profile)
35:     actions = profile.add_subparsers(dest="profile_command", metavar="ДЕЙСТВИЕ")
36: 
37:     project_parser = actions.add_parser("project", help="посчитать κ, κ+ и векторы")
38:     add_common_options(project_parser)
39:     project_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="путь к JSON профиля")
40: 
41:     export_parser = actions.add_parser("export", help="экспортировать профиль с версией и хэшем")
42:     add_common_options(export_parser)
43:     export_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="путь к JSON профиля")
44:     export_parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, required=True, help="куда писать")
45:     export_parser.add_argument(
46:         "--nda-root",
47:         type=Path,
48:         action="append",
49:         default=None,
50:         help="защищённый каталог (можно несколько); по умолчанию SIMORPH_NDA_ROOTS",
51:     )
52: 
53:     check_parser = actions.add_parser("check", help="проверить импорт профиля")
54:     add_common_options(check_parser)
55:     check_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="путь к JSON профиля")
56: 
57: 
58: def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
59:     try:
60:         return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
61:     except FileNotFoundError as exc:
62:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"файл профиля не найден: {path}") from exc
63: 
64: 
65: def _write(text: str) -> None:
66:     sys.stdout.write(f"{text}\n")
67: 
68: 
69: def _write_json(payload: object) -> None:
70:     _write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
71: 
72: 
73: def _cmd_project(path: Path, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
74:     imported = import_profile_text(_read_text(path))
75:     metrics = completeness(imported.section)
76:     projection = project_profile(imported.section)
77: 
78:     payload = {
79:         "status": "ok" if projection.ready else "blocked",
80:         "path": str(path),
81:         "customer": imported.section.customer,
82:         "nda": imported.section.nda,
83:         "parameters": imported.parameter_count,
84:         "unknown_fields": [item.to_dict() for item in imported.unknown],
85:         "completeness": metrics.to_dict(),
86:         "projection": projection.to_dict(),
87:     }
88:     if as_json:
89:         _write_json(payload)
90:     else:
91:         _write(f"профиль  {path}")
92:         _write(f"заказчик {imported.section.customer or '—'}")
93:         _write(f"параметров {metrics.total}, неизвестных полей {len(imported.unknown)}")
94:         _write(f"κ  {metrics.kappa_text} ({metrics.kappa_percent:.1f} %)")
95:         _write(f"κ+ {metrics.kappa_plus_text} ({metrics.kappa_plus_percent:.1f} %)")
96:         counts = projection.counts()
97:         _write(
98:             "векторы  "
99:             + ", ".join(f"{target}: {count}" for target, count in counts.items())
100:         )
101:         if projection.uncovered:
102:             _write(f"не покрыто {len(projection.uncovered)} параметров")
103:         for item in projection.issues:
104:             _write(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
105: 
106:     if not projection.ready:
107:         logger.error("проекция заблокирована: %s", path)
108:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
109:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
110: 
111: 
112: def _cmd_check(path: Path, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
113:     imported = import_profile_text(_read_text(path))
114:     payload = imported.report()
115:     if as_json:
116:         _write_json({"status": "ok", **payload})
117:     else:
118:         _write(f"профиль  {path}")
119:         _write(f"параметров {imported.parameter_count}")
120:         _write(f"неизвестных полей {len(imported.unknown)}")
121:         for item in imported.unknown:
122:             _write(f"  сохранено: {item.path}.{item.name}")
123:         for item in imported.issues:
124:             _write(f"  {item.path}: {item.message}")
125:     if any(item.severity == "error" for item in imported.issues):
126:         logger.error("профиль содержит ошибки: %s", path)
127:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
128:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
129: 
130: 
131: def _cmd_export(
132:     path: Path,
133:     output: Path,
134:     *,
135:     as_json: bool,
136:     logger: logging.Logger,
137:     nda_root: list[Path] | None,
138: ) -> int:
139:     imported = import_profile_text(_read_text(path))
140:     roots = nda_root
141:     violations = check_nda_export(imported.section, output, roots=roots)
142:     if violations:
143:         for item in violations:
144:             logger.error("%s", item.message)
145:         if as_json:
146:             _write_json(
147:                 {
148:                     "status": "error",
149:                     "error": "экспорт запрещён",
150:                     "issues": [item.to_dict() for item in violations],
151:                 }
152:             )
153:         else:
154:             for item in violations:
155:                 sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {item.message}\n")
156:         return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
157: 
158:     payload = export_profile_payload(imported.section, destination=output, roots=roots)
159:     output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
160:     output.write_text(dump_profile_export(payload), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
161: 
162:     if as_json:
163:         _write_json({"status": "ok", "path": str(output), "hash": payload["hash"]})
164:     else:
165:         _write(f"экспортирован профиль: {output}")
166:         _write(f"hash {payload['hash']}")
167:     return int(ExitCode.OK)
168: 
169: 
170: def run_profile_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
171:     """Диспетчер подкоманд ``profile``."""
172:     command = getattr(args, "profile_command", None)
173:     if command == "project":
174:         return _cmd_project(args.path, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
175:     if command == "check":
176:         return _cmd_check(args.path, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
177:     if command == "export":
178:         return _cmd_export(
179:             args.path,
180:             args.output,
181:             as_json=as_json,
182:             logger=logger,
183:             nda_root=args.nda_root,
184:         )
185:     logger.error("не указано действие для profile: project, check или export")
186:     return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)

1: """Сборка эталонных профилей в ``examples/profiles`` (T3-08).

5: и в golden-тестах. Профиль «Татнефть» помечен как NDA, поэтому лежит
6: в отдельном каталоге ``examples/profiles/nda``.
7: 
8: Запуск: ``python scripts/build_reference_profiles.py``.
9: """
10: 
11: from __future__ import annotations
12: 
13: import sys
14: from pathlib import Path
15: 
16: ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
17: if str(ROOT / "src") not in sys.path:  # pragma: no cover - запуск без установки
18:     sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

28: PROFILES_DIR = ROOT / "examples" / "profiles"
29: 
30: #: Каталог NDA-профилей: только он считается защищённым.

35:     """Путь файла профиля: NDA-профили уходят в отдельный каталог."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from simorph.core.profile import (
    CUSTOMER_CODES,
    PROFILE_SPEC,
    SPEC_BY_ID,
    build_reference_profile,
    completeness,
    profile_hash,
    project_profile,
    spec_by_block,
)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROFILES_DIR = ROOT / "examples" / "profiles"
NDA_DIR = PROFILES_DIR / "nda"


def test_spec_has_75_unique_parameters() -> None:
    assert len(PROFILE_SPEC) == 75
    assert len(SPEC_BY_ID) == 75
    assert [spec.id for spec in PROFILE_SPEC] == [f"П-{number:02d}" for number in range(1, 76)]


def test_spec_classes_match_source_table() -> None:
    assert Counter(spec.klass for spec in PROFILE_SPEC) == {
        "C": 17,
        "E": 25,
        "M": 15,
        "N": 18,
    }


def test_spec_blocks_cover_a_to_j() -> None:
    assert Counter(spec.block for spec in PROFILE_SPEC) == {
        "A": 5,
        "B": 9,
        "C": 8,
        "D": 9,
        "E": 9,
        "F": 8,
        "G": 8,
        "H": 7,
        "I": 7,
        "J": 5,
    }


def test_spec_by_block_returns_only_that_block() -> None:
    block = spec_by_block("G")
    assert block
    assert {spec.block for spec in block} == {"G"}
    assert len(block) == 8


def test_projected_classes_have_target_and_keys() -> None:
    for spec in PROFILE_SPEC:
        if spec.klass in {"C", "E"}:
            assert spec.target in {"P_gen", "P_sim", "P_hw"}, spec.id
            assert spec.projection, spec.id


def test_class_n_is_never_projected() -> None:
    for spec in PROFILE_SPEC:
        if spec.klass == "N":
            assert spec.target is None, spec.id
            assert spec.projection == (), spec.id


@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", CUSTOMER_CODES)
def test_reference_profile_is_complete(code: str) -> None:
    section = build_reference_profile(code)
    metrics = completeness(section)

    assert len(section.parameters) == 75
    assert metrics.unmarked == 0
    assert metrics.kappa_text == "42/75"
    assert metrics.kappa_plus_text == "57/75"
    assert metrics.kappa_percent == pytest.approx(56.0)
    assert metrics.kappa_plus_percent == pytest.approx(76.0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", CUSTOMER_CODES)
def test_reference_profile_projects_into_three_vectors(code: str) -> None:
    projection = project_profile(build_reference_profile(code))

    assert projection.ready
    assert projection.counts() == {"P_gen": 17, "P_sim": 30, "P_hw": 5}
    assert len(projection.uncovered) == 5


@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", CUSTOMER_CODES)
def test_example_file_matches_generator(code: str) -> None:
    section = build_reference_profile(code)
    path = (NDA_DIR if section.nda else PROFILES_DIR) / f"{code}.json"
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    assert payload["export_version"] == "1.0"
    assert payload["hash"] == profile_hash(section)
    assert payload["profile"]["customer"] == section.customer
    assert payload["profile"]["nda"] is section.nda
    assert len(payload["profile"]["parameters"]) == 75


def test_nda_profile_lives_in_protected_directory() -> None:
    assert build_reference_profile("tatneft").nda
    assert not build_reference_profile("agroforce").nda
    assert (NDA_DIR / "tatneft.json").exists()
    assert not (PROFILES_DIR / "tatneft.json").exists()

from simorph.core.profile import completeness, project_profile

from simorph.core.validation import validate_document


def _section(*parameters: ProfileParameter) -> ProfileSection:
    return ProfileSection(schema_version=CURRENT_VERSION, parameters=list(parameters))


def _parameter(**fields: object) -> ProfileParameter:
    base: dict[str, object] = {"id": "П-06", "value": 120.0, "block": "B"}
    base.update(fields)
    return ProfileParameter.model_validate(base)


def _document(section: ProfileSection, project_document: ProjectDocument) -> ProjectDocument:
    return project_document.model_copy(update={"profile": section})


def test_empty_profile_is_not_blocked() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section())

    assert projection.ready
    assert projection.counts() == {"P_gen": 0, "P_sim": 0, "P_hw": 0}
    assert completeness(_section()).total == 0


def test_unmarked_class_blocks_projection() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section(_parameter()))

    assert not projection.ready
    assert projection.vectors["P_gen"] == []
    assert projection.issues[0].path == "profile.parameters.0.class"
    assert projection.uncovered[0].reason == "класс не указан"


def test_class_c_without_target_blocks_projection() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section(_parameter(klass="C")))

    assert not projection.ready
    assert projection.issues[0].path == "profile.parameters.0.target"


def test_class_e_without_target_blocks_projection() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section(_parameter(klass="E")))

    assert not projection.ready
    assert "не проецируется" in projection.issues[0].message


def test_class_m_without_target_is_allowed() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section(_parameter(klass="M")))

    assert projection.ready
    assert projection.counts() == {"P_gen": 0, "P_sim": 0, "P_hw": 0}
    assert [item.parameter_id for item in projection.uncovered] == ["П-06"]


def test_class_n_is_kept_but_not_projected() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(_section(_parameter(klass="N")))

    assert projection.ready
    assert projection.counts() == {"P_gen": 0, "P_sim": 0, "P_hw": 0}
    assert projection.uncovered == []


def test_parameter_without_keys_is_a_warning() -> None:
    projection = project_profile(
        _section(_parameter(klass="C", target="P_gen", projection=[]))
    )

    assert projection.ready
    assert projection.counts()["P_gen"] == 1
    assert projection.issues[0].severity == "warning"
    assert projection.issues[0].path == "profile.parameters.0.projection"


def test_range_parameter_projects_as_pair() -> None:
    parameter = _parameter(value=None, range=(1.0, 18.0), klass="E", target="P_sim")

    entry = projection.vectors["P_sim"][0]

    assert entry.value == [1.0, 18.0]
    assert entry.klass == "E"


def test_key_map_groups_parameters_by_vector_key() -> None:
    first = _parameter(id="П-06", klass="C", target="P_gen", projection=["world.size.x"])

    assert key_map == {"world.size.x": ["П-06", "П-12"]}


def test_completeness_ignores_unmarked_and_n() -> None:
    section = _section(
        _parameter(id="П-01", klass="C", target="P_gen", projection=["a"]),
        _parameter(id="П-02", klass="E", target="P_sim", projection=["b"]),
        _parameter(id="П-03", klass="M"),
        _parameter(id="П-04", klass="N"),
        _parameter(id="П-05"),
    )
    metrics = completeness(section)

    assert metrics.total == 5
    assert metrics.unmarked == 1
    assert metrics.kappa_text == "2/5"
    assert metrics.kappa_plus_text == "3/5"
    assert not metrics.ready


def test_validation_warns_about_unmarked_class(project_document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
    document = _document(_section(_parameter()), project_document)

    issues = [item for item in validate_document(document) if item.path.startswith("profile.")]

    assert len(issues) == 1
    assert issues[0].path == "profile.parameters.0.class"
    assert issues[0].severity == "warning"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("klass", "target"),
    [("C", "P_gen"), ("E", "P_sim"), ("E", "P_hw"), ("M", "P_sim")],
)
def test_validation_accepts_allowed_targets(
    project_document: ProjectDocument, klass: str, target: str
) -> None:
    document = _document(
        _section(_parameter(klass=klass, target=target, projection=["key"])),
        project_document,
    )

    assert validate_document(document) == []


def test_new_project_profile_is_valid(project_document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
    section = new_project("test", seed=1).profile

    assert section.parameters == []
    assert completeness(section).ready is False
    assert project_profile(section).ready

from __future__ import annotations

    JsonPositionError,

)

def test_unknown_fields_are_preserved_and_reported() -> None:
    payload = {
        "customer": "АО «Тест»",
        "owner": "Иванов",
        "parameters": [{"id": "П-06", "value": 1.0, "class": "M", "legacy": "да"}],
    }

    imported = import_profile_payload(payload)

    assert [item.name for item in imported.unknown] == ["owner", "legacy"]
    assert imported.section.extra == {"owner": "Иванов"}
    assert imported.section.parameters[0].extra == {"legacy": "да"}

    exported = profile_payload(imported.section)
    assert exported["owner"] == "Иванов"
    assert exported["parameters"][0]["legacy"] == "да"
    assert "extra" not in exported


def test_export_envelope_is_accepted_on_import() -> None:

    assert imported.section.customer == section.customer

    assert error.value.column > 1
    assert "строка 2" in str(error.value)
