        "actuator_types": sorted({item.type for item in agent.actuators}),
        "hw": groups,
        "hw_constants": sum(len(group) for group in groups.values()),
    }
    if as_json:
        _write_json(payload)
        return int(ExitCode.OK)
    _write(f"агент    {agent.agent_id} ({agent.role})")
    _write(
        f"звеньев {len(agent.links)}, суставов {len(agent.joints)},"
        f" корень {tree.root or '—'}, масса {tree.total_mass_kg:.2f} кг"
    )
    _write(f"сенсоры  {len(agent.sensors)}: {', '.join(payload['sensor_types'])}")
    _write(f"актуаторы {len(agent.actuators)}: {', '.join(payload['actuator_types'])}")
    for group, values in groups.items():
        _write(f"  {group:<7} {len(values)} констант")
    for message in tree.errors:
        _write(f"  ошибка дерева: {message}")
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def _cmd_validate(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    document = _load(args.path)
    agent = _agent(document, args.index)
    issues = check_agent(agent, index=args.index)
    errors = sum(1 for item in issues if item.severity is Severity.ERROR)
    payload = {
        "status": "ok" if errors == 0 else "error",
        "agent_id": agent.agent_id,
        "errors": errors,
        "warnings": len(issues) - errors,
        "issues": issues_to_payload(issues),
        "thrust_margin": round(thrust_margin(agent), 3),
        "launch_allowed": errors == 0,
    }
    if as_json:
        _write_json(payload)
    else:
        _write(f"агент {agent.agent_id}: ошибок {errors}, предупреждений {len(issues) - errors}")
        _write(f"тяга/вес {payload['thrust_margin']}")
        for item in issues:
            _write(f"  {item.severity}: {item.path}: {item.message}")
    if errors:
        logger.error("агент не проходит физическую валидацию: ошибок %d", errors)
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def _cmd_export(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    document = _load(args.path)
    agent = _agent(document, args.index)
    path = write_urdf(agent, args.output)
    manifest = export_manifest(agent)
    payload = {"status": "ok", "file": str(path), "manifest": manifest}
    if as_json:
        _write_json(payload)
    else:
        _write(f"экспорт {path}")
        _write(
            f"звеньев {manifest['links']}, суставов {manifest['joints']},"
            f" сенсоров {manifest['sensors']}, актуаторов {manifest['actuators']},"
            f" P_hw {manifest['hw_constants']}"
        )
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def _cmd_preview(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    document = _load(args.path)
    agent = _agent(document, args.index)
    camera = initial_camera(agent)
    if args.distance is not None:
        camera.distance = float(args.distance)
    camera.yaw_deg = float(args.yaw)
    camera.pitch_deg = float(args.pitch)
    spec = CameraSpec(width=args.width, height=args.height)
    preview = AgentPreview(agent)
    try:
        stats = preview.rebuild(zones=not args.no_zones)
        if stats.status != "ready":
            logger.error("предпросмотр прерван: %s", stats.error)
            if as_json:
                _write_json({"status": "error", "error": stats.error})
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: предпросмотр прерван: {stats.error}\n")
            return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
        frame = preview.render(camera, spec)
        meta = {
            "agent_id": agent.agent_id,
            "role": agent.role,
            "camera": camera.to_dict(),
            "sensor": spec.to_dict(),
            "preview": stats.to_dict(),
            "depth_min": round(frame.depth_range()[0], 3),
            "depth_max": round(frame.depth_range()[1], 3),
        }
        image, meta_path = save_snapshot(args.output, frame.rgb, meta)
        payload = {
            "status": "ok",
            "image": str(image),
            "meta": str(meta_path),
            "links": stats.links,
            "zones": stats.zones,
            "collisions": [list(pair) for pair in stats.collisions],
            "build_ms": round(stats.build_ms, 3),
        }
        if as_json:
            _write_json(payload)
        else:
            _write(f"предпросмотр {image}")
            _write(
                f"звеньев {stats.links}, зон {stats.zones},"
                f" коллизий {len(stats.collisions)}, сборка {stats.build_ms:.1f} мс"
            )
    finally:
        preview.close()
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def run_agent_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    """Диспетчер подкоманд ``agent``."""
    command = getattr(args, "agent_command", None)
    try:
        if command == "build":
            return _cmd_build(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
        if command == "validate":
            return _cmd_validate(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
        if command == "export":
            return _cmd_export(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
        if command == "preview":
            return _cmd_preview(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
    except ProjectError as exc:
        logger.error("%s", exc)
        if as_json:
            _write_json({"status": "error", "error": str(exc)})
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {exc}\n")
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    logger.error("не указано действие для agent: build, validate, export или preview")
    return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)

So wheels are inside base — geometrically wrong reference! The wheel poses should be relative to base such that they sit outside: base at z 0.25 with half height 0.2 → bottom 0.05; wheel radius 0.1, center z should be 0.1 world → relative pose z = -0.15. x should be 0.6+0.05=0.65? Base half x 0.6; wheel half length 0.05 along x (cylinder size x is diameter 0.2 → half 0.1). Cylinder axis z by default in our renderer, but wheels should be axis y. Our renderer doesn't support rotation, so cylinder is vertical — for preview it's schematic. Position wheel outside: x = ±0.7, y = ±0.45, z=-0.15 relative → world 0.1. Then base x ±0.6, wheel x 0.7±0.1 → 0.6..0.8 touch at 0.6 (tolerance 1e-6, touching not collision since strict <). Good.

cam_pan relative (0,0,0.3) → world z 0.55, base top 0.45, cam_pan cylinder half z 0.05 → 0.5..0.6 no overlap. mast relative (0,0,0.5) → world 0.75, height 0.8 → 0.35..1.15 overlaps base (top 0.45) and cam_pan (0.5..0.6). Also drone rotors: body spans z 0..0.12 (pose 0.06 half 0.06), rotor pose z 0.13 relative → world 0.19, rotor half z 0.01 → 0.18..0.20 no overlap. x: body ±0.2, rotor at 0.25±0.125 → 0.125..0.375 overlaps body x 0.125..0.2. Note validation mass tolerance 25% — 47 exact.

Also factory has only 1 wheel and 1 drive; no collision check in validation, fine.

    """Агент-ровер: корпус, ведущее колесо и стереокамера."""

                update={

                    "gpu_budget_ms": 6.0,

                    "heavy_light_threshold_ms": 3.0,
                }
            ),
            "tc_com": base.tc_com.model_copy(update={"bandwidth_mbps": 200.0}),
        }
    )
    return AgentSection(
        schema_version=CURRENT_VERSION,
        agent_id=DEMO_AGENT_ID,
        role="rover",
        links=[
            Link(id="base", type="box", size_m=(1.2, 0.8, 0.4), mass_kg=45.0, pose=(0.0, 0.0, 0.2)),

        joints=[
            Joint(

                parent="base",
                child="wheel_fl",
                type="continuous",
                axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0),

        sensors=[

                baseline_m=0.12,
                fov_deg=90.0,

        actuators=[

function.name: create_new_file
function.arguments:
{"contents": """"Вкладка «Агент»: дерево конфигурации и 3D-предпросмотр (T5-04, T5-06).

Слева — состав агента: звенья, сенсоры, актуаторы и бортовые константы
``P_hw`` по группам ``TC-*``. Справа — предпросмотр без фотореализма:
орбита, панорамирование, зум, зоны обслуживания и подсветка коллизий.

Предпросмотр пересобирается после правки документа с задержкой: набор
текста в инспекторе не должен перестраивать сцену на каждый символ.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QImage, QMouseEvent, QPainter, QPaintEvent, QWheelEvent
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QSplitter,
    QTreeWidget,
    QTreeWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from simorph.core.agent import (
    AgentPreview,
    build_tree,
    check_agent,
    hw_payload,
    initial_camera,
)
from simorph.core.models.agent import AgentSection
from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
from simorph.core.world import CameraSpec, OrbitCamera
from simorph.settings import ApplicationSettings
from simorph.ui.scene_view import _Canvas, _to_image

__all__ = ["AgentView"]

#: Интервал обновления вида, мс.
FRAME_INTERVAL_MS = 33

#: Разрешение кадра в покое и во время движения камеры.
IDLE_SIZE = (640, 480)
INTERACTIVE_SIZE = (320, 240)

#: Задержка пересборки после правки документа, мс.
REBUILD_DELAY_MS = 300

#: Сколько миллисекунд после движения камеры считать вид «в движении».
INTERACTION_HOLD_MS = 250

_ERROR_STYLE = "color: #e5534b;"


class AgentView(QWidget):
    """3D-предпросмотр агента и его состав."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        document: ProjectDocument,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._settings = settings
        self._document = document
        self._agent = _first_agent(document)
        self._preview = AgentPreview(self._agent) if self._agent is not None else None
        self._camera = initial_camera(self._agent) if self._agent is not None else OrbitCamera()
        self._interacting = False
        self._frame_ms = 0.0
        self._fps = 0.0
        self._last_mouse: QPoint | None = None
        self._mode = "orbit"
        self._disposed = False
        self.setObjectName("editor_agent")

        self._canvas = _Canvas(self)
        self._tree = QTreeWidget()
        self._tree.setHeaderLabels(["Параметр", "Значение"])
        self._tree.setColumnWidth(0, 220)
        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._fps_label = QLabel("—")

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(self._tree)
        splitter.addWidget(self._canvas)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        splitter.setSizes([320, 640])

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)
        layout.addWidget(self._fps_label)

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(FRAME_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.tick)

        self._rebuild_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._rebuild_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._rebuild_timer.setInterval(REBUILD_DELAY_MS)
        self._rebuild_timer.timeout.connect(self._rebuild_now)

        self._hold_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._hold_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._hold_timer.setInterval(INTERACTION_HOLD_MS)
        self._hold_timer.timeout.connect(self._stop_interaction)

        self._rebuild_now()
        self._timer.start()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        reset_button = QPushButton("Сброс вида")
        reset_button.clicked.connect(self.reset_view)
        export_button = QPushButton("Экспорт URDF…")
        export_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.save_export())
        self._zones_box = QCheckBox("Зоны")
        self._zones_box.setChecked(True)
        self._zones_box.toggled.connect(self.set_zones)
        for widget in (reset_button, export_button, self._zones_box):
            row.addWidget(widget)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def preview(self) -> AgentPreview | None:
        return self._preview

    @property
    def camera(self) -> OrbitCamera:
        return self._camera

    @property
    def fps(self) -> float:
        return self._fps

    @property
    def frame_ms(self) -> float:
        return self._frame_ms

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    @property
    def agent(self) -> AgentSection | None:
        return self._agent

    def tick(self) -> None:
        """Один шаг вида: кадр и статистика."""
        if self._disposed or not self.isVisible():
            return
        started = time.perf_counter()
        self._render()
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0
        self._frame_ms = elapsed if self._frame_ms <= 0.0 else 0.8 * self._frame_ms + 0.2 * elapsed
        self._fps = 1000.0 / self._frame_ms if self._frame_ms > 0.0 else 0.0
        if self._preview is not None:
            self._fps_label.setText(
                f"FPS {self._fps:.0f} · кадр {self._frame_ms:.0f} мс"
                f" · звеньев {self._preview.stats.links}"
                f" · коллизий {len(self._preview.stats.collisions)}"
            )

    def render_once(self, width: int | None = None, height: int | None = None) -> QImage:
        """Снимает и возвращает кадр (для тестов и снимка)."""
        if self._preview is None:
            return QImage()
        target = (width, height) if width and height else IDLE_SIZE
        spec = CameraSpec(width=target[0], height=target[1])
        frame = self._preview.render(self._camera, spec)
        return _to_image(frame.rgb, spec.width, spec.height)

    def _render(self) -> None:
        if self._preview is None:
            self._canvas.set_message("в проекте нет агентов")
            return
        if self._preview.stats.status != "ready":
            self._canvas.set_message(
                f"предпросмотр прерван: {self._preview.stats.error or 'неизвестная ошибка'}"
            )
            return
        size = INTERACTIVE_SIZE if self._interacting else IDLE_SIZE
        self._canvas.set_image(self.render_once(*size))

    # --- документ -------------------------------------------------------

    def rebuild(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
        """Откладывает пересборку после правки документа."""
        self._document = document
        self._rebuild_timer.start()

    def _rebuild_now(self) -> None:
        if self._disposed:
            return
        agent = _first_agent(self._document)
        self._agent = agent
        if agent is None:
            if self._preview is not None:
                self._preview.close()
                self._preview = None
            self._tree.clear()
            self._update_status(None)
            self._render()
            return
        if self._preview is None:
            self._preview = AgentPreview(agent)
        self._camera = initial_camera(agent)
        stats = self._preview.rebuild(agent, zones=self._zones_box.isChecked())
        self._fill_tree(agent)
        self._update_status(stats)
        self._render()

    def reset_view(self) -> None:
        """Возвращает камеру к обзору агента целиком."""
        if self._agent is not None:
            self._camera = initial_camera(self._agent)
        self._render()

    def set_zones(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self._zones_box.setChecked(bool(enabled))
        if self._preview is not None:
            stats = self._preview.set_zones(bool(enabled))
            self._update_status(stats)

    def _fill_tree(self, agent: AgentSection) -> None:
        """Состав агента: звенья, сенсоры, актуаторы и константы."""
        self._tree.clear()
        tree = build_tree(agent)
        links = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Звенья ({len(agent.links)})", f"корень {tree.root or '—'}"])
        for link in agent.links:
            links.addChild(
                QTreeWidgetItem(
                    [link.id, f"{link.type}, {link.mass_kg:g} кг, {_size_text(link.size_m)}"]
                )
            )
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(links)

        sensors = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Сенсоры ({len(agent.sensors)})", ""])
        for sensor in agent.sensors:
            sensors.addChild(
                QTreeWidgetItem(
                    [sensor.id, f"{sensor.type}, {sensor.rate_hz:g} Гц, звено {sensor.link or '—'}"]
                )
            )
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(sensors)

        actuators = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Актуаторы ({len(agent.actuators)})", ""])
        for actuator in agent.actuators:
            actuators.addChild(QTreeWidgetItem([actuator.id, actuator.type]))
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(actuators)

        payload = hw_payload(agent)
        constants = QTreeWidgetItem([f"P_hw ({len(payload)})", "TC-DYN/SEN/CMP/ENE/COM"])
        groups: dict[str, QTreeWidgetItem] = {}
        for item in payload:
            group = str(item["group"])
            node = groups.get(group)
            if node is None:
                node = QTreeWidgetItem([group, ""])
                groups[group] = node
                constants.addChild(node)
            value = item["value"]
            text = " ".join(f"{part:g}" for part in value) if isinstance(value, list) else f"{value:g}"
            node.addChild(QTreeWidgetItem([f"{item['id']} {item['title']}", f"{text} {item['unit']}"]))
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(constants)
        self._tree.expandToDepth(0)

    def _update_status(self, stats: Any) -> None:
        if self._agent is None:
            self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)
            self._status_label.setText("в проекте нет агентов")
            return
        issues = check_agent(self._agent)
        errors = sum(1 for item in issues if item.severity == "error")
        parts = [
            f"агент {self._agent.agent_id} ({self._agent.role})",
            f"звеньев {len(self._agent.links)}",
            f"сенсоров {len(self._agent.sensors)}",
            f"актуаторов {len(self._agent.actuators)}",
        ]
        if stats is not None:
            parts.append(f"сборка {stats.build_ms:.0f} мс")
            if stats.collisions:
                parts.append(f"коллизий {len(stats.collisions)}")
        parts.append(f"ошибок {errors}")
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE if errors else "")
        self._status_label.setText(" · ".join(parts))

    # --- экспорт --------------------------------------------------------

    def save_export(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Сохраняет URDF-подобный файл агента."""
        if self._agent is None:
            return False
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / f"{self._agent.agent_id}.urdf"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт агента",
                str(suggested),
                "URDF-подобный файл (*.urdf *.xml);;Все файлы (*)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        from simorph.core.agent import write_urdf

        try:
            written = write_urdf(self._agent, target)
        except OSError as exc:  # экспорт не должен ронять окно
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт не выполнен", str(exc))
            return False
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспорт: {written.name}")
        return True

    # --- мышь -----------------------------------------------------------

    def mousePressEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = event.position().toPoint()
        self._mode = "orbit" if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton else "pan"
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        if self._last_mouse is None:
            return
        point = event.position().toPoint()
        delta = point - self._last_mouse
        self._last_mouse = point
        if self._mode == "orbit":
            self._camera.orbit(delta.x() * 0.4, delta.y() * 0.4)
        else:
            self._camera.pan(delta.x(), delta.y())
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = None
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def wheelEvent(self, event: QWheelEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        steps = event.angleDelta().y() / 120.0
        self._camera.zoom(0.85**steps)
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def _stop_interaction(self) -> None:
        self._interacting = False

    # --- жизненный цикл -------------------------------------------------

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает таймеры и освобождает соединение PyBullet."""
        self._disposed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self._rebuild_timer.stop()
        self._hold_timer.stop()
        if self._preview is not None:
            self._preview.close()

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self.dispose()
        super().closeEvent(event)


def _first_agent(document: ProjectDocument) -> AgentSection | None:
    return document.agents[0] if document.agents else None


def _size_text(size: tuple[float, float, float]) -> str:
    return "×".join(f"{value:g}" for value in size) + " м"


def _paint_placeholder(widget: QWidget, message: str) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt
    """Заглушка для пустого проекта: используется только вручную."""
    painter = QPainter(widget)
    try:
        painter.setPen(QColor("#e5534b"))
        painter.drawText(widget.rect(), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, message)
    finally:
        painter.end()


def _paint_event(widget: QWidget, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt

        constants = QTreeWidgetItem([f"P_hw ({len(payload)})", "TC-DYN/SEN/CMP/ENE/COM"])

        for item in payload:
            group = str(item["group"])
            node = groups.get(group)
            if node is None:
                node = QTreeWidgetItem([group, ""])
                groups[group] = node

                self,
                "Экспорт агента",
                str(suggested),

            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        from simorph.core.agent import write_urdf

        try:
            written = write_urdf(self._agent, target)
        except OSError as exc:  # экспорт не должен ронять окно
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт не выполнен", str(exc))
            return False

        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспорт: {written.name}")
        return True

    def mousePressEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = event.position().toPoint()
        self._mode = "orbit" if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton else "pan"
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        if self._last_mouse is None:
            return
        point = event.position().toPoint()
        delta = point - self._last_mouse
        self._last_mouse = point
        if self._mode == "orbit":
            self._camera.orbit(delta.x() * 0.4, delta.y() * 0.4)
        else:
            self._camera.pan(delta.x(), delta.y())
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = None
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def wheelEvent(self, event: QWheelEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        steps = event.angleDelta().y() / 120.0
        self._camera.zoom(0.85**steps)
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def _stop_interaction(self) -> None:
        self._interacting = False

    # --- жизненный цикл -------------------------------------------------

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает таймеры и освобождает соединение PyBullet."""
        self._disposed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self._rebuild_timer.stop()
        self._hold_timer.stop()
        if self._preview is not None:
            self._preview.close()

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self.dispose()
        super().closeEvent(event)


def _first_agent(document: ProjectDocument) -> AgentSection | None:
    return document.agents[0] if document.agents else None


def _size_text(size: tuple[float, float, float]) -> str:
    return "×".join(f"{value:g}" for value in size) + " м"


def _paint_placeholder(widget: QWidget, message: str) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt
    """Заглушка для пустого проекта: используется только вручную."""
    painter = QPainter(widget)
    try:
        painter.setPen(QColor("#e5534b"))
        painter.drawText(widget.rect(), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, message)
    finally:
        painter.end()


def _paint_event(widget: QWidget, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt
    """Совместимость с Qt: фактическая отрисовка — в ``_Canvas``."""
    widget.paintEvent(event)  # type: ignore[misc]

    """3D-предпросмотр агента и его состав."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        document: ProjectDocument,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._settings = settings
        self._document = document
        self._agent = _first_agent(document)
        self._preview = AgentPreview(self._agent) if self._agent is not None else None
        self._camera = initial_camera(self._agent) if self._agent is not None else OrbitCamera()
        self._interacting = False
        self._frame_ms = 0.0
        self._fps = 0.0
        self._last_mouse: QPoint | None = None
        self._mode = "orbit"
        self._disposed = False
        self.setObjectName("editor_agent")

        self._canvas = _Canvas(self)
        self._tree = QTreeWidget()
        self._tree.setHeaderLabels(["Параметр", "Значение"])
        self._tree.setColumnWidth(0, 220)
        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._fps_label = QLabel("—")

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(self._tree)
        splitter.addWidget(self._canvas)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        splitter.setSizes([320, 640])

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)
        layout.addWidget(self._fps_label)

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(FRAME_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.tick)

        self._rebuild_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._rebuild_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._rebuild_timer.setInterval(REBUILD_DELAY_MS)
        self._rebuild_timer.timeout.connect(self._rebuild_now)

        self._hold_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._hold_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._hold_timer.setInterval(INTERACTION_HOLD_MS)
        self._hold_timer.timeout.connect(self._stop_interaction)

        self._rebuild_now()
        self._timer.start()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        reset_button = QPushButton("Сброс вида")
        reset_button.clicked.connect(self.reset_view)
        export_button = QPushButton("Экспорт URDF…")
        export_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.save_export())
        self._zones_box = QCheckBox("Зоны")
        self._zones_box.setChecked(True)
        self._zones_box.toggled.connect(self.set_zones)
        for widget in (reset_button, export_button, self._zones_box):
            row.addWidget(widget)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def preview(self) -> AgentPreview | None:
        return self._preview

    @property
    def camera(self) -> OrbitCamera:
        return self._camera

    @property
    def fps(self) -> float:
        return self._fps

    @property
    def frame_ms(self) -> float:
        return self._frame_ms

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    @property
    def agent(self) -> AgentSection | None:
        return self._agent

    def tick(self) -> None:
        """Один шаг вида: кадр и статистика."""
        if self._disposed or not self.isVisible():
            return
        started = time.perf_counter()
        self._render()
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0
        self._frame_ms = elapsed if self._frame_ms <= 0.0 else 0.8 * self._frame_ms + 0.2 * elapsed
        self._fps = 1000.0 / self._frame_ms if self._frame_ms > 0.0 else 0.0
        if self._preview is not None:
            self._fps_label.setText(
                f"FPS {self._fps:.0f} · кадр {self._frame_ms:.0f} мс"
                f" · звеньев {self._preview.stats.links}"
                f" · коллизий {len(self._preview.stats.collisions)}"
            )

    def render_once(self, width: int | None = None, height: int | None = None) -> QImage:
        """Снимает и возвращает кадр (для тестов и снимка)."""
        if self._preview is None:
            return QImage()
        target = (width, height) if width and height else IDLE_SIZE
        spec = CameraSpec(width=target[0], height=target[1])
        frame = self._preview.render(self._camera, spec)
        return _to_image(frame.rgb, spec.width, spec.height)

    def _render(self) -> None:
        if self._preview is None:
            self._canvas.set_message("в проекте нет агентов")
            return
        if self._preview.stats.status != "ready":
            self._canvas.set_message(
                f"предпросмотр прерван: {self._preview.stats.error or 'неизвестная ошибка'}"
            )
            return
        size = INTERACTIVE_SIZE if self._interacting else IDLE_SIZE
        self._canvas.set_image(self.render_once(*size))

    # --- документ -------------------------------------------------------

    def rebuild(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
        """Откладывает пересборку после правки документа."""
        self._document = document
        self._rebuild_timer.start()

    def _rebuild_now(self) -> None:
        if self._disposed:
            return
        agent = _first_agent(self._document)
        self._agent = agent
        if agent is None:
            if self._preview is not None:
                self._preview.close()
                self._preview = None
            self._tree.clear()
            self._update_status(None)
            self._render()
            return
        if self._preview is None:
            self._preview = AgentPreview(agent)
        self._camera = initial_camera(agent)
        stats = self._preview.rebuild(agent, zones=self._zones_box.isChecked())
        self._fill_tree(agent)
        self._update_status(stats)
        self._render()

    def reset_view(self) -> None:
        """Возвращает камеру к обзору агента целиком."""
        if self._agent is not None:
            self._camera = initial_camera(self._agent)
        self._render()

    def set_zones(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self._zones_box.setChecked(bool(enabled))
        if self._preview is not None:
            stats = self._preview.set_zones(bool(enabled))
            self._update_status(stats)

    def _fill_tree(self, agent: AgentSection) -> None:
        """Состав агента: звенья, сенсоры, актуаторы и константы."""
        self._tree.clear()
        tree = build_tree(agent)
        links = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Звенья ({len(agent.links)})", f"корень {tree.root or '—'}"])
        for link in agent.links:
            links.addChild(
                QTreeWidgetItem(
                    [link.id, f"{link.type}, {link.mass_kg:g} кг, {_size_text(link.size_m)}"]
                )
            )
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(links)

        sensors = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Сенсоры ({len(agent.sensors)})", ""])
        for sensor in agent.sensors:
            sensors.addChild(
                QTreeWidgetItem(
                    [sensor.id, f"{sensor.type}, {sensor.rate_hz:g} Гц, звено {sensor.link or '—'}"]
                )
            )
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(sensors)

        actuators = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Актуаторы ({len(agent.actuators)})", ""])
        for actuator in agent.actuators:
            actuators.addChild(QTreeWidgetItem([actuator.id, actuator.type]))
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(actuators)

        payload = hw_payload(agent)
        constants = QTreeWidgetItem([f"P_hw ({len(payload)})", "TC-DYN/SEN/CMP/ENE/COM"])
        groups: dict[str, QTreeWidgetItem] = {}
        for item in payload:
            group = str(item["group"])
            node = groups.get(group)
            if node is None:
                node = QTreeWidgetItem([group, ""])
                groups[group] = node
                constants.addChild(node)
            value = item["value"]
            text = " ".join(f"{part:g}" for part in value) if isinstance(value, list) else f"{value:g}"
            node.addChild(QTreeWidgetItem([f"{item['id']} {item['title']}", f"{text} {item['unit']}"]))
        self._tree.addTopLevelItem(constants)
        self._tree.expandToDepth(0)

    def _update_status(self, stats: Any) -> None:
        if self._agent is None:
            self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE)
            self._status_label.setText("в проекте нет агентов")
            return
        issues = check_agent(self._agent)
        errors = sum(1 for item in issues if item.severity == "error")
        parts = [
            f"агент {self._agent.agent_id} ({self._agent.role})",
            f"звеньев {len(self._agent.links)}",
            f"сенсоров {len(self._agent.sensors)}",
            f"актуаторов {len(self._agent.actuators)}",
        ]
        if stats is not None:
            parts.append(f"сборка {stats.build_ms:.0f} мс")
            if stats.collisions:
                parts.append(f"коллизий {len(stats.collisions)}")
        parts.append(f"ошибок {errors}")
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE if errors else "")
        self._status_label.setText(" · ".join(parts))

    # --- экспорт --------------------------------------------------------

    def save_export(self, path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
        """Сохраняет URDF-подобный файл агента."""
        if self._agent is None:
            return False
        target = path
        if target is None:
            suggested = (self._settings.last_dir or Path.cwd()) / f"{self._agent.agent_id}.urdf"
            chosen = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
                self,
                "Экспорт агента",
                str(suggested),
                "URDF-подобный файл (*.urdf *.xml);;Все файлы (*)",
            )
            if not chosen or not chosen[0]:
                return False
            target = Path(chosen[0])
        from simorph.core.agent import write_urdf

        try:
            written = write_urdf(self._agent, target)
        except OSError as exc:  # экспорт не должен ронять окно
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт не выполнен", str(exc))
            return False
        self._settings.last_dir = target.parent
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._status_label.setText(f"экспорт: {written.name}")
        return True

    # --- мышь -----------------------------------------------------------

    def mousePressEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = event.position().toPoint()
        self._mode = "orbit" if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton else "pan"
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        if self._last_mouse is None:
            return
        point = event.position().toPoint()
        delta = point - self._last_mouse
        self._last_mouse = point
        if self._mode == "orbit":
            self._camera.orbit(delta.x() * 0.4, delta.y() * 0.4)
        else:
            self._camera.pan(delta.x(), delta.y())
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self._last_mouse = None
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def wheelEvent(self, event: QWheelEvent) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        steps = event.angleDelta().y() / 120.0
        self._camera.zoom(0.85**steps)
        self._interacting = True
        self._hold_timer.start()

    def _stop_interaction(self) -> None:
        self._interacting = False

    # --- жизненный цикл -------------------------------------------------

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает таймеры и освобождает соединение PyBullet."""
        self._disposed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self._rebuild_timer.stop()
        self._hold_timer.stop()
        if self._preview is not None:
            self._preview.close()

    def closeEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - переопределение Qt
        self.dispose()
        super().closeEvent(event)


def _first_agent(document: ProjectDocument) -> AgentSection | None:
    return document.agents[0] if document.agents else None


def _size_text(size: tuple[float, float, float]) -> str:
    return "×".join(f"{value:g}" for value in size) + " м"


def _paint_placeholder(widget: QWidget, message: str) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt
    """Заглушка для пустого проекта: используется только вручную."""
    painter = QPainter(widget)
    try:
        painter.setPen(QColor("#e5534b"))
        painter.drawText(widget.rect(), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, message)
    finally:
        painter.end()


def _paint_event(widget: QWidget, event: QPaintEvent) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - Qt
    """Совместимость с Qt: фактическая отрисовка — в ``_Canvas``."""
    widget.paintEvent(event)  # type: ignore[misc]

1: """Публикация данных сенсоров девяти типов (T5-02, FR-AGT-03, FR-AGT-06).
2: 
3: Этап 5 не запускает физику: сенсоры должны доказать, что каждый тип
4: создаётся и даёт данные, а не подменять собой этап 7. Поэтому здесь
5: детерминированный источник показаний: значения зависят от seed агента,
6: идентификатора сенсора и времени, но не от случайного состояния процесса.
7: 
8: Камеры отдают маленькие кадры-отпечатки (8×5): полноразмерный кадр
9: появляется на этапе 7, когда сцена и физика уже есть. Форма ответа при
10: этом не меняется — кадр, метки времени и GT-глубина на месте.
11: """
12: 
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: import math
16: import random
17: import zlib
18: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
19: from typing import Any
20: 
21: from simorph.core.models.agent import AgentSection, Sensor
22: 
23: __all__ = ["SensorSample", "SensorSuite", "sensor_types", "supported_types"]
24: 
25: #: Размер кадра-отпечатка камеры, px.
26: THUMBNAIL_WIDTH: int = 8
27: THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT: int = 5
28: 
29: #: Широта и долгота полигона по умолчанию (Санкт-Петербург).
30: BASE_LATITUDE: float = 59.93
31: BASE_LONGITUDE: float = 30.31
32: 
33: #: Все девять типов сенсоров TRD 5.5.
34: _ALL_TYPES: tuple[str, ...] = (
35:     "imu9",
36:     "gps",
37:     "stereo_camera",
38:     "camera",
39:     "distance",
40:     "angle",
41:     "angular_rate",
42:     "external_io",
43:     "error_signal",
44: )
45: 
46: 
47: def supported_types() -> tuple[str, ...]:
48:     """Типы, которые умеет публиковать набор."""
49:     return _ALL_TYPES
50: 
51: 
52: def sensor_types(agent: AgentSection) -> set[str]:
53:     """Типы сенсоров, реально присутствующие у агента."""
54:     return {sensor.type for sensor in agent.sensors}
55: 
56: 
57: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
58: class SensorSample:
59:     """Одно показание сенсора."""
60: 
61:     sensor_id: str
62:     type: str
63:     t_ns: int
64:     values: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
65: 
66:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
67:         return {
68:             "sensor_id": self.sensor_id,
69:             "type": self.type,
70:             "t_ns": self.t_ns,
71:             "values": dict(self.values),
72:         }
73: 
74: 
75: class SensorSuite:
76:     """Детерминированная публикация показаний всех сенсоров агента."""
77: 
78:     def __init__(self, agent: AgentSection, *, seed: int = 0) -> None:
79:         self._agent = agent
80:         self._seed = int(seed)
81:         self._sensors = {sensor.id: sensor for sensor in agent.sensors}
82:         self._published = 0
83: 
84:     @property
85:     def sensors(self) -> dict[str, Sensor]:
86:         return dict(self._sensors)
87: 
88:     @property
89:     def published(self) -> int:
90:         """Сколько показаний выдано с момента создания набора."""
91:         return self._published
92: 
93:     def _rng(self, sensor_id: str, time_s: float) -> random.Random:
94:         """Поток случайных чисел, привязанный к сенсору и моменту времени."""
95:         stamp = int(round(max(0.0, float(time_s)) * 1000.0))
96:         return random.Random((self._seed * 1_000_003) ^ zlib.crc32(sensor_id.encode()) ^ stamp)
97: 
98:     def sample(self, time_s: float) -> list[SensorSample]:
99:         """Показания всех сенсоров на момент времени, с."""
100:         samples = [self.sample_one(sensor, time_s) for sensor in self._agent.sensors]
101:         self._published += len(samples)
102:         return samples
103: 
104:     def sample_one(self, sensor: Sensor, time_s: float) -> SensorSample:
105:         """Показание одного сенсора."""
106:         t_ns = int(round(max(0.0, float(time_s)) * 1e9))
107:         rng = self._rng(sensor.id, time_s)
108:         values = self._values(sensor, rng, time_s, t_ns)
109:         values.setdefault("t_fsin_ns", t_ns)
110:         values.setdefault("t_monotonic_ns", t_ns + int(float(sensor.latency_ms or 0.0) * 1e6))
111:         return SensorSample(sensor_id=sensor.id, type=sensor.type, t_ns=t_ns, values=values)
112: 
113:     def _values(
114:         self,
115:         sensor: Sensor,
116:         rng: random.Random,
117:         time_s: float,
118:         t_ns: int,
119:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
120:         noise = float(sensor.noise or 0.0)
121:         bias = float(sensor.bias or 0.0)
122:         phase = math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * min(1.0, float(sensor.rate_hz) / 1000.0) * time_s)
123: 
124:         if sensor.type == "imu9":
125:             roll = 4.0 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise or 0.05) + bias
126:             pitch = 3.0 * math.cos(time_s * 0.7) + rng.gauss(0.0, noise or 0.05)
127:             yaw = (time_s * 12.0) % 360.0
128:             half = math.radians(roll) / 2.0
129:             return {
130:                 "roll_deg": round(roll, 4),
131:                 "pitch_deg": round(pitch, 4),
132:                 "yaw_deg": round(yaw, 4),
133:                 "quaternion": [
134:                     round(math.cos(half), 6),
135:                     round(math.sin(half), 6),
136:                     0.0,
137:                     0.0,
138:                 ],
139:                 "accel_mps2": [
140:                     round(rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
141:                     round(rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
142:                     round(9.80665 + rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
143:                 ],
144:                 "gyro_rad_s": [
145:                     round(0.01 * phase, 5),
146:                     round(0.01 * math.cos(time_s), 5),
147:                     round(0.02 * phase, 5),
148:                 ],
149:                 "polar_center_m": round(1.2 + 0.3 * phase, 4),
150:             }
151: 
152:         if sensor.type == "gps":
153:             accuracy = float(sensor.accuracy_m or 1.5)
154:             return {
155:                 "latitude_deg": round(BASE_LATITUDE + rng.gauss(0.0, accuracy) / 111_320.0, 7),
156:                 "longitude_deg": round(BASE_LONGITUDE + rng.gauss(0.0, accuracy) / 64_000.0, 7),
157:                 "altitude_m": round(12.0 + 0.5 * phase, 3),
158:                 "speed_mps": round(abs(1.2 * phase), 3),
159:                 "fix": True,
160:             }
161: 
162:         if sensor.type == "stereo_camera":
163:             width, height = sensor.resolution or (1280, 800)
164:             return {
165:                 "left": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
166:                 "right": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
167:                 "frames": 2,
168:                 "width": width,
169:                 "height": height,
170:                 "bit_depth": sensor.bit_depth or 8,
171:                 "mode": sensor.mode or "mono",
172:                 "baseline_m": float(sensor.baseline_m or 0.12),
173:                 "fov_deg": float(sensor.fov_deg or 90.0),
174:                 "depth_gt_m": [round(3.0 + 0.4 * phase, 3), round(40.0 + phase, 3)],
175:                 "t_fsin_ns": t_ns,
176:                 "t_monotonic_ns": t_ns,
177:             }
178: 
179:         if sensor.type == "camera":
180:             width, height = sensor.resolution or (2560, 1440)
181:             return {
182:                 "frame": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
183:                 "width": width,
184:                 "height": height,
185:                 "bit_depth": sensor.bit_depth or 8,
186:                 "fov_deg": float(sensor.fov_deg or 90.0),
187:                 "t_fsin_ns": t_ns,
188:                 "t_monotonic_ns": t_ns,
189:             }
190: 
191:         if sensor.type == "distance":
192:             limit = float(sensor.range_m or 30.0)
193:             return {
194:                 "distance_m": round(min(limit, max(0.0, 8.0 + 2.0 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise))), 4),
195:                 "range_m": limit,
196:             }
197: 
198:         if sensor.type == "angle":
199:             low, high = sensor.range_deg or (-180.0, 180.0)
200:             value = min(high, max(low, 15.0 * phase + bias + rng.gauss(0.0, noise)))
201:             return {"angle_deg": round(value, 4), "range_deg": [low, high]}
202: 
203:         if sensor.type == "angular_rate":
204:             low, high = sensor.range_dps or (-500.0, 500.0)
205:             value = min(high, max(low, 30.0 * phase + bias + rng.gauss(0.0, noise)))
206:             return {"rate_dps": round(value, 4), "rate_rad_s": round(math.radians(value), 6)}
207: 
208:         if sensor.type == "external_io":
209:             channels = int(sensor.channels or 1)
210:             analog = sensor.levels == "analog"
211:             values = [
212:                 round(0.5 + 0.5 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise), 4) if analog else rng.randint(0, 1)
213:                 for _ in range(channels)
214:             ]
215:             return {"channels": channels, "levels": sensor.levels or "digital", "values": values}
216: 
217:         # error_signal
218:         active_high = sensor.active_level != "low"
219:         active = (math.sin(time_s) > 0.98) == active_high
220:         return {"active": bool(active), "active_level": sensor.active_level or "high"}
221: 
222: 
223: def _thumbnail(rng: random.Random, width: int, height: int) -> list[list[int]]:
224:     """Кадр-отпечаток: форма настоящего кадра, размер — для тестов и логов."""
225:     return [[rng.randint(0, 255) for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]

1: """Приём команд актуаторами семи типов (T5-03, FR-AGT-04, FR-AGT-07).
2: 
3: Модель актуатора — это не физика, а контракт: команда ограничивается
4: диапазоном, скоростью и инерцией привода, а состояние показывает, что
5: именно применилось. Седьмой этап подставит сюда реальные тела PyBullet;
6: интерфейс команды от этого не изменится.
7: 
8: Все семь типов принимают команду. Для каждого типа своя величина:
9: угол, позиция, набор суставных углов, тяга, скорость, фокус, канал.
10: """
11: 
12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: import math
15: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
16: from typing import Any
17: 
18: from simorph.core.models.agent import Actuator, AgentSection
19: 
20: __all__ = ["ActuatorCommand", "ActuatorController", "ActuatorState", "ActuatorType"]
21: 
22: 
23: ActuatorType = str
24: 
25: 
26: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
27: class ActuatorCommand:
28:     """Команда актуатору: величина и момент времени."""
29: 
30:     actuator_id: str
31:     value: Any
32:     t_s: float = 0.0
33: 
34: 
35: @dataclass(slots=True)
36: class ActuatorState:
37:     """Состояние привода после применения команды."""
38: 
39:     actuator_id: str
40:     type: str
41:     target: Any = None
42:     position: Any = None
43:     velocity: Any = None
44:     saturated: bool = False
45:     accepted: bool = True
46:     message: str = ""
47: 
48:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
49:         return {
50:             "actuator_id": self.actuator_id,
51:             "type": self.type,
52:             "target": self.target,
53:             "position": self.position,
54:             "velocity": self.velocity,
55:             "saturated": self.saturated,
56:             "accepted": self.accepted,
57:             "message": self.message,
58:         }
59: 
60: 
61: class ActuatorController:
62:     """Контроллер команд: ограничения диапазона, скорости и задержки."""
63: 
64:     def __init__(self, agent: AgentSection) -> None:
65:         self._agent = agent
66:         self._actuators = {item.id: item for item in agent.actuators}
67:         self._states: dict[str, ActuatorState] = {
68:             item.id: ActuatorState(actuator_id=item.id, type=item.type, position=_initial(item))
69:             for item in agent.actuators
70:         }
71: 
72:     @property
73:     def actuators(self) -> dict[str, Actuator]:
74:         return dict(self._actuators)
75: 
76:     @property
77:     def states(self) -> dict[str, ActuatorState]:
78:         return dict(self._states)
79: 
80:     def state(self, actuator_id: str) -> ActuatorState:
81:         return self._states[actuator_id]
82: 
83:     def command(
84:         self,
85:         actuator_id: str,
86:         value: Any,
87:         *,
88:         dt_s: float = 0.01,
89:     ) -> ActuatorState:
90:         """Применяет команду и возвращает новое состояние привода.
91: 
92:         Raises:
93:             KeyError: актуатора с таким идентификатором нет у агента.
94:         """
95:         actuator = self._actuators[actuator_id]
96:         state = self._states[actuator_id]
97:         target, saturated = self._clamp(actuator, value)
98:         position = self._approach(actuator, state.position, target, max(1e-6, float(dt_s)))
99:         velocity = _difference(position, state.position, dt_s)
100:         state.target = target
101:         state.position = position
102:         state.velocity = velocity
103:         state.saturated = saturated or not _equal(target, position)
104:         state.accepted = True
105:         state.message = "ограничено диапазоном" if saturated else ""
106:         return state
107: 
108:     def command_many(self, commands: list[ActuatorCommand], *, dt_s: float = 0.01) -> list[ActuatorState]:
109:         """Применяет пачку команд: порядок сохраняется."""
110:         return [self.command(item.actuator_id, item.value, dt_s=dt_s) for item in commands]
111: 
112:     # --- ограничения ------------------------------------------------------
113: 
114:     def _clamp(self, actuator: Actuator, value: Any) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
115:         """Приводит команду к допустимому диапазону."""
116:         if actuator.type == "rotary_axis":
117:             low, high = actuator.range_deg or (-180.0, 180.0)
118:             target = _as_float(value)
119:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
120:         if actuator.type == "prismatic":
121:             low, high = actuator.range_m or (0.0, 1.0)
122:             target = _as_float(value)
123:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
124:         if actuator.type == "linkage":
125:             values = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else [value]
126:             joints = list(actuator.joints or [])
127:             target = [_as_float(item) for item in values]
128:             if joints and len(target) != len(joints):
129:                 target = (target + [0.0] * len(joints))[: len(joints)]
130:             return target, False
131:         if actuator.type == "thrust_vector":
132:             limit = float(actuator.thrust_max_n or 0.0)
133:             target = _as_float(value)
134:             return min(limit, max(0.0, target)), not (0.0 <= target <= limit)
135:         if actuator.type == "drive_axis":
136:             limit = float(actuator.max_speed_rad_s or 0.0)
137:             target = _as_float(value)
138:             return min(limit, max(-limit, target)), abs(target) > limit
139:         if actuator.type == "optical_focus":
140:             low, high = actuator.range_m or (0.0, 10.0)
141:             target = _as_float(value)
142:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
143:         # external_io
144:         analog = actuator.levels == "analog"
145:         target = _as_float(value)
146:         if analog:
147:             return min(1.0, max(0.0, target)), not (0.0 <= target <= 1.0)
148:         discrete = 1.0 if target >= 0.5 else 0.0
149:         return discrete, discrete != target
150: 
151:     def _approach(self, actuator: Actuator, current: Any, target: Any, dt_s: float) -> Any:
152:         """Один шаг привода: задержка первого порядка и ограничение скорости."""
153:         if isinstance(target, list):
154:             current_list = current if isinstance(current, list) else [0.0] * len(target)
155:             return [
156:                 _approach_scalar(float(current_list[index]), float(value), actuator, dt_s)
157:                 for index, value in enumerate(target)
158:             ]

37:     "stereo_camera",

39:     "distance",

77: 
78:     def __init__(self, agent: AgentSection, *, seed: int = 0) -> None:
79:         self._agent = agent

81:         self._sensors = {sensor.id: sensor for sensor in agent.sensors}

96:         return random.Random((self._seed * 1_000_003) ^ zlib.crc32(sensor_id.encode()) ^ stamp)

99:         """Показания всех сенсоров на момент времени, с."""
100:         samples = [self.sample_one(sensor, time_s) for sensor in self._agent.sensors]

104:     def sample_one(self, sensor: Sensor, time_s: float) -> SensorSample:
105:         """Показание одного сенсора."""

113:     def _values(

115:         sensor: Sensor,
116:         rng: random.Random,
117:         time_s: float,
118:         t_ns: int,
119:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
120:         noise = float(sensor.noise or 0.0)
121:         bias = float(sensor.bias or 0.0)
122:         phase = math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * min(1.0, float(sensor.rate_hz) / 1000.0) * time_s)
123: 
124:         if sensor.type == "imu9":
125:             roll = 4.0 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise or 0.05) + bias
126:             pitch = 3.0 * math.cos(time_s * 0.7) + rng.gauss(0.0, noise or 0.05)
127:             yaw = (time_s * 12.0) % 360.0
128:             half = math.radians(roll) / 2.0
129:             return {
130:                 "roll_deg": round(roll, 4),
131:                 "pitch_deg": round(pitch, 4),
132:                 "yaw_deg": round(yaw, 4),
133:                 "quaternion": [

135:                     round(math.sin(half), 6),
136:                     0.0,
137:                     0.0,
138:                 ],
139:                 "accel_mps2": [
140:                     round(rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
141:                     round(rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
142:                     round(9.80665 + rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05), 4),
143:                 ],
144:                 "gyro_rad_s": [
145:                     round(0.01 * phase, 5),
146:                     round(0.01 * math.cos(time_s), 5),
147:                     round(0.02 * phase, 5),
148:                 ],
149:                 "polar_center_m": round(1.2 + 0.3 * phase, 4),
150:             }
151: 
152:         if sensor.type == "gps":
153:             accuracy = float(sensor.accuracy_m or 1.5)
154:             return {
155:                 "latitude_deg": round(BASE_LATITUDE + rng.gauss(0.0, accuracy) / 111_320.0, 7),
156:                 "longitude_deg": round(BASE_LONGITUDE + rng.gauss(0.0, accuracy) / 64_000.0, 7),
157:                 "altitude_m": round(12.0 + 0.5 * phase, 3),
158:                 "speed_mps": round(abs(1.2 * phase), 3),
159:                 "fix": True,
160:             }
161: 
162:         if sensor.type == "stereo_camera":
163:             width, height = sensor.resolution or (1280, 800)
164:             return {
165:                 "left": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
166:                 "right": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
167:                 "frames": 2,
168:                 "width": width,
169:                 "height": height,
170:                 "bit_depth": sensor.bit_depth or 8,
171:                 "mode": sensor.mode or "mono",
172:                 "baseline_m": float(sensor.baseline_m or 0.12),
173:                 "fov_deg": float(sensor.fov_deg or 90.0),
174:                 "depth_gt_m": [round(3.0 + 0.4 * phase, 3), round(40.0 + phase, 3)],
175:                 "t_fsin_ns": t_ns,
176:                 "t_monotonic_ns": t_ns,
177:             }
178: 
179:         if sensor.type == "camera":
180:             width, height = sensor.resolution or (2560, 1440)
181:             return {
182:                 "frame": _thumbnail(rng, THUMBNAIL_WIDTH, THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT),
183:                 "width": width,
184:                 "height": height,
185:                 "bit_depth": sensor.bit_depth or 8,
186:                 "fov_deg": float(sensor.fov_deg or 90.0),
187:                 "t_fsin_ns": t_ns,
188:                 "t_monotonic_ns": t_ns,
189:             }
190: 
191:         if sensor.type == "distance":
192:             limit = float(sensor.range_m or 30.0)
193:             return {
194:                 "distance_m": round(min(limit, max(0.0, 8.0 + 2.0 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise))), 4),
195:                 "range_m": limit,
196:             }
197: 
198:         if sensor.type == "angle":
199:             low, high = sensor.range_deg or (-180.0, 180.0)
200:             value = min(high, max(low, 15.0 * phase + bias + rng.gauss(0.0, noise)))
201:             return {"angle_deg": round(value, 4), "range_deg": [low, high]}
202: 
203:         if sensor.type == "angular_rate":
204:             low, high = sensor.range_dps or (-500.0, 500.0)
205:             value = min(high, max(low, 30.0 * phase + bias + rng.gauss(0.0, noise)))
206:             return {"rate_dps": round(value, 4), "rate_rad_s": round(math.radians(value), 6)}
207: 
208:         if sensor.type == "external_io":
209:             channels = int(sensor.channels or 1)
210:             analog = sensor.levels == "analog"
211:             values = [
212:                 round(0.5 + 0.5 * phase + rng.gauss(0.0, noise), 4) if analog else rng.randint(0, 1)
213:                 for _ in range(channels)
214:             ]
215:             return {"channels": channels, "levels": sensor.levels or "digital", "values": values}
216: 
217:         # error_signal
218:         active_high = sensor.active_level != "low"
219:         active = (math.sin(time_s) > 0.98) == active_high
220:         return {"active": bool(active), "active_level": sensor.active_level or "high"}

223: def _thumbnail(rng: random.Random, width: int, height: int) -> list[list[int]]:
224:     """Кадр-отпечаток: форма настоящего кадра, размер — для тестов и логов."""
225:     return [[rng.randint(0, 255) for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]

66:         self._actuators = {item.id: item for item in agent.actuators}
67:         self._states: dict[str, ActuatorState] = {

81:         return self._states[actuator_id]

96:         state = self._states[actuator_id]
97:         target, saturated = self._clamp(actuator, value)
98:         position = self._approach(actuator, state.position, target, max(1e-6, float(dt_s)))
99:         velocity = _difference(position, state.position, dt_s)

101:         state.position = position
102:         state.velocity = velocity
103:         state.saturated = saturated or not _equal(target, position)
104:         state.accepted = True
105:         state.message = "ограничено диапазоном" if saturated else ""

108:     def command_many(self, commands: list[ActuatorCommand], *, dt_s: float = 0.01) -> list[ActuatorState]:
109:         """Применяет пачку команд: порядок сохраняется."""
110:         return [self.command(item.actuator_id, item.value, dt_s=dt_s) for item in commands]
111: 
112:     # --- ограничения ------------------------------------------------------
113: 
114:     def _clamp(self, actuator: Actuator, value: Any) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
115:         """Приводит команду к допустимому диапазону."""
116:         if actuator.type == "rotary_axis":
117:             low, high = actuator.range_deg or (-180.0, 180.0)
118:             target = _as_float(value)
119:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
120:         if actuator.type == "prismatic":
121:             low, high = actuator.range_m or (0.0, 1.0)
122:             target = _as_float(value)
123:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
124:         if actuator.type == "linkage":
125:             values = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else [value]
126:             joints = list(actuator.joints or [])
127:             target = [_as_float(item) for item in values]
128:             if joints and len(target) != len(joints):
129:                 target = (target + [0.0] * len(joints))[: len(joints)]
130:             return target, False
131:         if actuator.type == "thrust_vector":
132:             limit = float(actuator.thrust_max_n or 0.0)
133:             target = _as_float(value)
134:             return min(limit, max(0.0, target)), not (0.0 <= target <= limit)
135:         if actuator.type == "drive_axis":
136:             limit = float(actuator.max_speed_rad_s or 0.0)
137:             target = _as_float(value)
138:             return min(limit, max(-limit, target)), abs(target) > limit
139:         if actuator.type == "optical_focus":
140:             low, high = actuator.range_m or (0.0, 10.0)
141:             target = _as_float(value)
142:             return min(high, max(low, target)), not (low <= target <= high)
143:         # external_io
144:         analog = actuator.levels == "analog"
145:         target = _as_float(value)
146:         if analog:
147:             return min(1.0, max(0.0, target)), not (0.0 <= target <= 1.0)
148:         discrete = 1.0 if target >= 0.5 else 0.0
149:         return discrete, discrete != target
150: 
151:     def _approach(self, actuator: Actuator, current: Any, target: Any, dt_s: float) -> Any:
152:         """Один шаг привода: задержка первого порядка и ограничение скорости."""
153:         if isinstance(target, list):
154:             current_list = current if isinstance(current, list) else [0.0] * len(target)
155:             return [
156:                 _approach_scalar(float(current_list[index]), float(value), actuator, dt_s)
157:                 for index, value in enumerate(target)
158:             ]
159:         return _approach_scalar(_as_float(current), float(target), actuator, dt_s)
160: 
161: 
162: def _approach_scalar(current: float, target: float, actuator: Actuator, dt_s: float) -> float:
163:     """Инерция привода: доля шага и предел скорости."""
164:     response = max(0.0, float(actuator.response_ms or 0.0)) / 1000.0
165:     alpha = 1.0 if response <= 0.0 else min(1.0, dt_s / (response + dt_s))
166:     step = (target - current) * alpha
167:     limit = _speed_limit(actuator)
168:     if limit is not None:
169:         max_step = limit * dt_s
170:         step = min(max_step, max(-max_step, step))
171:     return current + step
172: 
173: 
174: def _speed_limit(actuator: Actuator) -> float | None:
175:     """Предел изменения величины за секунду в единицах команды."""
176:     if actuator.type == "rotary_axis":
177:         if actuator.max_speed_dps is not None:
178:             return float(actuator.max_speed_dps)
179:         if actuator.max_speed_rad_s is not None:
180:             return math.degrees(float(actuator.max_speed_rad_s))
181:     if actuator.type in {"prismatic", "optical_focus"}:
182:         return None if actuator.max_speed_mps is None else float(actuator.max_speed_mps)
183:     if actuator.type == "drive_axis":
184:         return None if actuator.max_speed_rad_s is None else float(actuator.max_speed_rad_s)
185:     if actuator.type == "thrust_vector":
186:         return None if actuator.max_force_n is None else float(actuator.max_force_n)
187:     return None
188: 
189: 
190: def _initial(actuator: Actuator) -> Any:
191:     if actuator.type == "linkage":
192:         return [0.0 for _ in (actuator.joints or [])]
193:     if actuator.type == "thrust_vector":
194:         return 0.0
195:     return 0.0
196: 
197: 
198: def _difference(current: Any, previous: Any, dt_s: float) -> Any:
199:     if isinstance(current, list) and isinstance(previous, list):
200:         return [
201:             round((float(value) - float(previous[index])) / dt_s, 6)
202:             for index, value in enumerate(current)
203:         ]
204:     return round((_as_float(current) - _as_float(previous)) / dt_s, 6)
205: 
206: 
207: def _equal(left: Any, right: Any) -> bool:
208:     if isinstance(left, list) and isinstance(right, list):
209:         return len(left) == len(right) and all(
210:             abs(float(a) - float(b)) < 1e-9 for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=False)
211:         )
212:     return abs(_as_float(left) - _as_float(right)) < 1e-9
213: 
214: 
215: def _as_float(value: Any) -> float:
216:     if isinstance(value, bool):
217:         return 1.0 if value else 0.0
218:     try:
219:         return float(value)
220:     except (TypeError, ValueError):
221:         return 0.0

2: 
3: Проверки отвечают на вопрос «можно ли запускать этого агента», а не
4: «правильно ли заполнена схема»: схема уже не даст нулевую массу или
5: отрицательный бюджет. Здесь ловятся несогласованности между разделами:

363: def _of_type(actuators: list[Actuator], kind: str) -> list[Actuator]:

367: def thrust_margin(agent: AgentSection) -> float:
368:     """Отношение суммарной тяги к весу: 1.0 — ровно вес."""
369:     tree = build_tree(agent)

6: тяга против веса, инерция, бюджеты CPU/GPU, энергия и канал связи.
7: 
8: Каждая проверка возвращает замечания с путём к полю, поэтому интерфейс
9: открывает ровно тот параметр, который надо исправить. Ошибка блокирует
10: запуск, предупреждение — нет.
11: """

42: def sensor_data_rate_mbps(sensor: Sensor) -> float:

36: def _length(value: Vec3) -> float:

40: def link_volume(link: Link) -> float:
41:     """Объём звена, м³: нужен для оценки плотности и инерции."""
42:     x, y, z = (max(0.0, value) for value in link.size_m)
43:     if link.type == "sphere":
44:         radius = x / 2.0
45:         return 4.0 / 3.0 * math.pi * radius**3
46:     if link.type == "cylinder":
47:         radius = x / 2.0
48:         return math.pi * radius**2 * z
49:     return x * y * z

52: def link_inertia(link: Link) -> Vec3:
53:     """Главные моменты инерции звена относительно его центра, кг·м²."""
54:     x, y, z = (max(0.0, value) for value in link.size_m)
55:     mass = float(link.mass_kg)
56:     if link.type == "sphere":
57:         radius = x / 2.0
58:         value = 0.4 * mass * radius**2
59:         return (value, value, value)
60:     if link.type == "cylinder":
61:         radius = x / 2.0
62:         axial = 0.5 * mass * radius**2
63:         radial = mass / 12.0 * (3.0 * radius**2 + z**2)

65:     return (

132:                 total[index] += pose[index] * float(link.mass_kg)

182: def build_tree(agent: AgentSection) -> KinematicTree:
183:     """Собирает дерево звеньев и суставов, накапливая ошибки иерархии."""
184:     tree = KinematicTree(links={link.id: link for link in agent.links}, joints=list(agent.joints))
185:     for joint in agent.joints:
186:         if joint.parent == joint.child:
187:             tree.errors.append(f"сустав {joint.id!r} связывает звено {joint.parent!r} само с собой")
188:             continue
189:         if joint.parent not in tree.links:
190:             tree.errors.append(f"сустав {joint.id!r}: родитель {joint.parent!r} не найден")
191:             continue
192:         if joint.child not in tree.links:
193:             tree.errors.append(f"сустав {joint.id!r}: потомок {joint.child!r} не найден")
194:             continue
195:         if joint.child in tree.parents:
196:             tree.errors.append(
197:                 f"у звена {joint.child!r} два родителя:"
198:                 f" {tree.parents[joint.child]!r} и {joint.parent!r}"
199:             )
200:             continue
201:         tree.parents[joint.child] = joint.parent
202:         tree.children.setdefault(joint.parent, []).append(joint.child)
203: 
204:     roots = [link_id for link_id in tree.links if link_id not in tree.parents]
205:     if not tree.links:
206:         tree.errors.append("у агента нет звеньев")
207:     elif len(roots) > 1:
208:         tree.errors.append(
209:             "у агента несколько корней: " + ", ".join(sorted(roots)) + " (ожидался один)"
210:         )
211:     elif not roots:
212:         tree.errors.append("в иерархии звеньев есть цикл: корень не найден")
213:     else:
214:         tree.root = roots[0]
215: 
216:     tree.order = _traverse(tree, roots[0] if len(roots) == 1 else None)
217:     if tree.root is not None and len(tree.order) != len(tree.links):
218:         missing = sorted(set(tree.links) - set(tree.order))
219:         tree.errors.append("звенья недостижимы от корня: " + ", ".join(missing))
220:     return tree

222: 
223: def _traverse(tree: KinematicTree, root: str | None) -> list[str]:
224:     """Обход в глубину с защитой от цикла: порядок детерминирован."""
225:     if root is None:
226:         return []
227:     order: list[str] = []
228:     seen: set[str] = set()
229:     stack = [root]
230:     while stack:
231:         current = stack.pop()
232:         if current in seen:
233:             continue
234:         seen.add(current)
235:         order.append(current)
236:         for child in reversed(tree.children.get(current, [])):
237:             if child not in seen:
238:                 stack.append(child)
239:     return order
