1: """Сцена мира: сборка, сброс, кадры и ground truth (T4-01…T4-09).
2: 
3: ``Scene`` связывает раскладку, рендер и погоду. Правила этапа:
4: 
5: - сборка не бросает исключений наружу: сбой помечает сцену ``interrupted``,
6:   и приложение продолжает работать (G4-07);
7: - ``reset`` пересобирает раскладку из того же seed и профиля, поэтому
8:   повторный сброс даёт идентичную сцену (G4-06);
9: - фотореализм и колебания влияют только на предпросмотр, а ground truth
10:   снимается с сенсорной позы без вибрации (G4-04);
11: - лимит объектов проверяется в раскладке, сцена строится и при превышении.
12: 
13: Сцена — не глобальный объект: её создаёт интерфейс или CLI, а закрывает
14: владелец. Соединение PyBullet живёт внутри рендера и освобождается
15: в ``close``.
16: """
17: 
18: from __future__ import annotations
19: 
20: import time
21: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
22: from pathlib import Path
23: from typing import Any, Literal
24: 
25: from simorph.core.issues import IssueCode, Severity, issue
26: from simorph.core.models.profile import ProfileSection
27: from simorph.core.models.world import WorldSection
28: from simorph.core.world.camera import CameraPose, CameraSpec, OrbitCamera
29: from simorph.core.world.ground_truth import GroundTruth, bbox_corners
30: from simorph.core.world.layout import MAX_OBJECTS, SceneLayout, build_layout
31: from simorph.core.world.lighting import SunState, lighting_for_hour, sun_state
32: from simorph.core.world.renderer import BulletRenderer, Frame
33: from simorph.core.world.snapshot import save_snapshot
34: from simorph.core.world.weather import Precipitation, WeatherState, weather_state
35: 
36: __all__ = ["Scene", "SceneStats", "SceneStatus"]
37: 
38: #: Состояние сцены: готова или прервана сбоем.
39: SceneStatus = Literal["ready", "interrupted"]
40: 
41: 
42: @dataclass(slots=True)
43: class SceneStats:
44:     """Статистика сцены для интерфейса, CLI и журнала."""
45: 
46:     objects: int = 0
47:     bodies: int = 0
48:     by_category: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
49:     limit: int = MAX_OBJECTS
50:     truncated: int = 0
51:     warnings: int = 0
52:     build_seconds: float = 0.0
53:     status: SceneStatus = "ready"
54:     error: str | None = None
55: 
56:     @property
57:     def over_limit(self) -> bool:
58:         return self.truncated > 0
59: 
60:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
61:         return {
62:             "status": self.status,
63:             "error": self.error,
64:             "objects": self.objects,
65:             "bodies": self.bodies,
66:             "by_category": dict(self.by_category),
67:             "limit": self.limit,
68:             "truncated": self.truncated,
69:             "warnings": self.warnings,
70:             "build_seconds": round(self.build_seconds, 4),
71:         }
72: 
73: 
74: class Scene:
75:     """Сцена мира: раскладка, тела PyBullet, свет и погода."""
76: 
77:     def __init__(
78:         self,
79:         world: WorldSection,
80:         profile: ProfileSection | None = None,
81:         *,
82:         limit: int = MAX_OBJECTS,
83:         renderer: BulletRenderer | None = None,
84:         layout: SceneLayout | None = None,
85:     ) -> None:
86:         self._world = world
87:         self._profile = profile
88:         self._limit = limit
89:         self._renderer = renderer if renderer is not None else BulletRenderer()
90:         self._owns_renderer = renderer is None
91:         self._layout = layout
92:         self._status: SceneStatus = "ready"
93:         self._error: str | None = None
94:         self._build_seconds = 0.0
95:         self._realism = True
96:         self._vibrations = True
97:         self._hour: float | None = None
98:         self._sun = sun_state(world.lighting)
99:         self._weather = weather_state(world, vibrations=True)
100:         self._time = 0.0
101: 
102:     # --- сборка ---------------------------------------------------------
103: 
104:     def build(self) -> SceneStats:
105:         """Строит тела сцены; сбой не выходит наружу."""
106:         started = time.perf_counter()
107:         self._status = "ready"
108:         self._error = None
109:         if self._layout is None:
110:             self._layout = build_layout(self._world, self._profile, limit=self._limit)
111:         try:
112:             self._renderer.clear()
113:             failures: list[str] = []
114:             for item in self._layout.objects:
115:                 try:
116:                     self._renderer.add_object(item)
117:                 except Exception as exc:  # один объект не должен срывать сцену
118:                     failures.append(f"{item.id}: {exc}")
119:             self._renderer.set_lighting(self._sun, realism=self._realism)
120:         except Exception as exc:  # сцена не должна ронять приложение (G4-07)
121:             self._status = "interrupted"
122:             self._error = str(exc)
123:         else:
124:             if failures and self._renderer.body_count == 0:
125:                 self._status = "interrupted"
126:                 self._error = failures[0]
127:             elif failures:
128:                 for text in failures[:5]:
129:                     self._layout.warnings.append(
130:                         issue(
131:                             IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
132:                             "world",
133:                             f"объект не построен ({text})",
134:                             severity=Severity.WARNING,
135:                         )
136:                     )
137:         self._build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
138:         return self.stats
139: 
140:     def rebuild(self, world: WorldSection, profile: ProfileSection | None = None) -> SceneStats:
141:         """Пересобирает сцену под новый документ (правка проекта в UI)."""
142:         self._world = world
143:         self._profile = profile
144:         self._layout = None
145:         self._hour = None
146:         self._sun = sun_state(world.lighting)
147:         self._weather = weather_state(world, vibrations=self._vibrations)
148:         return self.build()
149: 
150:     def reset(self) -> SceneStats:
151:         """Сбрасывает сцену к seed: раскладка строится заново."""
152:         self._layout = None
153:         self._time = 0.0
154:         return self.build()
155: 
156:     # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------
157: 
158:     @property
159:     def layout(self) -> SceneLayout:
160:         if self._layout is None:
161:             self._layout = build_layout(self._world, self._profile, limit=self._limit)
162:         return self._layout
163: 
164:     @property
165:     def stats(self) -> SceneStats:
166:         layout = self.layout
167:         return SceneStats(
168:             objects=len(layout.objects),
169:             bodies=self._renderer.body_count,
170:             by_category=layout.stats(),
171:             limit=layout.limit,
172:             truncated=layout.truncated,
173:             warnings=len(layout.warnings),
174:             build_seconds=self._build_seconds,
175:             status=self._status,
176:             error=self._error,
177:         )
178: 
179:     @property
180:     def status(self) -> SceneStatus:
181:         return self._status
182: 
183:     @property
184:     def interrupted(self) -> bool:
185:         return self._status == "interrupted"
186: 
187:     @property
188:     def error(self) -> str | None:
189:         return self._error
190: 
191:     @property
192:     def sun(self) -> SunState:
193:         return self._sun
194: 
195:     @property
196:     def weather(self) -> WeatherState:
197:         return self._weather
198: 
199:     @property
200:     def realism(self) -> bool:
201:         return self._realism
202: 
203:     # --- переключатели --------------------------------------------------
204: 
205:     def set_realism(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
206:         """Фотореализм: яркость и оттенок материалов; GT не меняется."""
207:         self._realism = bool(enabled)
208:         if not self.interrupted:
209:             self._renderer.set_lighting(self._sun, realism=self._realism)
210: 
211:     def set_vibrations(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
212:         """Колебания камеры предпросмотра; сенсор и GT не затрагиваются."""
213:         self._vibrations = bool(enabled)
214:         self._weather = weather_state(
215:             self._world,
216:             precipitation=self._weather.precipitation,
217:             vibrations=self._vibrations,
218:         )
219: 
220:     def set_precipitation(self, kind: Precipitation) -> None:
221:         """Вид осадков: визуальный слой поверх кадра."""
222:         self._weather = weather_state(
223:             self._world,
224:             precipitation=kind,

226:         )

228:     def set_hour(self, hour: float | None) -> None:

233:         else:

236:             )

239:

242:         self._time += max(0.0, float(dt))

244:     @property

248:     # --- кадры ----------------------------------------------------------

250:     def preview_pose(self, camera: OrbitCamera) -> CameraPose:
251:         """Поза предпросмотра с колебаниями среды."""
252:         pose = camera.pose()
253:         offset = self._weather.vibration(self._time)
254:         if offset == (0.0, 0.0, 0.0):
255:             return pose
256:         return pose.translated(offset)
257: 
258:     def render(
259:         self,
260:         camera: OrbitCamera,
261:         spec: CameraSpec | None = None,
262:         *,
263:         vibrations: bool = True,
264:     ) -> Frame:
265:         """Кадр предпросмотра."""
266:         target_spec = spec if spec is not None else camera.spec()
267:         pose = self.preview_pose(camera) if vibrations else camera.pose()
268:         return self._renderer.render(pose, target_spec)
269: 
270:     def render_pose(self, pose: CameraPose, spec: CameraSpec) -> Frame:
271:         """Кадр с сенсорной позы: без вибрации, для ground truth."""
272:         return self._renderer.render(pose, spec)
273: 
274:     def render_stereo(self, pose: CameraPose, spec: CameraSpec) -> tuple[Frame, Frame]:
275:         return self._renderer.render_stereo(pose, spec)
276: 
277:     def ground_truth(self, pose: CameraPose, spec: CameraSpec) -> GroundTruth:
278:         """Истина: глубина и маски из кадра, позы и точки — из раскладки."""
279:         frame = self._renderer.render(pose, spec)
280:         poses = {item.id: item.pose for item in self.layout.objects}
281:         keypoints = {
282:             item.id: bbox_corners(item)
283:             for item in self.layout.objects
284:             if item.category not in {"terrain", "zone"}
285:         }
286:         return GroundTruth(
287:             depth=frame.depth,
288:             mask=frame.mask,
289:             labels=dict(frame.body_labels),
290:             poses=poses,
291:             keypoints=keypoints,
292:             spec=spec,
293:         )
294: 
295:     # --- снимок ---------------------------------------------------------
296: 
297:     def snapshot(
298:         self,
299:         path: Path,
300:         camera: OrbitCamera,
301:         spec: CameraSpec | None = None,
302:     ) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
303:         """Сохраняет кадр и JSON с камерой и статистикой."""
304:         target_spec = spec if spec is not None else camera.spec()
305:         frame = self.render(camera, target_spec)
306:         meta = {
307:             "world_id": self._world.world_id,
308:             "seed": self._world.seed,
309:             "camera": camera.to_dict(),
310:             "pose": self.preview_pose(camera).to_dict(),
311:             "sensor": target_spec.to_dict(),
312:             "sun": {
313:                 "azimuth_deg": self._sun.azimuth_deg,
314:                 "elevation_deg": self._sun.elevation_deg,
315:                 "phase": self._sun.phase,
316:             },
317:             "weather": self._weather.to_dict(),
318:             "scene": self.stats.to_dict(),
319:             "depth_min": round(frame.depth_range()[0], 3),
320:             "depth_max": round(frame.depth_range()[1], 3),
321:         }
322:         return save_snapshot(path, frame.rgb, meta)
323: 
324:     # --- жизненный цикл -------------------------------------------------
325: 
326:     def close(self) -> None:
327:         """Освобождает соединение PyBullet, если сцена его создала."""
328:         if self._owns_renderer:
329:             self._renderer.close()

332:         return self

4: берётся из монотонных часов и не убывает: даже если системные часы

6: событие можно было привязать к кадру и к элементу миссии.
7: 
8: События копятся в памяти и сразу пишутся в артефакты прогона, поэтому
9: после аварийного завершения журнал остаётся читаемым.
10: """

12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: import time
15: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
16: from enum import StrEnum
17: from typing import Any
18: 
19: __all__ = ["EventKind", "EventStream", "SimEvent"]
20: 
21: 
22: class EventKind(StrEnum):
23:     """Виды событий супервизора и симуляции."""
24: 
25:     RUN_STARTED = "run_started"
26:     RUN_FINISHED = "run_finished"
27:     RUN_INTERRUPTED = "run_interrupted"
28:     STATE_CHANGED = "state_changed"
29:     ELEMENT_CHANGED = "element_changed"
30:     TRANSACTION_STARTED = "transaction_started"
31:     TRANSACTION_FINISHED = "transaction_finished"
32:     FRAME_PUSHED = "frame_pushed"
33:     FRAME_CONSUMED = "frame_consumed"
34:     FRAME_DROPPED = "frame_dropped"
35:     DEGRADATION = "degradation"
36:     ERROR = "error"
37: 
38: 
39: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
40: class SimEvent:
41:     """Одно событие потока."""
42: 
43:     seq: int
44:     kind: EventKind
45:     t_monotonic_ns: int
46:     t_scene_ns: int
47:     message: str = ""
48:     data: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
49: 
50:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
51:         return {
52:             "seq": self.seq,
53:             "kind": str(self.kind),
54:             "t_monotonic_ns": self.t_monotonic_ns,
55:             "t_scene_ns": self.t_scene_ns,
56:             "message": self.message,
57:             "data": dict(self.data),
58:         }
59: 
60: 
61: class EventStream:
62:     """Упорядоченный поток событий с монотонными метками времени."""
63: 
64:     def __init__(self, *, clock_ns: Any = None) -> None:
65:         self._events: list[SimEvent] = []
66:         self._clock_ns = clock_ns if clock_ns is not None else time.perf_counter_ns
67:         self._last_ns = 0
68: 
69:     # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------
70: 
71:     @property
72:     def events(self) -> list[SimEvent]:
73:         return list(self._events)
74: 
75:     @property
76:     def last(self) -> SimEvent | None:
77:         return self._events[-1] if self._events else None
78: 
79:     def __len__(self) -> int:
80:         return len(self._events)
81: 
82:     def by_kind(self, kind: EventKind) -> list[SimEvent]:
83:         return [item for item in self._events if item.kind is kind]
84: 
85:     def kinds(self) -> set[EventKind]:
86:         return {item.kind for item in self._events}
87: 
88:     # --- запись ---------------------------------------------------------
89: 
90:     def emit(
91:         self,
92:         kind: EventKind,
93:         message: str = "",
94:         *,
95:         t_scene_ns: int = 0,
96:         **data: Any,
97:     ) -> SimEvent:
98:         """Добавляет событие; метка PC не убывает."""
99:         now = int(self._clock_ns())
100:         stamp = max(now, self._last_ns)
101:         self._last_ns = stamp
102:         event = SimEvent(
103:             seq=len(self._events),
104:             kind=kind,
105:             t_monotonic_ns=stamp,
106:             t_scene_ns=int(t_scene_ns),
107:             message=message,
108:             data=dict(data),
109:         )
110:         self._events.append(event)
111:         return event
112: 
113:     def clear(self) -> None:
114:         self._events.clear()
115:         self._last_ns = 0
116: 
117:     # --- отчёт ----------------------------------------------------------
118: 
119:     def to_payload(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
120:         return [item.to_dict() for item in self._events]
121: 
122:     def ordered(self) -> bool:
123:         """Метки PC не убывают, метки сцены не убывают."""
124:         previous = (-1, -1)
125:         for item in self._events:
126:             current = (item.t_monotonic_ns, item.t_scene_ns)
127:             if current[0] < previous[0] or current[1] < previous[1]:
128:                 return False
129:             previous = current
130:         return True

1: """Сцена мира: сборка, сброс, кадры и ground truth (T4-01…T4-09).
2: 
3: ``Scene`` связывает раскладку, рендер и погоду. Правила этапа:
4: 
5: - сборка не бросает исключений наружу: сбой помечает сцену ``interrupted``,
6:   и приложение продолжает работать (G4-07);
7: - ``reset`` пересобирает раскладку из того же seed и профиля, поэтому
8:   повторный сброс даёт идентичную сцену (G4-06);
9: - фотореализм и колебания влияют только на предпросмотр, а ground truth
10:   снимается с сенсорной позы без вибрации (G4-04);
11: - лимит объектов проверяется в раскладке, сцена строится и при превышении.
12: 
13: Сцена — не глобальный объект: её создаёт интерфейс или CLI, а закрывает
14: владелец. Соединение PyBullet живёт внутри рендера и освобождается
15: в ``close``.
16: """
17: 
18: from __future__ import annotations
19: 
20: import time
21: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
22: from pathlib import Path
23: from typing import Any, Literal
24: 
25: from simorph.core.issues import IssueCode, Severity, issue
26: from simorph.core.models.profile import ProfileSection
27: from simorph.core.models.world import WorldSection
28: from simorph.core.world.camera import CameraPose, CameraSpec, OrbitCamera
29: from simorph.core.world.ground_truth import GroundTruth, bbox_corners
30: from simorph.core.world.layout import MAX_OBJECTS, SceneLayout, build_layout
31: from simorph.core.world.lighting import SunState, lighting_for_hour, sun_state
32: from simorph.core.world.renderer import BulletRenderer, Frame
33: from simorph.core.world.snapshot import save_snapshot
34: from simorph.core.world.weather import Precipitation, WeatherState, weather_state
35: 
36: __all__ = ["Scene", "SceneStats", "SceneStatus"]
37: 
38: #: Состояние сцены: готова или прервана сбоем.
39: SceneStatus = Literal["ready", "interrupted"]
40: 
41: 
42: @dataclass(slots=True)
43: class SceneStats:
44:     """Статистика сцены для интерфейса, CLI и журнала."""
45: 
46:     objects: int = 0
47:     bodies: int = 0
48:     by_category: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
49:     limit: int = MAX_OBJECTS
50:     truncated: int = 0
51:     warnings: int = 0
52:     build_seconds: float = 0.0
53:     status: SceneStatus = "ready"
54:     error: str | None = None
55: 
56:     @property
57:     def over_limit(self) -> bool:
58:         return self.truncated > 0
59: 
60:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
61:         return {
62:             "status": self.status,
63:             "error": self.error,
64:             "objects": self.objects,
65:             "bodies": self.bodies,
66:             "by_category": dict(self.by_category),
67:             "limit": self.limit,
68:             "truncated": self.truncated,
69:             "warnings": self.warnings,
70:             "build_seconds": round(self.build_seconds, 4),
71:         }
72: 
73: 
74: class Scene:
75:     """Сцена мира: раскладка, тела PyBullet, свет и погода."""
76: 
77:     def __init__(
78:         self,
79:         world: WorldSection,
80:         profile: ProfileSection | None = None,
81:         *,
82:         limit: int = MAX_OBJECTS,
83:         renderer: BulletRenderer | None = None,
84:         layout: SceneLayout | None = None,
85:     ) -> None:
86:         self._world = world
87:         self._profile = profile
88:         self._limit = limit
89:         self._renderer = renderer if renderer is not None else BulletRenderer()
90:         self._owns_renderer = renderer is None
91:         self._layout = layout
92:         self._status: SceneStatus = "ready"
93:         self._error: str | None = None
94:         self._build_seconds = 0.0
95:         self._realism = True
96:         self._vibrations = True
97:         self._hour: float | None = None
98:         self._sun = sun_state(world.lighting)
99:         self._weather = weather_state(world, vibrations=True)
100:         self._time = 0.0
101: 
102:     # --- сборка ---------------------------------------------------------
103: 
104:     def build(self) -> SceneStats:
105:         """Строит тела сцены; сбой не выходит наружу."""
106:         started = time.perf_counter()
107:         self._status = "ready"
108:         self._error = None
109:         if self._layout is None:
110:             self._layout = build_layout(self._world, self._profile, limit=self._limit)
111:         try:
112:             self._renderer.clear()
113:             failures: list[str] = []
114:             for item in self._layout.objects:
115:                 try:
116:                     self._renderer.add_object(item)
117:                 except Exception as exc:  # один объект не должен срывать сцену
118:                     failures.append(f"{item.id}: {exc}")
119:             self._renderer.set_lighting(self._sun, realism=self._realism)
120:         except Exception as exc:  # сцена не должна ронять приложение (G4-07)
121:             self._status = "interrupted"
122:             self._error = str(exc)
123:         else:
124:             if failures and self._renderer.body_count == 0:
125:                 self._status = "interrupted"
126:                 self._error = failures[0]
127:             elif failures:
128:                 for text in failures[:5]:
129:                     self._layout.warnings.append(
130:                         issue(
131:                             IssueCode.INVALID_VALUE,
132:                             "world",
133:                             f"объект не построен ({text})",
134:                             severity=Severity.WARNING,
135:                         )
136:                     )
137:         self._build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
138:         return self.stats
139: 
140:     def rebuild(self, world: WorldSection, profile: ProfileSection | None = None) -> SceneStats:
141:         """Пересобирает сцену под новый документ (правка проекта в UI)."""
142:         self._world = world
143:         self._profile = profile
144:         self._layout = None
145:         self._hour = None
146:         self._sun = sun_state(world.lighting)
147:         self._weather = weather_state(world, vibrations=self._vibrations)
148:         return self.build()
149: 
150:     def reset(self) -> SceneStats:
151:         """Сбрасывает сцену к seed: раскладка строится заново."""
152:         self._layout = None
153:         self._time = 0.0
154:         return self.build()
155: 
156:     # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------
157: 
158:     @property
159:     def layout(self) -> SceneLayout:
160:         if self._layout is None:
161:             self._layout = build_layout(self._world, self._profile, limit=self._limit)
162:         return self._layout
163: 
164:     @property
165:     def stats(self) -> SceneStats:
166:         layout = self.layout
167:         return SceneStats(
168:             objects=len(layout.objects),
169:             bodies=self._renderer.body_count,
170:             by_category=layout.stats(),
171:             limit=layout.limit,
172:             truncated=layout.truncated,
173:             warnings=len(layout.warnings),
174:             build_seconds=self._build_seconds,
175:             status=self._status,
176:             error=self._error,
177:         )
178: 
179:     @property
180:     def status(self) -> SceneStatus:
181:         return self._status
182: 
183:     @property
184:     def interrupted(self) -> bool:
185:         return self._status == "interrupted"
186: 
187:     @property
188:     def error(self) -> str | None:
189:         return self._error
190: 
191:     @property
192:     def sun(self) -> SunState:
193:         return self._sun
194: 
195:     @property
196:     def weather(self) -> WeatherState:
197:         return self._weather
198: 
199:     @property
200:     def realism(self) -> bool:

1: """Сцена мира: сборка, сброс, кадры и ground truth (T4-01…T4-09).
2: 
3: ``Scene`` связывает раскладку, рендер и погоду. Правила этапа:
4: 
5: - сборка не бросает исключений наружу: сбой помечает сцену ``interrupted``,
6:   и приложение продолжает работать (G4-07);
7: - ``reset`` пересобирает раскладку из того же seed и профиля, поэтому
8:   повторный сброс даёт идентичную сцену (G4-06);
9: - фотореализм и колебания влияют только на предпросмотр, а ground truth
10:   снимается с сенсорной позы без вибрации (G4-04);
11: - лимит объектов проверяется в раскладке, сцена строится и при превышении.
12: 
13: Сцена — не глобальный объект: её создаёт интерфейс или CLI, а закрывает
14: владелец. Соединение PyBullet живёт внутри рендера и освобождается

1: """Камеры сцены: сенсор и орбитальный обзор (T4-05, T4-07, FR-WLD-02).
2: 
3: ``CameraSpec`` описывает сенсор: разрешение, поле зрения, ближнюю и дальнюю
4: плоскости, режим стереопары. ``CameraPose`` — положение и направление
5: взгляда. ``OrbitCamera`` — модель управления обзором: орбита, панорамирование
6: и зум вокруг цели.
7: 
8: Математика камеры не зависит от PyBullet: те же функции считают проекцию
9: ключевых точек для ground truth, поэтому проверка глубины не требует
10: второго источника истины.
11: """
12: 
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: import math
16: from dataclasses import dataclass
17: from typing import Any, ClassVar, Literal
18: 
19: __all__ = [
20:     "CameraPose",
21:     "CameraSpec",
22:     "OrbitCamera",
23:     "Vec3",
24:     "stereo_offset",
25: ]
26: 
27: Vec3 = tuple[float, float, float]
28: 
29: #: Режим камеры.
30: CameraMode = Literal["mono", "stereo"]
31: 
32: 
33: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
34: class CameraSpec:
35:     """Параметры сенсора."""
36: 
37:     width: int = 640
38:     height: int = 480
39:     fov_deg: float = 60.0
40:     near: float = 0.1
41:     far: float = 1000.0
42:     mode: CameraMode = "mono"
43:     baseline_m: float = 0.12
44: 
45:     @property
46:     def aspect(self) -> float:
47:         return self.width / max(1, self.height)
48: 
49:     def scaled(self, width: int, height: int) -> CameraSpec:
50:         """Тот же сенсор с другим разрешением (для быстрого предпросмотра)."""
51:         return CameraSpec(
52:             width=max(16, int(width)),
53:             height=max(16, int(height)),
54:             fov_deg=self.fov_deg,
55:             near=self.near,
56:             far=self.far,
57:             mode=self.mode,
58:             baseline_m=self.baseline_m,
59:         )
60: 
61:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
62:         return {
63:             "width": self.width,
64:             "height": self.height,
65:             "fov_deg": self.fov_deg,
66:             "near": self.near,
67:             "far": self.far,
68:             "mode": self.mode,
69:             "baseline_m": self.baseline_m,
70:         }
71: 
72: 
73: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
74: class CameraPose:
75:     """Положение камеры: точка, цель и направление «вверх»."""
76: 
77:     eye: Vec3
78:     target: Vec3
79:     up: Vec3 = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
80: 
81:     @property
82:     def forward(self) -> Vec3:
83:         return _normalize(_sub(self.target, self.eye))
84: 
85:     @property
86:     def right(self) -> Vec3:
87:         return _normalize(_cross(self.forward, self.up))
88: 
89:     @property
90:     def up_vector(self) -> Vec3:
91:         return _cross(self.right, self.forward)
92: 
93:     def translated(self, offset: Vec3) -> CameraPose:
94:         return CameraPose(
95:             eye=_add(self.eye, offset),
96:             target=_add(self.target, offset),
97:             up=self.up,
98:         )
99: 
100:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
101:         return {"eye": list(self.eye), "target": list(self.target), "up": list(self.up)}
102: 
103: 
104: @dataclass(slots=True)
105: class OrbitCamera:
106:     """Орбитальный обзор сцены."""
107: 
108:     target: Vec3 = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
109:     distance: float = 220.0
110:     yaw_deg: float = 45.0
111:     pitch_deg: float = -35.0
112:     fov_deg: float = 60.0
113: 
114:     #: Минимальная и максимальная дистанция, м.
115:     MIN_DISTANCE: ClassVar[float] = 2.0
116:     MAX_DISTANCE: ClassVar[float] = 5000.0
117: 
118:     def pose(self) -> CameraPose:
119:         """Положение камеры по текущим углам."""
120:         yaw = math.radians(self.yaw_deg)
121:         pitch = math.radians(self.pitch_deg)
122:         forward = (
123:             math.cos(pitch) * math.cos(yaw),
124:             math.cos(pitch) * math.sin(yaw),
125:             math.sin(pitch),
126:         )
127:         eye = _sub(self.target, _scale(forward, self.distance))
128:         return CameraPose(eye=eye, target=self.target)
129: 
130:     def orbit(self, delta_yaw_deg: float, delta_pitch_deg: float) -> None:
131:         """Поворот вокруг цели."""
132:         self.yaw_deg = (self.yaw_deg + delta_yaw_deg) % 360.0
133:         self.pitch_deg = min(85.0, max(-85.0, self.pitch_deg + delta_pitch_deg))
134: 
135:     def pan(self, delta_right: float, delta_up: float) -> None:
136:         """Сдвиг цели в плоскости кадра."""
137:         pose = self.pose()
138:         step = self.distance / 500.0
139:         offset = _add(
140:             _scale(pose.right, delta_right * step),
141:             _scale(pose.up_vector, -delta_up * step),
142:         )
143:         self.target = _add(self.target, offset)
144: 
145:     def zoom(self, factor: float) -> None:
146:         """Приближение или удаление камеры."""
147:         if factor <= 0.0:
148:             return
149:         self.distance = min(self.MAX_DISTANCE, max(self.MIN_DISTANCE, self.distance * factor))
150: 
151:     def spec(self, width: int = 640, height: int = 480) -> CameraSpec:
152:         return CameraSpec(width=width, height=height, fov_deg=self.fov_deg)
153: 
154:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
155:         return {
156:             "target": list(self.target),
157:             "distance": self.distance,
158:             "yaw_deg": self.yaw_deg,
159:             "pitch_deg": self.pitch_deg,
160:             "fov_deg": self.fov_deg,
161:         }
162: 
163: 
164: def stereo_offset(pose: CameraPose, baseline_m: float) -> tuple[CameraPose, CameraPose]:
165:     """Левая и правая камеры стереопары вокруг исходной позы."""
166:     half = baseline_m / 2.0
167:     right = _scale(pose.right, half)
168:     left = CameraPose(eye=_sub(pose.eye, right), target=_sub(pose.target, right), up=pose.up)
169:     right_pose = CameraPose(eye=_add(pose.eye, right), target=_add(pose.target, right), up=pose.up)
170:     return left, right_pose
171: 
172: 
173: def _sub(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> Vec3:
174:     return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2])
175: 
176: 
177: def _add(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> Vec3:
178:     return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2])
179: 
180: 
181: def _scale(a: Vec3, factor: float) -> Vec3:
182:     return (a[0] * factor, a[1] * factor, a[2] * factor)
183: 
184: 
185: def _cross(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> Vec3:
186:     return (
187:         a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
188:         a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
189:         a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
190:     )
191: 
192: 
193: def _length(a: Vec3) -> float:
194:     return math.sqrt(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2])
195: 
196: 
197: def _normalize(a: Vec3) -> Vec3:
198:     length = _length(a)
199:     if length <= 1e-12:
200:         return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
201:     return (a[0] / length, a[1] / length, a[2] / length)

<content>
1: """Камеры сцены: сенсор и орбитальный обзор (T4-05, T4-07, FR-WLD-02).
2: 
3: ``CameraSpec`` описывает сенсор: разрешение, поле зрения, ближнюю и дальнюю
4: плоскости, режим стереопары. ``CameraPose`` — положение и направление
5: взгляда. ``OrbitCamera`` — модель управления обзором: орбита, панорамирование
6: и зум вокруг цели.
7: 
8: Математика камеры не зависит от PyBullet: те же функции считают проекцию
9: ключевых точек для ground truth, поэтому проверка глубины не требует
10: второго источника истины.
11: """
12: 
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: import math
16: from dataclasses import dataclass
17: from typing import Any, ClassVar, Literal
18: 
19: __all__ = [
20:     "CameraPose",
21:     "CameraSpec",
22:     "OrbitCamera",
23:     "Vec3",
24:     "stereo_offset",
25: ]
26: 
27: Vec3 = tuple[float, float, float]
28: 
29: #: Режим камеры.
30: CameraMode = Literal["mono", "stereo"]
31: 
32: 
33: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
34: class CameraSpec:
35:     """Параметры сенсора."""
36: 
37:     width: int = 640
38:     height: int = 480
39:     fov_deg: float = 60.0
40:     near: float = 0.1
41:     far: float = 1000.0
42:     mode: CameraMode = "mono"
43:     baseline_m: float = 0.12
44: 
45:     @property
46:     def aspect(self) -> float:
47:         return self.width / max(1, self.height)
48: 
49:     def scaled(self, width: int, height: int) -> CameraSpec:
50:         """Тот же сенсор с другим разрешением (для быстрого предпросмотра)."""
51:         return CameraSpec(
52:             width=max(16, int(width)),
53:             height=max(16, int(height)),
54:             fov_deg=self.fov_deg,
55:             near=self.near,
56:             far=self.far,
57:             mode=self.mode,
58:             baseline_m=self.baseline_m,
59:         )
60: 
61:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
62:         return {
63:             "width": self.width,
64:             "height": self.height,
65:             "fov_deg": self.fov_deg,
66:             "near": self.near,
67:             "far": self.far,
68:             "mode": self.mode,
69:             "baseline_m": self.baseline_m,
70:         }
71: 
72: 
73: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
74: class CameraPose:
75:     """Положение камеры: точка, цель и направление «вверх»."""
76: 
77:     eye: Vec3
78:     target: Vec3
79:     up: Vec3 = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
80: 
81:     @property
82:     def forward(self) -> Vec3:
83:         return _normalize(_sub(self.target, self.eye))
84: 
85:     @property
86:     def right(self) -> Vec3:
87:         return _normalize(_cross(self.forward, self.up))
88: 
89:     @property
90:     def up_vector(self) -> Vec3:
91:         return _cross(self.right, self.forward)
92: 
93:     def translated(self, offset: Vec3) -> CameraPose:
94:         return CameraPose(
95:             eye=_add(self.eye, offset),
96:             target=_add(self.target, offset),
97:             up=self.up,
98:         )
99: 
100:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
101:         return {"eye": list(self.eye), "target": list(self.target), "up": list(self.up)}
102: 
103: 
104: @dataclass(slots=True)
105: class OrbitCamera:
106:     """Орбитальный обзор сцены."""
107: 
108:     target: Vec3 = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
109:     distance: float = 220.0
110:     yaw_deg: float = 45.0
111:     pitch_deg: float = -35.0
112:     fov_deg: float = 60.0
113: 
114:     #: Минимальная и максимальная дистанция, м.
115:     MIN_DISTANCE: ClassVar[float] = 2.0
116:     MAX_DISTANCE: ClassVar[float] = 5000.0
117: 
118:     def pose(self) -> CameraPose:
119:         """Положение камеры по текущим углам."""
120:         yaw = math.radians(self.yaw_deg)
121:         pitch = math.radians(self.pitch_deg)
122:         forward = (

514:

530: | T7-06 | Реализовать инжекцию деградации | Задержка сенсора, потеря кадров, рассинхронизация ±0,5 мс, джиттер экспозиции | Успех — параметры из конфигурации применяются и видны в метриках. Неуспех — значения игнорируются | 1.0 |

553:

Now design runner. Key requirements:
- G7-02: 120 Hz transport with loss ≤ 1%. In the runner, frames per tick: if sensor rate 120 Hz and physics step 100 Hz... Hmm. Actually 120 Hz frame rate vs step 0.01 (100 Hz). Frames = ticks requirement G7-08 says number of frames equals number of ticks. So the runner generates one frame per tick. With step 0.01 that's 100 Hz. To test 120 Hz, we can set step_s = 1/120. Then 120 frames/s. The WP says success "120 Гц без потерь на эталонной сцене". I'll set config `sensor_hz` default 120 and step_s default = 1/120? But clock default is 0.01. For the runner, default step_s=0.01, sensor_hz=120 meaning the plan interval is 1/120 s and clock step is 1/120? Simpler: runner config has `step_s` and `sensor_hz`; step default 1/120 when sensor_hz=120? That is confusing.

Better: `SimulationConfig(step_s=DEFAULT_STEP_S=0.01, sensor_hz=120.0)`. Plan interval for stages: sensor budget = 1000/sensor_hz ms = 8.333 ms. The clock's target_interval = step_s/scale = 10 ms. The stages plan sum should equal 1/fps? TRD says budget_ms and fps are plan guides; stage plan = 1000/fps for sensor. Hmm, for metric `k` to be meaningful with plan based on stage sums, and stage plan = 1000/sensor_hz, then with step 10 ms and fps 120, planned per tick is 8.33 ms but wall per tick is 10 ms → k=1.2 constantly. That's bad.

Instead, per-tick plan should be clock target interval = step_s/scale (10 ms). And the stage plan for the "sensor" stage = 1000/fps (8.33 ms) if fps=120; then planned sum ≠ 10 ms. To keep consistency, set default step_s = 1/120 = 0.008333... and sensor_hz = 120. Then target interval = 8.333 ms = sensor budget. Good: one frame per tick at 120 Hz, exactly.

So `SimulationConfig.step_s` default `1.0/120.0`? But clock DEFAULT_STEP_S is 0.01. Runner can default `sensor_hz=120.0` and `step_s = 1.0/sensor_hz` when step_s is None. Let's define:

```python
@dataclass(slots=True)
class SimulationConfig:
    sensor_hz: float = 120.0
    step_s: float | None = None  # None -> 1/sensor_hz
    scale: float = 1.0
    duration_s: float | None = None  # None -> budget
    slots: int = 3
    realtime_drop: bool = False
    degradation: Degradation = field(default_factory=Degradation)
    record_path: Path | None = None
    frame_bytes: int = 256
    stage_slowdown: float = 1.0  # artificial 3x delay
    interval_s: float = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_S
    seed: int = 20261121
    mission_index: int = 0
    exercise_index: int = 0
```

Stages: derive from agent hardware constants:
- `sensor` plan = 1000/fps
- `preprocess`? Let's look at TRD 6.5 or pipeline stage naming. Actually stage names in agent: `cpu_budget_ms`, `gpu_budget_ms`, `stabilization_rate_hz`, `heavy_light_threshold_ms`. TRD 6.5? Let me grep TRD for "ступень" lines around 660-680 and 900-915.

            raise ValueError("частота источника должна быть положительной")
        if self.step_s is not None and self.step_s <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("шаг физики должен быть положительным")
        if self.frame_bytes < 1:
            raise ValueError("размер кадра должен быть положительным")
        if self.work_ms < 0.0:
            raise ValueError("искусственная работа не может быть отрицательной")
        if self.slowdown <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("замедление ступени должно быть положительным")
        if self.duration_s is not None and self.duration_s <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("длительность прогона должна быть положительной")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "sensor_hz": self.sensor_hz,
            "step_s": self.step_s,
            "scale": self.scale,
            "duration_s": self.duration_s,
            "slots": self.slots,
            "slot_bytes": self.slot_bytes,
            "frame_bytes": self.frame_bytes,
            "work_ms": self.work_ms,
            "slowdown": self.slowdown,
            "realtime_drop": self.realtime_drop,
            "degradation": self.degradation.to_dict(),
            "record_path": None if self.record_path is None else str(self.record_path),
            "report_path": None if self.report_path is None else str(self.report_path),
            "interval_s": self.interval_s,
            "stage_plan_ms": None if self.stage_plan_ms is None else dict(self.stage_plan_ms),
            "pace": self.pace,
            "seed": self.seed,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RunReport:
    """Итог прогона: состояние, метрики, кадры и события."""

    mission_id: str
    agent_id: str
    state: str
    reason: str | None
    config: dict[str, Any]
    clock: dict[str, Any]
    supervisor: dict[str, Any]
    metrics: dict[str, Any]
    frames: dict[str, Any]
    events: list[dict[str, Any]]
    record: str | None = None
    status: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.state == str(RunState.FINISHED)

    @property
    def loss_ratio(self) -> float:
        return float(self.frames.get("loss_ratio", 0.0))

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "status": "ok" if self.ok else "error",
            "state": self.state,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "mission_id": self.mission_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "config": dict(self.config),
            "clock": dict(self.clock),
            "supervisor": dict(self.supervisor),
            "metrics": dict(self.metrics),
            "frames": dict(self.frames),
            "events": list(self.events),
            "record": self.record,
            "status_file": self.status,
        }

    def summary(self) -> str:
        """Короткая сводка для CLI и панели прогона."""
        frames = self.frames
        return (
            f"прогон {self.state}: миссия {self.mission_id} ({self.agent_id})"
            f" · сцена {self.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
            f" · PC {self.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
            f" · тактов {frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · кадров {frames.get('pushed', 0)}/{frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({self.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
            f" · k p50 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f},"
            f" p95 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
            f" · событий {len(self.events)}"
        )


class SimulationRunner:
    """Headless-прогон: такты, кадры, состояния и артефакты."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        mission: Mission,
        *,
        agent: AgentSection | None = None,
        config: SimulationConfig | None = None,
        frame_source: Callable[[int, int], bytes] | None = None,
        now_ns: Callable[[], int] | None = None,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config if config is not None else SimulationConfig()
        self._mission = mission
        self._agent = agent
        self._frame_source = frame_source
        self._now = now_ns if now_ns is not None else time.perf_counter_ns
        self._sleep = sleep if sleep is not None else time.sleep

        sensor = _pick_sensor(agent)
        self.sensor_hz = float(
            self.config.sensor_hz
            if self.config.sensor_hz is not None
            else (sensor.rate_hz if sensor is not None else DEFAULT_SENSOR_HZ)
        )
        self.camera_id = sensor.id if sensor is not None else "sim.camera"
        self.frame_size = _frame_size(sensor)
        step_s = self.config.step_s if self.config.step_s is not None else 1.0 / self.sensor_hz
        self.clock = SimClock(
            step_s=step_s,
            scale=self.config.scale,
            realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
        )
        self.events = EventStream(clock_ns=self._now)
        self.supervisor = MissionSupervisor(mission, self.events, total_s=self._total_s())
        self.ring = FrameRing(slots=self.config.slots, slot_bytes=self.config.slot_bytes)
        self.injector = DegradationInjector(self.config.degradation)
        self.recorder = ScaleRecorder(self.config.interval_s)
        self.metrics = RunMetrics(
            realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
            degradation=self.injector.stats(),
        )
        self.stage_plan = self._stage_plan()
        self._slow_stage = "sensor" if "sensor" in self.stage_plan else next(iter(self.stage_plan))
        self._run_recorder = (
            RunRecorder(self.config.record_path, meta=self._stream_meta())
            if self.config.record_path is not None
            else None
        )
        self._state = RunState.IDLE
        self._frame_id = 0
        self._push_times: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._pending_wait_ms = 0.0
        self._stop = Event()
        self._pause = Event()
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._report: RunReport | None = None

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def state(self) -> RunState:
        return self._state

    @property
    def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
        return self._report

    @property
    def status_path(self) -> Path | None:
        if self.config.report_path is None:
            return None
        target = Path(self.config.report_path)
        return target.with_name(f"{target.stem}.status.json")

    def pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза: такты прекращаются, состояние супервизора меняется."""
        if self._state is not RunState.RUNNING:
            return False
        self._pause.set()
        self.clock.pause()
        self.supervisor.pause()
        self._write_status()
        return True

    def resume(self) -> bool:
        """Продолжение после паузы."""
        if self._state is not RunState.PAUSED:
            return False
        self._pause.clear()
        self.supervisor.resume()
        self.clock.resume()
        self._write_status()
        return True

    def request_stop(self) -> None:
        """Просит прогон завершиться: поток останавливается на границе такта."""
        self._stop.set()

    def interrupt(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """Прерывает прогон и сохраняет артефакты."""
        self._stop.set()
        self.supervisor.interrupt(reason)
        self._write_status()

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную (шаг вперёд) при паузе."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._state is not RunState.PAUSED:
                return False
            self.supervisor.resume()
            self.clock.resume()
            previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
            completed = self._tick(previous, paced=False)
            self.clock.pause()
            self.supervisor.pause()
            if completed:
                self.supervisor.finish()
            self._write_status()
            return True

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def run(self) -> RunReport:
        """Выполняет прогон до конца миссии или до сбоя."""
        if self._state is not RunState.IDLE:
            raise RuntimeError(f"прогон уже выполнялся: {self._state}")
        self.clock.start()
        self.supervisor.start()
        self._state = RunState.RUNNING
        self._write_status()
        previous = 0.0
        try:
            while not self._stop.is_set():
                self._wait_if_paused()
                if self._stop.is_set():
                    break
                completed = self._tick(previous, paced=True)
                previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
                self._state = self.supervisor.state
                if completed:
                    self.supervisor.finish()
                    break
            if self._stop.is_set() and self._state is RunState.RUNNING:
                self.supervisor.interrupt("прогон остановлен пользователем")
        except Exception as exc:  # сбой симуляции не должен ломать UI (FR-SIM-14)
            self.supervisor.interrupt(f"сбой симуляции: {exc}")
        finally:
            self._state = self.supervisor.state
            self._finalize()
        assert self._report is not None
        return self._report

    # --- такт -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _tick(self, previous_s: float, *, paced: bool) -> bool:
        """Один такт: кадр, транспорт, часы, супервизор и метрики."""
        started_ns = self._now()
        t_scene_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self._frame_id += 1
        frame_id = self._frame_id
        fsin_ns = round(t_scene_s * 1e9)
        packet = FramePacket(
            frame_id=frame_id,
            t_fsin_ns=fsin_ns,
            t_monotonic_ns=started_ns,
            camera_id=self.camera_id,
            width=self.frame_size[0],
            height=self.frame_size[1],
            payload=self._payload(frame_id, fsin_ns),
        )
        self._push_frame(packet, fsin_ns)
        self._consume_frames()

        if self.config.work_ms > 0.0:
            self._sleep(self.config.work_ms / 1000.0)
        work_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
        stages, wall_ms = self._stage_actuals(work_ns)
        wall_ns = round(wall_ms * 1e6)
        target_ns = round(self.clock.target_interval_s * 1e9)
        if paced and self.config.pace:
            wall_ns = max(wall_ns, target_ns)
            spent_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
            if wall_ns > spent_ns:
                self._sleep((wall_ns - spent_ns) / 1e9)
        self.clock.tick(wall_ns / 1e9)
        self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
        self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
        self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self.supervisor.advance(previous_s, self.clock.sim_time_s)
        self.recorder.observe_tick(
            stages,
            queue_depth=self.ring.depth,
            queue_wait_ms=self._pending_wait_ms,
        )
        sample = self.recorder.maybe_close(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
        if sample is not None:
            self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
        return self.supervisor.complete(self.clock.sim_time_s)

    def _push_frame(self, packet: FramePacket, fsin_ns: int) -> None:
        injected = self.injector.apply(packet)
        if injected is None:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"кадр {packet.frame_id} потерян при инжекции",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="degradation",
            )
            return
        dropped_before = self.ring.dropped
        pushed = self.ring.push(injected, drop_oldest=self.config.realtime_drop)
        overwritten = self.ring.dropped - dropped_before
        if overwritten:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += overwritten
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"перезаписано кадров: {overwritten}",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="realtime_drop",
            )
        if not pushed:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"кадр {packet.frame_id} не поместился в кольцо",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="full",
            )
            return
        self.metrics.frames_pushed += 1
        self._push_times[packet.frame_id] = self._now()
        self.events.emit(
            EventKind.FRAME_PUSHED,
            f"кадр {packet.frame_id}",
            t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
            frame_id=packet.frame_id,
            camera_id=packet.camera_id,
            depth=self.ring.depth,
        )

    def _consume_frames(self) -> None:
        for item in self.ring.drain():
            self.metrics.frames_consumed += 1
            pushed_ns = self._push_times.pop(item.frame_id, item.t_monotonic_ns)
            wait_ms = max(0.0, (self._now() - pushed_ns) / 1e6)
            self._pending_wait_ms = max(self._pending_wait_ms, wait_ms)
            if self._run_recorder is not None:
                self._run_recorder.append(item)
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_CONSUMED,
                f"кадр {item.frame_id}",
                t_scene_ns=item.t_fsin_ns,
                frame_id=item.frame_id,
                wait_ms=round(wait_ms, 3),
            )

    # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------

    def _wait_if_paused(self) -> None:
        while self._pause.is_set() and not self._stop.is_set():
            self._sleep(0.005)

    def _total_s(self) -> float:
        probe = MissionSupervisor(self._mission, self.events)
        if self.config.duration_s is not None:
            return float(self.config.duration_s)
        if probe.total_s > 0.0:
            return probe.total_s
        return DEFAULT_DURATION_S

    def _stage_plan(self) -> dict[str, float]:
        if self.config.stage_plan_ms is not None:
            plans = {name: float(value) for name, value in self.config.stage_plan_ms.items()}
            if not plans:
                raise ValueError("план ступеней пуст")
            if any(value <= 0.0 for value in plans.values()):
                raise ValueError("план ступени должен быть положительным")
            return plans
        return {"sensor": 1000.0 / self.sensor_hz}

    def _stage_actuals(self, work_ns: int) -> tuple[dict[str, tuple[float, float]], float]:
        """Раскладывает фактическое время по ступеням и добавляет замедление."""
        total_plan = sum(self.stage_plan.values())
        actual_total_ms = work_ns / 1e6
        stages: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
        wall_ms = actual_total_ms
        for name, plan in self.stage_plan.items():
            share = plan / total_plan
            actual_ms = actual_total_ms * share
            if name == self._slow_stage and self.config.slowdown != 1.0:
                extra = actual_ms * (self.config.slowdown - 1.0)
                actual_ms += extra
                wall_ms += extra
            stages[name] = (plan, actual_ms)
        return stages, wall_ms

    def _payload(self, frame_id: int, fsin_ns: int) -> bytes:
        if self._frame_source is not None:
            return self._frame_source(frame_id, fsin_ns)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{self.config.seed}:{frame_id}:{fsin_ns}".encode("utf-8")
        ).digest()
        size = self.config.frame_bytes
        if size <= len(digest):
            return digest[:size]
        repeats = size // len(digest)
        return digest * repeats + digest[: size % len(digest)]

    def _stream_meta(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
            "agent_id": self._mission.agent_id,
            "sensor_hz": self.sensor_hz,
            "step_s": self.clock.step_s,
            "scale": self.clock.scale,
            "camera_id": self.camera_id,
            "width": self.frame_size[0],
            "height": self.frame_size[1],
            "seed": self.config.seed,
            "realtime_drop": self.config.realtime_drop,
            "degradation": self.config.degradation.to_dict(),
        }

    def _finalize(self) -> None:
        """Собирает остатки, закрывает поток и пишет отчёт."""
        self._consume_frames()
        sample = self.recorder.flush(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
        if sample is not None:
            self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
        self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
        self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
        self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self.metrics.queue = self.supervisor.queue.to_dict()
        self.metrics.degradation = self.injector.stats()
        if self._run_recorder is not None:
            self._run_recorder.close()
        self._report = self._build_report()
        if self.config.report_path is not None:
            _write_json(self.config.report_path, self._report.to_dict())
        self._write_status()

    def _build_report(self) -> RunReport:
        attempted = self.clock.ticks
        dropped = self.metrics.frames_dropped
        frames = {
            "attempted": attempted,
            "pushed": self.metrics.frames_pushed,
            "consumed": self.metrics.frames_consumed,
            "dropped": dropped,
            "loss_ratio": round(dropped / attempted, 6) if attempted else 0.0,
            "ring": self.ring.stats(),
        }
        return RunReport(
            mission_id=self._mission.mission_id,
            agent_id=self._mission.agent_id,
            state=str(self._state),
            reason=self.supervisor.reason,
            config=self.config.to_dict(),
            clock=self.clock.to_dict(),
            supervisor=self.supervisor.to_dict(),
            metrics=self.metrics.to_dict(),
            frames=frames,
            events=self.events.to_payload(),
            record=None if self.config.record_path is None else str(self.config.record_path),
            status=None if self.status_path is None else str(self.status_path),
        )

    def _write_status(self) -> None:
        path = self.status_path
        if path is None:
            return
        payload = {
            "state": str(self.supervisor.state),
            "reason": self.supervisor.reason,
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "updated_ns": self._now(),
            "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
        }
        _write_json(path, payload)

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Освобождает кольцо и файл потока."""
        if self._run_recorder is not None:
            self._run_recorder.close()
        self.ring.close()


def _pick_sensor(agent: AgentSection | None) -> Sensor | None:
    if agent is None:
        return None
    for sensor in agent.sensors:
        if sensor.type in {"camera", "stereo_camera"}:
            return sensor
    return agent.sensors[0] if agent.sensors else None


def _frame_size(sensor: Sensor | None) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if sensor is None or sensor.resolution is None:
        return (640, 480)
    width, height = sensor.resolution
    return (int(width), int(height))


def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Пишет JSON атомарно: недописанный файл не попадёт на место готового."""
    target = Path(path)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = target.with_name(f"{target.name}.tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(target)


def read_status(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Читает файл состояния прогона; отсутствие файла — ``interrupted``."""
    target = Path(path)
    try:
        payload = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED), "reason": "файл состояния недоступен"}
    return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)}


def effective_state(status: dict[str, Any], *, alive: bool | None = None) -> str:
    """Состояние с учётом живости процесса.

    Если процесс умер, а состояние осталось ``running``, прогон считается
    прерванным: артефакты могли не дописаться, но журнал читаем (G7-07).
    """
    state = str(status.get("state", RunState.INTERRUPTED))
    if state == str(RunState.RUNNING) and alive is False:
        return str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)
    return state
