@dataclass(slots=True)
class RunReport:
    """Итог прогона: состояние, метрики, кадры и события."""

    mission_id: str
    agent_id: str
    state: str
    reason: str | None
    config: dict[str, Any]
    clock: dict[str, Any]
    supervisor: dict[str, Any]
    metrics: dict[str, Any]
    frames: dict[str, Any]
    events: list[dict[str, Any]]
    record: str | None = None
    status: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.state == str(RunState.FINISHED)

    @property
    def loss_ratio(self) -> float:
        return float(self.frames.get("loss_ratio", 0.0))

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "status": "ok" if self.ok else "error",
            "state": self.state,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "mission_id": self.mission_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "config": dict(self.config),
            "clock": dict(self.clock),
            "supervisor": dict(self.supervisor),
            "metrics": dict(self.metrics),
            "frames": dict(self.frames),
            "events": list(self.events),
            "record": self.record,
            "status_file": self.status,
        }

    def summary(self) -> str:
        """Короткая сводка для CLI и панели прогона."""
        frames = self.frames
        return (
            f"прогон {self.state}: миссия {self.mission_id} ({self.agent_id})"
            f" · сцена {self.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
            f" · PC {self.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.1f} с"
            f" · тактов {frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · кадров {frames.get('pushed', 0)}/{frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({self.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
            f" · k p50 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f},"
            f" p95 {self.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
            f" · событий {len(self.events)}"
        )


class SimulationRunner:
    """Headless-прогон: такты, кадры, состояния и артефакты."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        mission: Mission,
        *,
        agent: AgentSection | None = None,
        config: SimulationConfig | None = None,
        frame_source: Callable[[int, int], bytes] | None = None,
        now_ns: Callable[[], int] | None = None,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.config = config if config is not None else SimulationConfig()
        self._mission = mission
        self._agent = agent
        self._frame_source = frame_source
        self._now = now_ns if now_ns is not None else time.perf_counter_ns
        self._sleep = sleep if sleep is not None else time.sleep

        sensor = _pick_sensor(agent)
        self.sensor_hz = float(
            self.config.sensor_hz
            if self.config.sensor_hz is not None
            else (sensor.rate_hz if sensor is not None else DEFAULT_SENSOR_HZ)
        )
        self.camera_id = sensor.id if sensor is not None else "sim.camera"
        self.frame_size = _frame_size(sensor)
        step_s = self.config.step_s if self.config.step_s is not None else 1.0 / self.sensor_hz
        self.clock = SimClock(
            step_s=step_s,
            scale=self.config.scale,
            realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
        )
        self.events = EventStream(clock_ns=self._now)
        self.supervisor = MissionSupervisor(mission, self.events, total_s=self._total_s())
        self.ring = FrameRing(slots=self.config.slots, slot_bytes=self.config.slot_bytes)
        self.injector = DegradationInjector(self.config.degradation)
        self.recorder = ScaleRecorder(self.config.interval_s)
        self.metrics = RunMetrics(
            realtime_drop=self.config.realtime_drop,
            degradation=self.injector.stats(),
        )
        self.stage_plan = self._stage_plan()
        self._slow_stage = "sensor" if "sensor" in self.stage_plan else next(iter(self.stage_plan))
        self._run_recorder = (
            RunRecorder(self.config.record_path, meta=self._stream_meta())
            if self.config.record_path is not None
            else None
        )
        self._state = RunState.IDLE
        self._frame_id = 0
        self._push_times: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._pending_wait_ms = 0.0
        self._stop = Event()
        self._pause = Event()
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._report: RunReport | None = None

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def state(self) -> RunState:
        return self._state

    @property
    def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
        return self._report

    @property
    def status_path(self) -> Path | None:
        if self.config.report_path is None:
            return None
        target = Path(self.config.report_path)
        return target.with_name(f"{target.stem}.status.json")

    def pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза: такты прекращаются, состояние супервизора меняется."""
        if self._state is not RunState.RUNNING:
            return False
        self._pause.set()
        self.clock.pause()
        self.supervisor.pause()
        self._write_status()
        return True

    def resume(self) -> bool:
        """Продолжение после паузы."""
        if self._state is not RunState.PAUSED:
            return False
        self._pause.clear()
        self.supervisor.resume()
        self.clock.resume()
        self._write_status()
        return True

    def request_stop(self) -> None:
        """Просит прогон завершиться: поток останавливается на границе такта."""
        self._stop.set()

    def interrupt(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """Прерывает прогон и сохраняет артефакты."""
        self._stop.set()
        self.supervisor.interrupt(reason)
        self._write_status()

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную (шаг вперёд) при паузе."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._state is not RunState.PAUSED:
                return False
            self.supervisor.resume()
            self.clock.resume()
            previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
            completed = self._tick(previous, paced=False)
            self.clock.pause()
            self.supervisor.pause()
            if completed:
                self.supervisor.finish()
            self._write_status()
            return True

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def run(self) -> RunReport:
        """Выполняет прогон до конца миссии или до сбоя."""
        if self._state is not RunState.IDLE:
            raise RuntimeError(f"прогон уже выполнялся: {self._state}")
        self.clock.start()
        self.supervisor.start()
        self._state = RunState.RUNNING
        self._write_status()
        previous = 0.0
        try:
            while not self._stop.is_set():
                self._wait_if_paused()
                if self._stop.is_set():
                    break
                completed = self._tick(previous, paced=True)
                previous = self.clock.sim_time_s
                self._state = self.supervisor.state
                if completed:
                    self.supervisor.finish()
                    break
            if self._stop.is_set() and self._state is RunState.RUNNING:
                self.supervisor.interrupt("прогон остановлен пользователем")
        except Exception as exc:  # сбой симуляции не должен ломать UI (FR-SIM-14)
            self.supervisor.interrupt(f"сбой симуляции: {exc}")
        finally:
            self._state = self.supervisor.state
            self._finalize()
        assert self._report is not None
        return self._report

    # --- такт -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _tick(self, previous_s: float, *, paced: bool) -> bool:
        """Один такт: кадр, транспорт, часы, супервизор и метрики."""
        started_ns = self._now()
        t_scene_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self._frame_id += 1
        frame_id = self._frame_id
        fsin_ns = round(t_scene_s * 1e9)
        packet = FramePacket(
            frame_id=frame_id,
            t_fsin_ns=fsin_ns,
            t_monotonic_ns=started_ns,
            camera_id=self.camera_id,
            width=self.frame_size[0],
            height=self.frame_size[1],
            payload=self._payload(frame_id, fsin_ns),
        )
        self._push_frame(packet, fsin_ns)
        self._consume_frames()

        if self.config.work_ms > 0.0:
            self._sleep(self.config.work_ms / 1000.0)
        work_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
        stages, wall_ms = self._stage_actuals(work_ns)
        wall_ns = round(wall_ms * 1e6)
        target_ns = round(self.clock.target_interval_s * 1e9)
        if paced and self.config.pace:
            wall_ns = max(wall_ns, target_ns)
            spent_ns = max(0, self._now() - started_ns)
            if wall_ns > spent_ns:
                self._sleep((wall_ns - spent_ns) / 1e9)
        self.clock.tick(wall_ns / 1e9)
        self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
        self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
        self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self.supervisor.advance(previous_s, self.clock.sim_time_s)
        self.recorder.observe_tick(
            stages,
            queue_depth=self.ring.depth,
            queue_wait_ms=self._pending_wait_ms,
        )
        sample = self.recorder.maybe_close(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
        if sample is not None:
            self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
        return self.supervisor.complete(self.clock.sim_time_s)

    def _push_frame(self, packet: FramePacket, fsin_ns: int) -> None:
        injected = self.injector.apply(packet)
        if injected is None:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"кадр {packet.frame_id} потерян при инжекции",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="degradation",
            )
            return
        dropped_before = self.ring.dropped
        pushed = self.ring.push(injected, drop_oldest=self.config.realtime_drop)
        overwritten = self.ring.dropped - dropped_before
        if overwritten:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += overwritten
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"перезаписано кадров: {overwritten}",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="realtime_drop",
            )
        if not pushed:
            self.metrics.frames_dropped += 1
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_DROPPED,
                f"кадр {packet.frame_id} не поместился в кольцо",
                t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
                frame_id=packet.frame_id,
                cause="full",
            )
            return
        self.metrics.frames_pushed += 1
        self._push_times[packet.frame_id] = self._now()
        self.events.emit(
            EventKind.FRAME_PUSHED,
            f"кадр {packet.frame_id}",
            t_scene_ns=fsin_ns,
            frame_id=packet.frame_id,
            camera_id=packet.camera_id,
            depth=self.ring.depth,
        )

    def _consume_frames(self) -> None:
        for item in self.ring.drain():
            self.metrics.frames_consumed += 1
            pushed_ns = self._push_times.pop(item.frame_id, item.t_monotonic_ns)
            wait_ms = max(0.0, (self._now() - pushed_ns) / 1e6)
            self._pending_wait_ms = max(self._pending_wait_ms, wait_ms)
            if self._run_recorder is not None:
                self._run_recorder.append(item)
            self.events.emit(
                EventKind.FRAME_CONSUMED,
                f"кадр {item.frame_id}",
                t_scene_ns=item.t_fsin_ns,
                frame_id=item.frame_id,
                wait_ms=round(wait_ms, 3),
            )

    # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------

    def _wait_if_paused(self) -> None:
        while self._pause.is_set() and not self._stop.is_set():
            self._sleep(0.005)

    def _total_s(self) -> float:
        probe = MissionSupervisor(self._mission, self.events)
        if self.config.duration_s is not None:
            return float(self.config.duration_s)
        if probe.total_s > 0.0:
            return probe.total_s
        return DEFAULT_DURATION_S

    def _stage_plan(self) -> dict[str, float]:
        if self.config.stage_plan_ms is not None:
            plans = {name: float(value) for name, value in self.config.stage_plan_ms.items()}
            if not plans:
                raise ValueError("план ступеней пуст")
            if any(value <= 0.0 for value in plans.values()):
                raise ValueError("план ступени должен быть положительным")
            return plans
        return {"sensor": 1000.0 / self.sensor_hz}

    def _stage_actuals(self, work_ns: int) -> tuple[dict[str, tuple[float, float]], float]:
        """Раскладывает фактическое время по ступеням и добавляет замедление."""
        total_plan = sum(self.stage_plan.values())
        actual_total_ms = work_ns / 1e6
        stages: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
        wall_ms = actual_total_ms
        for name, plan in self.stage_plan.items():
            share = plan / total_plan
            actual_ms = actual_total_ms * share
            if name == self._slow_stage and self.config.slowdown != 1.0:
                extra = actual_ms * (self.config.slowdown - 1.0)
                actual_ms += extra
                wall_ms += extra
            stages[name] = (plan, actual_ms)
        return stages, wall_ms

    def _payload(self, frame_id: int, fsin_ns: int) -> bytes:
        if self._frame_source is not None:
            return self._frame_source(frame_id, fsin_ns)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{self.config.seed}:{frame_id}:{fsin_ns}".encode("utf-8")
        ).digest()
        size = self.config.frame_bytes
        if size <= len(digest):
            return digest[:size]
        repeats = size // len(digest)
        return digest * repeats + digest[: size % len(digest)]

    def _stream_meta(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
            "agent_id": self._mission.agent_id,
            "sensor_hz": self.sensor_hz,
            "step_s": self.clock.step_s,
            "scale": self.clock.scale,
            "camera_id": self.camera_id,
            "width": self.frame_size[0],
            "height": self.frame_size[1],
            "seed": self.config.seed,
            "realtime_drop": self.config.realtime_drop,
            "degradation": self.config.degradation.to_dict(),
        }

    def _finalize(self) -> None:
        """Собирает остатки, закрывает поток и пишет отчёт."""
        self._consume_frames()
        sample = self.recorder.flush(self.clock.sim_time_s, self.clock.wall_time_s)
        if sample is not None:
            self.metrics.intervals.append(sample)
        self.metrics.ticks = self.clock.ticks
        self.metrics.pc_time_s = self.clock.wall_time_s
        self.metrics.scene_time_s = self.clock.sim_time_s
        self.metrics.queue = self.supervisor.queue.to_dict()
        self.metrics.degradation = self.injector.stats()
        if self._run_recorder is not None:
            self._run_recorder.close()
        self._report = self._build_report()
        if self.config.report_path is not None:
            _write_json(self.config.report_path, self._report.to_dict())
        self._write_status()

    def _build_report(self) -> RunReport:
        attempted = self.clock.ticks
        dropped = self.metrics.frames_dropped
        frames = {
            "attempted": attempted,
            "pushed": self.metrics.frames_pushed,
            "consumed": self.metrics.frames_consumed,
            "dropped": dropped,
            "loss_ratio": round(dropped / attempted, 6) if attempted else 0.0,
            "ring": self.ring.stats(),
        }
        return RunReport(
            mission_id=self._mission.mission_id,
            agent_id=self._mission.agent_id,
            state=str(self._state),
            reason=self.supervisor.reason,
            config=self.config.to_dict(),
            clock=self.clock.to_dict(),
            supervisor=self.supervisor.to_dict(),
            metrics=self.metrics.to_dict(),
            frames=frames,
            events=self.events.to_payload(),
            record=None if self.config.record_path is None else str(self.config.record_path),
            status=None if self.status_path is None else str(self.status_path),
        )

    def _write_status(self) -> None:
        path = self.status_path
        if path is None:
            return
        payload = {
            "state": str(self.supervisor.state),
            "reason": self.supervisor.reason,
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "updated_ns": self._now(),
            "mission_id": self._mission.mission_id,
        }
        _write_json(path, payload)

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Освобождает кольцо и файл потока."""
        if self._run_recorder is not None:
            self._run_recorder.close()
        self.ring.close()


def _pick_sensor(agent: AgentSection | None) -> Sensor | None:
    if agent is None:
        return None
    for sensor in agent.sensors:
        if sensor.type in {"camera", "stereo_camera"}:
            return sensor
    return agent.sensors[0] if agent.sensors else None


def _frame_size(sensor: Sensor | None) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if sensor is None or sensor.resolution is None:
        return (640, 480)
    width, height = sensor.resolution
    return (int(width), int(height))


def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Пишет JSON атомарно: недописанный файл не попадёт на место готового."""
    target = Path(path)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = target.with_name(f"{target.name}.tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(target)


def read_status(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Читает файл состояния прогона; отсутствие файла — ``interrupted``."""
    target = Path(path)
    try:
        payload = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED), "reason": "файл состояния недоступен"}
    return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"state": str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)}


def effective_state(status: dict[str, Any], *, alive: bool | None = None) -> str:
    """Состояние с учётом живости процесса.

    Если процесс умер, а состояние осталось ``running``, прогон считается
    прерванным: артефакты могли не дописаться, но журнал читаем (G7-07).
    """
    state = str(status.get("state", RunState.INTERRUPTED))
    if state == str(RunState.RUNNING) and alive is False:
        return str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)
    return state

Budget total=0 → fallback 10, but config.duration_s=1.0 overrides. Good.

Run: should complete after 120 ticks, frames 120/120, loss 0, events ordered, report state finished.

Let's test.

"""Команды ``simorph sim``: headless-прогон и replay (этап 7).

``sim run`` исполняет миссию без 3D-окна и печатает метрики мягкого
масштаба. ``sim replay`` читает записанный поток и сверяет хэши кадров,
не запуская физику. Обе команды работают с тем же раннером, что и вкладка
«Симуляция», поэтому оконный и headless-режимы дают одинаковые числа.

Код возврата: 0 — успех, 1 — ошибка данных или незавершённый прогон.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from simorph.cli.exit_codes import ExitCode
from simorph.cli.project import add_common_options
from simorph.core.errors import ProjectError
from simorph.core.models.exercise import ExerciseSection, Mission
from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
from simorph.core.repository import load_project
from simorph.core.simulation import (
    Degradation,
    SimulationConfig,
    SimulationRunner,
    replay_stream,
)

__all__ = ["build_sim_parser", "run_sim_command"]


def build_sim_parser(subparsers: Any) -> None:
    """Регистрирует подкоманды ``sim``."""
    sim = subparsers.add_parser("sim", help="симуляция: прогон и replay потока")
    add_common_options(sim)
    actions = sim.add_subparsers(dest="sim_command", metavar="ДЕЙСТВИЕ")

    run_parser = actions.add_parser("run", help="headless-прогон миссии")
    add_common_options(run_parser)
    run_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="путь к project.json")
    run_parser.add_argument("--exercise", type=int, default=0, help="номер упражнения")
    run_parser.add_argument("--mission", type=int, default=0, help="номер миссии")
    run_parser.add_argument("--scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="целевой масштаб времени")
    run_parser.add_argument("--step", type=float, default=None, help="шаг физики, с")
    run_parser.add_argument("--duration", type=float, default=None, help="длительность, с")
    run_parser.add_argument("--slots", type=int, default=3, help="слотов в кольце (2–4)")
    run_parser.add_argument(
        "--realtime-drop",
        action="store_true",
        help="явно разрешить отбрасывание кадров при переполнении",
    )
    run_parser.add_argument("--latency-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="задержка сенсора, мс")
    run_parser.add_argument("--loss", type=float, default=0.0, help="доля потерь кадров 0…1")
    run_parser.add_argument("--desync-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="рассинхронизация ±0,5 мс")
    run_parser.add_argument("--jitter-us", type=float, default=0.0, help="джиттер выдержки, мкс")
    run_parser.add_argument("--work-ms", type=float, default=0.0, help="искусственная работа такта")
    run_parser.add_argument("--slowdown", type=float, default=1.0, help="замедление ступени, раз")
    run_parser.add_argument("--record", type=Path, default=None, help="записать поток кадров")
    run_parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=None, help="записать отчёт JSON")
    run_parser.add_argument(
        "--no-pace",
        action="store_true",
        help="не выдерживать плановый интервал (максимальная скорость)",
    )

    replay_parser = actions.add_parser("replay", help="воспроизвести поток без физики")
    add_common_options(replay_parser)
    replay_parser.add_argument("path", type=Path, help="файл потока")
    replay_parser.add_argument(
        "--no-compare",
        action="store_true",
        help="только прочитать поток, не сверяя хэши",
    )


def _write(text: str) -> None:
    sys.stdout.write(f"{text}\n")


def _write_json(payload: object) -> None:
    _write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def _load(path: Path) -> ProjectDocument:
    return load_project(path).document


def _exercise(document: ProjectDocument, index: int) -> ExerciseSection:
    if not document.exercises:
        raise ProjectError("в проекте нет упражнений")
    if not 0 <= index < len(document.exercises):
        raise ProjectError(
            f"упражнение с номером {index} не найдено: в проекте {len(document.exercises)}"
        )
    return document.exercises[index]


def _mission(exercise: ExerciseSection, index: int) -> Mission:
    if not exercise.missions:
        raise ProjectError(f"в упражнении {exercise.exercise_id!r} нет миссий")
    if not 0 <= index < len(exercise.missions):
        raise ProjectError(
            f"миссия с номером {index} не найдена: в упражнении {len(exercise.missions)}"
        )
    return exercise.missions[index]


def _agent(document: ProjectDocument, mission: Mission) -> Any:
    for agent in document.agents:
        if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
            return agent
    return None


def _cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    document = _load(args.path)
    exercise = _exercise(document, args.exercise)
    mission = _mission(exercise, args.mission)
    config = SimulationConfig(
        scale=args.scale,
        step_s=args.step,
        duration_s=args.duration,
        slots=args.slots,
        realtime_drop=bool(args.realtime_drop),
        degradation=Degradation(
            sensor_latency_ms=args.latency_ms,
            frame_loss_ratio=args.loss,
            desync_ms=args.desync_ms,
            exposure_jitter_us=args.jitter_us,
        ),
        work_ms=args.work_ms,
        slowdown=args.slowdown,
        record_path=args.record,
        report_path=args.report,
        pace=not args.no_pace,
    )
    runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=_agent(document, mission), config=config)
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()
    if as_json:
        _write_json(report.to_dict())
    else:
        _write(report.summary())
        _write(
            f"масштаб {report.clock.get('scale', 1.0):g}"
            f" · шаг {report.clock.get('step_s', 0.0) * 1000:.2f} мс"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · потеря {report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%"
        )
        if report.record:
            _write(f"поток: {report.record}")
        if report.status:
            _write(f"состояние: {report.status}")
        if report.reason:
            _write(f"причина: {report.reason}")
    if not report.ok:
        logger.error("прогон не завершён: %s (%s)", report.state, report.reason)
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def _cmd_replay(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    report = replay_stream(args.path, compare=not args.no_compare)
    if as_json:
        _write_json(report.to_dict())
    else:
        _write(
            f"поток {report.source}: кадров {report.frames}"
            f" · совпало {report.matched}"
            f" · расхождений {len(report.mismatched)}"
            f" · нарушений меток {len(report.bad_timing)}"
        )
        if report.mismatched:
            _write(f"  расхождения: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.mismatched[:10])}")
        if report.bad_timing:
            _write(f"  метки: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.bad_timing[:10])}")
    if not report.ok:
        logger.error(
            "replay не совпал: расхождений %d, нарушений меток %d",
            len(report.mismatched),
            len(report.bad_timing),
        )
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def run_sim_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    """Диспетчер подкоманд ``sim``."""
    command = getattr(args, "sim_command", None)
    try:
        if command == "run":
            return _cmd_run(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
        if command == "replay":
            return _cmd_replay(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
    except (ProjectError, ValueError) as exc:
        logger.error("%s", exc)
        if as_json:
            _write_json({"status": "error", "error": str(exc)})
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {exc}\n")
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    logger.error("не указано действие для sim: run или replay")
    return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)

        slots=args.slots,
        realtime_drop=bool(args.realtime_drop),
        degradation=Degradation(
            sensor_latency_ms=args.latency_ms,
            frame_loss_ratio=args.loss,
            desync_ms=args.desync_ms,
            exposure_jitter_us=args.jitter_us,
        ),
        work_ms=args.work_ms,
        slowdown=args.slowdown,
        record_path=args.record,
        report_path=args.report,
        pace=not args.no_pace,
    )
    runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=_agent(document, mission), config=config)
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()
    if as_json:
        _write_json(report.to_dict())
    else:
        _write(report.summary())
        _write(
            f"масштаб {report.clock.get('scale', 1.0):g}"
            f" · шаг {report.clock.get('step_s', 0.0) * 1000:.2f} мс"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · потеря {report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%"
        )
        if report.record:
            _write(f"поток: {report.record}")
        if report.status:
            _write(f"состояние: {report.status}")
        if report.reason:
            _write(f"причина: {report.reason}")
    if not report.ok:
        logger.error("прогон не завершён: %s (%s)", report.state, report.reason)
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def _cmd_replay(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    report = replay_stream(args.path, compare=not args.no_compare)
    if as_json:
        _write_json(report.to_dict())
    else:
        _write(
            f"поток {report.source}: кадров {report.frames}"
            f" · совпало {report.matched}"
            f" · расхождений {len(report.mismatched)}"
            f" · нарушений меток {len(report.bad_timing)}"
        )
        if report.mismatched:
            _write(f"  расхождения: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.mismatched[:10])}")
        if report.bad_timing:
            _write(f"  метки: {', '.join(str(i) for i in report.bad_timing[:10])}")
    if not report.ok:
        logger.error(
            "replay не совпал: расхождений %d, нарушений меток %d",
            len(report.mismatched),
            len(report.bad_timing),
        )
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    return int(ExitCode.OK)


def run_sim_command(args: argparse.Namespace, *, as_json: bool, logger: logging.Logger) -> int:
    """Диспетчер подкоманд ``sim``."""
    command = getattr(args, "sim_command", None)
    try:
        if command == "run":
            return _cmd_run(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
        if command == "replay":
            return _cmd_replay(args, as_json=as_json, logger=logger)
    except (ProjectError, ValueError) as exc:
        logger.error("%s", exc)
        if as_json:
            _write_json({"status": "error", "error": str(exc)})
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"simorph: {exc}\n")
        return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)
    logger.error("не указано действие для sim: run или replay")
    return int(ExitCode.DATA_ERROR)

message.content:
Bug: `@dataclass(slots=True)` with declared `__slots__` from dataclass — assigning `_ticks` in `__post_init__` fails because slots are only the fields. The class is slots=True and doesn't declare private fields as fields. Tests for clock must have passed? The summary said clock implemented; maybe not tested yet. Need to fix: declare private attributes as dataclass fields with `field(init=False)` or remove slots=True. Simplest: remove `slots=True` from SimClock (use regular class). But other classes also use slots with private fields: `DegradationInjector` has `_rng` etc. declared with `field(init=False)`. `FrameRing` isn't a dataclass. `MissionSupervisor` regular class. `ScaleRecorder` regular. `RunMetrics` dataclass slots with only declared fields. `SimClock` needs private fields declared.

Add fields:
```python
_ticks: int = field(init=False, default=0, repr=False)
...
```
But `_started`, `_paused`, `_stopped`. Then `__post_init__` validates and sets them (or defaults handle). `field(init=False)` with defaults means they are slots. Keep slots=True for performance.

Also `SimClock` sets `self.scale = float(scale)` in set_scale — scale is a field, fine.

Let me patch clock.py.

Also `to_dict` uses `_ticks`; fine. But `start()` sets `_started` etc.; fields exist.

Check other dataclass slots classes for undeclared private fields:
- `DegradationInjector`: `_rng`, `_applied`, `_lost`, `_max_desync_ns`, `_max_jitter_us` all declared with `field(init=False, ...)` except `_max_jitter_us` declared as `_max_jitter_us: float = 0.0` — with slots=True, a class-level default without field? In dataclass, annotated attribute with default becomes a field; slots include it, but it's also an init parameter! `DegradationInjector(config=..., _max_jitter_us=0.0)`? That's an init field, not desirable but works. Wait `_applied: int = 0` similarly. They're annotated and have defaults → become init parameters named `_applied` etc. That's ugly but functional. However, dataclass fields starting with underscore are allowed. Tests may not care. But `_rng` is `field(init=False, repr=False)` without default → not set in __post_init__? It is set. Fine.

8:    переходы; правка применяется одной командой undo;
9: 3. **параметры** — бюджет миссии, расписание с критическим путём и
10:    замечания валидатора по этой миссии.
11: 
12: Панели синхронны: выбор узла в графе открывает его в панели элемента
13: и подсвечивает строку расписания, а правка поля сразу перестраивает
14: граф и бюджет.
15: 
16: Компактный режим убирает панель графа, оставляя элемент и параметры;
17: выбранный узел, индексы упражнения и миссии при переключении не теряются.

448:     def _refresh_all(self) -> None:
449:         if self._refreshing or self._disposed:
450:             return
451:         self._refreshing = True
452:         try:
453:             self._sync_combos()
454:             self._recalculate()
455:             self._fill_graph()
456:             self._fill_timeline()
457:             self._sync_selection()
458:         finally:
459:             self._refreshing = False

461:     def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
462:         exercises = self._document.exercises
463:         self._exercise_index = min(self._exercise_index, max(0, len(exercises) - 1))
464:         self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
465:         self._exercise_combo.clear()
466:         for index, exercise in enumerate(exercises):
467:             self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
468:         self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
469:         self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)
470: 
471:         missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
472:         self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
473:         self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
474:         self._mission_combo.clear()
475:         for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
476:             self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
477:         self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
478:         self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)
479: 
480:     def _recalculate(self) -> None:
481:         mission = self.mission
482:         if mission is None:
483:             self._graph = MissionGraph()
484:             self._budget = MissionBudget()
485:             self._issues = []
486:             return
487:         self._graph = build_graph(mission.elements)
488:         self._budget = mission_budget(mission.elements)
489:         self._issues = mission_issues(
490:             mission,
491:             world=self._document.world,
492:             agents=self._document.agents,
493:             prefix=f"exercises.{self._exercise_index}.missions.{self._mission_index}",
494:         )
495: 
496:     # --- панели ---------------------------------------------------------
497: 
498:     def _fill_graph(self) -> None:
499:         self._graph_tree.blockSignals(True)
500:         self._graph_tree.clear()
501:         mission = self.mission
502:         if mission is None:
503:             self._graph_tree.blockSignals(False)
504:             self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
505:             return
506:         by_id = {element.id: element for element in mission.elements}
507:         grouped: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
508:         for name in self._graph.order:
509:             grouped.setdefault(self._graph.layers.get(name, 0), []).append(name)
510:         for layer in sorted(grouped):
511:             header = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Слой {layer}", ""])
512:             header.setFlags(Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled)
513:             self._graph_tree.addTopLevelItem(header)
514:             for name in grouped[layer]:
515:                 element = by_id[name]
516:                 spec = element_spec(element.type)
517:                 item = QTreeWidgetItem([f"{spec.title} · {name}", spec.title])
518:                 item.setData(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, name)
519:                 self._decorate(item, element)
520:                 header.addChild(item)
521:         self._graph_tree.expandAll()
522:         self._graph_tree.blockSignals(False)
523: 
524:     def _decorate(self, item: QTreeWidgetItem, element: MissionElement) -> None:
525:         """Подсвечивает проблемные узлы прямо в графе."""
526:         if element.id in self._graph.illegal_cycles:
527:             item.setForeground(0, QBrush(_CYCLE_COLOR))
528:             item.setToolTip(0, "цикл допустим только через элемент 'loop'")
529:         elif element.id not in self._graph.reachable:
530:             item.setForeground(0, QBrush(_UNREACHABLE_COLOR))
531:             item.setToolTip(0, "элемент недостижим из 'start'")
532:         elif element.id in self._graph.cycles:
533:             item.setToolTip(0, "участок повторяется через 'loop'")
534:         missing = [
535:             name for name in required_fields(element.type) if getattr(element, name, None) is None
536:         ]
537:         if missing:
538:             item.setToolTip(0, f"не заполнено: {', '.join(missing)}")
539: 
540:     def _sync_selection(self) -> None:
541:         """Приводит выбор, панель элемента и расписание к одному узлу."""
542:         mission = self.mission
543:         if mission is None:
544:             self._selected_id = None
545:             self._show_empty_element("в упражнении нет миссий")
546:             self._update_summary()
547:             return
548:         ids = [element.id for element in mission.elements]
549:         if self._selected_id not in ids:
550:             self._selected_id = ids[0] if ids else None
551:         self._select_tree_item(self._selected_id)
552:         self._show_element(self._selected_id)
553:         self._highlight_timeline(self._selected_id)
554:         self._update_summary()
555: 
556:     def _select_tree_item(self, element_id: str | None) -> None:
557:         self._graph_tree.blockSignals(True)
558:         try:
559:             for top in range(self._graph_tree.topLevelItemCount()):
560:                 header = self._graph_tree.topLevelItem(top)
561:                 if header is None:
562:                     continue
563:                 for index in range(header.childCount()):
564:                     child = header.child(index)
565:                     if child is not None and (
566:                         child.data(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) == element_id
567:                     ):
568:                         self._graph_tree.setCurrentItem(child)

461:     def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
462:         exercises = self._document.exercises

464:         self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
465:         self._exercise_combo.clear()

467:             self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
468:         self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
469:         self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)

471:         missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
472:         self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
473:         self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
474:         self._mission_combo.clear()
475:         for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
476:             self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
477:         self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
478:         self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)

498:     def _fill_graph(self) -> None:
499:         self._graph_tree.blockSignals(True)
500:         self._graph_tree.clear()
501:         mission = self.mission
502:         if mission is None:
503:             self._graph_tree.blockSignals(False)
504:             self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
505:             return
506:         by_id = {element.id: element for element in mission.elements}
507:         grouped: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
508:         for name in self._graph.order:
509:             grouped.setdefault(self._graph.layers.get(name, 0), []).append(name)
510:         for layer in sorted(grouped):
511:             header = QTreeWidgetItem([f"Слой {layer}", ""])
512:             header.setFlags(Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled)
513:             self._graph_tree.addTopLevelItem(header)
514:             for name in grouped[layer]:
515:                 element = by_id[name]
516:                 spec = element_spec(element.type)
517:                 item = QTreeWidgetItem([f"{spec.title} · {name}", spec.title])
518:                 item.setData(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, name)
519:                 self._decorate(item, element)
520:                 header.addChild(item)
521:         self._graph_tree.expandAll()
522:         self._graph_tree.blockSignals(False)

524:     def _decorate(self, item: QTreeWidgetItem, element: MissionElement) -> None:
525:         """Подсвечивает проблемные узлы прямо в графе."""
526:         if element.id in self._graph.illegal_cycles:
527:             item.setForeground(0, QBrush(_CYCLE_COLOR))
528:             item.setToolTip(0, "цикл допустим только через элемент 'loop'")
529:         elif element.id not in self._graph.reachable:
530:             item.setForeground(0, QBrush(_UNREACHABLE_COLOR))
531:             item.setToolTip(0, "элемент недостижим из 'start'")
532:         elif element.id in self._graph.cycles:
533:             item.setToolTip(0, "участок повторяется через 'loop'")
534:         missing = [
535:             name for name in required_fields(element.type) if getattr(element, name, None) is None
536:         ]
537:         if missing:
538:             item.setToolTip(0, f"не заполнено: {', '.join(missing)}")
539: 
540:     def _sync_selection(self) -> None:
541:         """Приводит выбор, панель элемента и расписание к одному узлу."""
542:         mission = self.mission
543:         if mission is None:
544:             self._selected_id = None
545:             self._show_empty_element("в упражнении нет миссий")
546:             self._update_summary()
547:             return
548:         ids = [element.id for element in mission.elements]
549:         if self._selected_id not in ids:
550:             self._selected_id = ids[0] if ids else None
551:         self._select_tree_item(self._selected_id)
552:         self._show_element(self._selected_id)
553:         self._highlight_timeline(self._selected_id)
554:         self._update_summary()

556:     def _select_tree_item(self, element_id: str | None) -> None:

558:         try:
559:             for top in range(self._graph_tree.topLevelItemCount()):
560:                 header = self._graph_tree.topLevelItem(top)
561:                 if header is None:
562:                     continue
563:                 for index in range(header.childCount()):
564:                     child = header.child(index)
565:                     if child is not None and (
566:                         child.data(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) == element_id
567:                     ):
568:                         self._graph_tree.setCurrentItem(child)
569:                         return
570:         finally:
571:             self._graph_tree.blockSignals(False)

573:     def _show_element(self, element_id: str | None) -> None:
574:         mission = self.mission
575:         if mission is None or element_id is None:
576:             self._show_empty_element("элемент не выбран")
577:             return
578:         element = next((item for item in mission.elements if item.id == element_id), None)
579:         if element is None:
580:             self._show_empty_element("элемент не выбран")
581:             return
582:         spec = element_spec(element.type)
583:         self._element_title.setText(f"{spec.title} · {element.id}")
584:         path = self._graph.path_to(element.id)
585:         incoming = self._graph.parents.get(element.id, [])
586:         parts = [
587:             f"тип {element.type} · категория {spec.category}",
588:             f"путь: {' → '.join(path) if path else '—'}",
589:             f"входы: {', '.join(incoming) if incoming else '—'}",
590:             f"переходы: {', '.join(element.next) if element.next else '—'}",
591:         ]
592:         if spec.terminal:
593:             parts.append("терминальный: исходящих переходов быть не должно")
594:         self._element_hint.setText("\n".join(parts))
595:         related = [
596:             item.message for item in self._issues if item.path.startswith(self._element_prefix())
597:         ]
598:         self._element_issues.setText("\n".join(related))
599:         for name, editor in self._fields.items():
600:             editor.blockSignals(True)
601:             editor.setText(_format_value(name, getattr(element, name)))
602:             editor.blockSignals(False)

619:     def _fill_timeline(self) -> None:
620:         timeline = sorted(
621:             (
622:                 (name, self._budget.starts.get(name, 0.0), self._budget.ends.get(name, 0.0))
623:                 for name in self._budget.starts
624:             ),
625:             key=lambda row: (row[1], row[2], row[0]),
626:         )
627:         critical = set(self._budget.critical_path)
628:         self._timeline.setRowCount(len(timeline))
629:         for row, (name, start, end) in enumerate(timeline):
630:             for column, text in enumerate((name, f"{start:.1f}", f"{end:.1f}")):
631:                 item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
632:                 item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, name)
633:                 if name in critical:
634:                     font = QFont(item.font())
635:                     font.setBold(True)
636:                     item.setFont(font)
637:                 self._timeline.setItem(row, column, item)

639:     def _update_summary(self) -> None:
640:         mission = self.mission
641:         if mission is None:
642:             self._budget_label.setText("бюджет: —")
643:             self._mission_issues.clear()
644:             return
645:         errors = sum(1 for item in self._issues if item.severity is Severity.ERROR)
646:         warnings = len(self._issues) - errors
647:         ttl = "—" if self._budget.ttl_s is None else f"{self._budget.ttl_s:.1f} с"
648:         over = " · бюджет больше TTL" if self._budget.over_ttl else ""
649:         self._budget_label.setText(
650:             f"бюджет {self._budget.total_s:.1f} с · сумма {self._budget.sequential_s:.1f} с"
651:             f" · параллелизм {self._budget.parallel_width} · TTL {ttl}{over}\n"
652:             f"критический путь: {' → '.join(self._budget.critical_path) or '—'}\n"
653:             f"элементов {len(mission.elements)} · слоёв {self._graph.layer_count}"
654:             f" · ошибок {errors} · предупреждений {warnings}"
655:         )
656:         self._mission_issues.clear()
657:         for item in self._issues:
658:             entry = QListWidgetItem(f"{item.severity}: {item.path}: {item.message}")
659:             if item.severity is Severity.ERROR:
660:                 entry.setForeground(QBrush(_CYCLE_COLOR))
661:             self._mission_issues.addItem(entry)
662:         self._set_status(
663:             f"миссия {mission.mission_id}: ошибок {errors}, предупреждений {warnings}",
664:             error=errors > 0,
665:         )

722:         if self._selected_id is None or self.mission is None:

726:             self._store.set_value(self.element_field_path(name), value)
727:         except ProjectValidationError as exc:
728:             detail = exc.issues[0].message if exc.issues else str(exc)
729:             self._set_status(f"{name}: {detail}", error=True)
730:             self._show_element(self._selected_id)
731:             return False
732:         except ProjectError as exc:
733:             self._set_status(f"{name}: {exc}", error=True)
734:             self._show_element(self._selected_id)
735:             return False
736:         self.rebuild(self._store.document)

740:     def add_element(self, kind: str | None = None) -> bool:
741:         """Добавляет элемент выбранного типа в конец миссии."""
742:         mission = self.mission
743:         if mission is None:
744:             self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
745:             return False
746:         target = kind or self._type_combo.currentData()
747:         if not isinstance(target, str):
748:             return False
749:         element = self._default_element(target, mission)
750:         if element is None:
751:             self._set_status(f"для типа {target!r} в проекте нет зоны или камеры", error=True)
752:             return False

{"contents": """"Вкладка «Симуляция»: прогон миссии, метрики и события (T7-05, G7-01).

Вкладка не считает физику сама: она запускает тот же ``SimulationRunner``,
что и ``simorph sim run``, в фоновом потоке. Поэтому оконный режим не
блокирует интерфейс и даёт те же метрики, что headless-прогон.

Пока прогон идёт, панель состояния обновляется по таймеру: состояние
супервизора, время сцены и PC, такты, кадры, потери. После завершения
появляются интервалы план/факт, вклад ступеней и последние события.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDoubleSpinBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QPushButton,
    QSplitter,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

from simorph.core.models.exercise import ExerciseSection, Mission
from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
from simorph.core.simulation import (
    RunReport,
    SimulationConfig,
    SimulationRunner,
    RunState,
)
from simorph.settings import ApplicationSettings
from simorph.ui.commands import DocumentStore

__all__ = ["SimulationView"]

#: Сколько последних событий показывать в панели.
_EVENT_LIMIT = 200

#: Период обновления панели во время прогона, мс.
_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 100

#: Красный текст для ошибок.
_ERROR_STYLE = "color: #e5534b;"

#: Серый текст для подсказок.
_MUTED_STYLE = "color: #8f949c;"

#: Типы сенсоров, которые считаются камерой.
_CAMERA_SENSORS = frozenset({"camera", "stereo_camera"})


class SimulationView(QWidget):
    """Прогон миссии: состояние, план/факт и журнал событий."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: DocumentStore,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._store = store
        self._settings = settings
        self._document = store.document
        self._exercise_index = 0
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._disposed = False
        self._runner: SimulationRunner | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._report: RunReport | None = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self.setObjectName("editor_simulation")

        self._exercise_combo = QComboBox()
        self._exercise_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_exercise_changed)
        self._mission_combo = QComboBox()
        self._mission_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_mission_changed)

        self._scale_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._scale_spin.setRange(0.05, 8.0)
        self._scale_spin.setSingleStep(0.25)
        self._scale_spin.setValue(1.0)
        self._scale_spin.setDecimals(2)
        self._scale_spin.setToolTip("Целевой масштаб времени: 2x — вдвое быстрее плана")

        self._duration_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._duration_spin.setRange(0.0, 3600.0)
        self._duration_spin.setSingleStep(1.0)
        self._duration_spin.setValue(0.0)
        self._duration_spin.setDecimals(1)
        self._duration_spin.setToolTip("0 — длительность по бюджету миссии")

        self._pace_box = QCheckBox("Выдерживать план")
        self._pace_box.setChecked(True)
        self._pace_box.setToolTip("Снять — прогон на максимальной скорости")

        self._start_button = QPushButton("Запустить")
        self._start_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_run())
        self._pause_button = QPushButton("Пауза")
        self._pause_button.clicked.connect(self.toggle_pause)
        self._step_button = QPushButton("Шаг")
        self._step_button.clicked.connect(self.step_once)
        self._stop_button = QPushButton("Стоп")
        self._stop_button.clicked.connect(self.stop_run)
        for button in (self._pause_button, self._step_button, self._stop_button):
            button.setEnabled(False)

        self._state_label = QLabel("прогон не запущен")
        self._state_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._state_label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        self._clock_label = QLabel("—")
        self._clock_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._frames_label = QLabel("—")
        self._frames_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._supervisor_label = QLabel("—")
        self._supervisor_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._stage_table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self._stage_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Ступень", "План, мс", "Факт, мс", "Перерасход, мс"]
        )
        self._stage_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._stage_table.setColumnWidth(0, 140)

        self._interval_table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self._interval_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["#", "Сцена, с", "PC, с", "k", "План, мс", "Факт, мс"]
        )
        self._interval_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._interval_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        for column in range(6):
            self._interval_table.setColumnWidth(column, 90)

        self._events = QListWidget()

        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._poll)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(self._build_splitter(), 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)

        self._sync_combos()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Упражнение:"))
        row.addWidget(self._exercise_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Миссия:"))
        row.addWidget(self._mission_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Масштаб:"))
        row.addWidget(self._scale_spin)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Длительность, с:"))
        row.addWidget(self._duration_spin)
        row.addWidget(self._pace_box)
        row.addWidget(self._start_button)
        row.addWidget(self._pause_button)
        row.addWidget(self._step_button)
        row.addWidget(self._stop_button)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    def _build_splitter(self) -> QSplitter:
        left = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left)
        left_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._state_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._clock_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._frames_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._supervisor_label)
        stage_title = QLabel("Вклад ступеней")
        stage_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        left_layout.addWidget(stage_title)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._stage_table, 1)

        right = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right)
        right_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        interval_title = QLabel("Интервалы план/факт")
        interval_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(interval_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._interval_table, 1)
        events_title = QLabel("События")
        events_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(events_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._events, 1)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left)
        splitter.addWidget(right)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 1)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        return splitter

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def document(self) -> ProjectDocument:
        return self._document

    @property
    def runner(self) -> SimulationRunner | None:
        return self._runner

    @property
    def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
        return self._report

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self._thread is not None and self._thread.is_alive()

    @property
    def state_text(self) -> str:
        return self._state_label.text()

    @property
    def clock_text(self) -> str:
        return self._clock_label.text()

    @property
    def frames_text(self) -> str:
        return self._frames_label.text()

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    @property
    def exercise_index(self) -> int:
        return self._exercise_index

    @property
    def mission_index(self) -> int:
        return self._mission_index

    @property
    def exercise(self) -> ExerciseSection | None:
        if 0 <= self._exercise_index < len(self._document.exercises):
            return self._document.exercises[self._exercise_index]
        return None

    @property
    def mission(self) -> Mission | None:
        exercise = self.exercise
        if exercise is None or not 0 <= self._mission_index < len(exercise.missions):
            return None
        return exercise.missions[self._mission_index]

    def interval_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы интервалов план/факт."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._interval_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._interval_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._interval_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def stage_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы вклада ступеней."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._stage_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._stage_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._stage_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def event_rows(self) -> list[str]:
        """Тексты событий в журнале."""
        return [self._events.item(index).text() for index in range(self._events.count())]

    # --- документ -------------------------------------------------------

    def rebuild(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
        """Подхватывает новый документ, не сбрасывая выбранные индексы."""
        self._document = document
        self._sync_combos()

    def set_selection(self, exercise: int, mission: int) -> bool:
        """Переключает упражнение и миссию по индексам."""
        if not 0 <= exercise < len(self._document.exercises):
            return False
        missions = self._document.exercises[exercise].missions
        if not 0 <= mission < len(missions):
            return False
        self._exercise_index = exercise
        self._mission_index = mission
        self._sync_combos()
        return True

    def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
        exercises = self._document.exercises
        self._exercise_index = min(self._exercise_index, max(0, len(exercises) - 1))
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._exercise_combo.clear()
        for index, exercise in enumerate(exercises):
            self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
        self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)

        missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
        self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._mission_combo.clear()
        for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
            self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
        self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_exercise_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._exercise_index = index
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._sync_combos()

    def _on_mission_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._mission_index = index

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def start_run(self, duration_s: float | None = None) -> bool:
        """Запускает прогон в фоновом потоке."""
        if self.running:
            self._set_status("прогон уже идёт", error=True)
            return False
        mission = self.mission
        if mission is None:
            self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
            return False
        duration = duration_s if duration_s is not None else self._duration_spin.value()
        config = SimulationConfig(
            scale=self._scale_spin.value(),
            duration_s=duration if duration > 0.0 else None,
            pace=self._pace_box.isChecked(),
        )
        try:
            runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=self._agent(mission), config=config)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._set_status(f"параметры прогона: {exc}", error=True)
            return False
        self._runner = runner
        self._report = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self._events.clear()
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._state_label.setText("подготовка")
        self._set_status("прогон запущен")
        self._start_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._execute, name="simulation", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        self._timer.start()
        return True

    def _execute(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        try:
            self._report = runner.run()
        finally:
            runner.close()

    def toggle_pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза или продолжение; в паузе доступен шаг вперёд."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return False
        if runner.state is RunState.RUNNING:
            if not runner.pause():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Продолжить")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(True)
            self._set_status("пауза")
            self._poll()
            return True
        if runner.state is RunState.PAUSED:
            if not runner.resume():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._set_status("продолжение")
            return True
        return False

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную при паузе."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None or not runner.step_once():
            return False
        self._poll()
        return True

    def stop_run(self) -> None:

            return False

        if mission is None:
            self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
            return False
        duration = duration_s if duration_s is not None else self._duration_spin.value()
        config = SimulationConfig(
            scale=self._scale_spin.value(),
            duration_s=duration if duration > 0.0 else None,
            pace=self._pace_box.isChecked(),

        thread = self._thread
        if thread is None:

        thread.join(timeout_s)
        finished = not thread.is_alive()

            self._timer.stop()
            self._poll()
        return finished

            f" · очередь {supervisor.queue.depth} (пик {supervisor.queue.peak})"
        )

    def _append_events(self) -> None:

            )

        self._stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        report = self._report
        if report is None:
            self._set_status("прогон завершился без отчёта", error=True)
            return
        self._fill_intervals(report)
        self._fill_stages(report)
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {report.state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {report.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · PC {report.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {report.frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · k p50 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f}"
            f", p95 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {report.frames.get('pushed', 0)}"
            f" · принято {report.frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {report.frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
        )
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"событий {len(report.events)}"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · причина: {report.reason or '—'}"
        )
        if report.ok:
            self._set_status(report.summary())
        else:
            self._set_status(f"{report.state}: {report.reason or 'прогон не завершён'}", error=True)

    def _fill_intervals(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        samples = report.metrics.get("samples", [])
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(len(samples))
        for row, sample in enumerate(samples):
            stages = sample.get("stages", {})
            plan = sum(float(item.get("plan_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            actual = sum(float(item.get("actual_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            values = (
                str(sample.get("index", row)),
                f"{float(sample.get('scene_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('wall_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('k', 1.0)):.2f}",
                f"{plan:.2f}",
                f"{actual:.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._interval_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _fill_stages(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        stages = report.metrics.get("stages", {})
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(len(stages))
        for row, (name, item) in enumerate(stages.items()):
            values = (
                name,
                f"{float(item.get('plan_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(item.get('actual_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(item.get('overrun_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._stage_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _agent(self, mission: Mission) -> Any:
        for agent in self._document.agents:
            if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
                return agent
        return None

    # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------

    def _set_status(self, text: str, *, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE if error else "")
        self._status_label.setText(text)

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает прогон и отключает таймер у закрытой вкладки."""
        self._disposed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is not None:
            runner.request_stop()
