"""Вкладка «Симуляция»: прогон миссии, метрики и события (T7-05, G7-01).

Вкладка не считает физику сама: она запускает тот же ``SimulationRunner``,
что и ``simorph sim run``, в фоновом потоке. Поэтому оконный режим не
блокирует интерфейс и даёт те же метрики, что headless-прогон.

Пока прогон идёт, панель состояния обновляется по таймеру: состояние
супервизора, время сцены и PC, такты, кадры, потери. После завершения
появляются интервалы план/факт, вклад ступеней и последние события.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDoubleSpinBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QPushButton,
    QSplitter,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

from simorph.core.models.exercise import ExerciseSection, Mission
from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
from simorph.core.simulation import (
    RunReport,
    SimulationConfig,
    SimulationRunner,
    RunState,
)
from simorph.settings import ApplicationSettings
from simorph.ui.commands import DocumentStore

__all__ = ["SimulationView"]

#: Сколько последних событий показывать в панели.
_EVENT_LIMIT = 200

#: Период обновления панели во время прогона, мс.
_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 100

#: Красный текст для ошибок.
_ERROR_STYLE = "color: #e5534b;"

#: Серый текст для подсказок.
_MUTED_STYLE = "color: #8f949c;"

#: Типы сенсоров, которые считаются камерой.
_CAMERA_SENSORS = frozenset({"camera", "stereo_camera"})


class SimulationView(QWidget):
    """Прогон миссии: состояние, план/факт и журнал событий."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: DocumentStore,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._store = store
        self._settings = settings
        self._document = store.document
        self._exercise_index = 0
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._disposed = False
        self._runner: SimulationRunner | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._report: RunReport | None = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self.setObjectName("editor_simulation")

        self._exercise_combo = QComboBox()
        self._exercise_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_exercise_changed)
        self._mission_combo = QComboBox()
        self._mission_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_mission_changed)

        self._scale_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._scale_spin.setRange(0.05, 8.0)
        self._scale_spin.setSingleStep(0.25)
        self._scale_spin.setValue(1.0)
        self._scale_spin.setDecimals(2)
        self._scale_spin.setToolTip("Целевой масштаб времени: 2x — вдвое быстрее плана")

        self._duration_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._duration_spin.setRange(0.0, 3600.0)
        self._duration_spin.setSingleStep(1.0)
        self._duration_spin.setValue(0.0)
        self._duration_spin.setDecimals(1)
        self._duration_spin.setToolTip("0 — длительность по бюджету миссии")

        self._pace_box = QCheckBox("Выдерживать план")
        self._pace_box.setChecked(True)
        self._pace_box.setToolTip("Снять — прогон на максимальной скорости")

        self._start_button = QPushButton("Запустить")
        self._start_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_run())
        self._pause_button = QPushButton("Пауза")
        self._pause_button.clicked.connect(self.toggle_pause)
        self._step_button = QPushButton("Шаг")
        self._step_button.clicked.connect(self.step_once)
        self._stop_button = QPushButton("Стоп")
        self._stop_button.clicked.connect(self.stop_run)
        for button in (self._pause_button, self._step_button, self._stop_button):
            button.setEnabled(False)

        self._state_label = QLabel("прогон не запущен")
        self._state_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._state_label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        self._clock_label = QLabel("—")
        self._clock_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._frames_label = QLabel("—")
        self._frames_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._supervisor_label = QLabel("—")
        self._supervisor_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._stage_table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self._stage_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Ступень", "План, мс", "Факт, мс", "Перерасход, мс"]
        )
        self._stage_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._stage_table.setColumnWidth(0, 140)

        self._interval_table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self._interval_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["#", "Сцена, с", "PC, с", "k", "План, мс", "Факт, мс"]
        )
        self._interval_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._interval_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        for column in range(6):
            self._interval_table.setColumnWidth(column, 90)

        self._events = QListWidget()

        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._poll)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(self._build_splitter(), 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)

        self._sync_combos()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Упражнение:"))
        row.addWidget(self._exercise_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Миссия:"))
        row.addWidget(self._mission_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Масштаб:"))
        row.addWidget(self._scale_spin)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Длительность, с:"))
        row.addWidget(self._duration_spin)
        row.addWidget(self._pace_box)
        row.addWidget(self._start_button)
        row.addWidget(self._pause_button)
        row.addWidget(self._step_button)
        row.addWidget(self._stop_button)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    def _build_splitter(self) -> QSplitter:
        left = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left)
        left_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._state_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._clock_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._frames_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._supervisor_label)
        stage_title = QLabel("Вклад ступеней")
        stage_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        left_layout.addWidget(stage_title)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._stage_table, 1)

        right = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right)
        right_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        interval_title = QLabel("Интервалы план/факт")
        interval_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(interval_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._interval_table, 1)
        events_title = QLabel("События")
        events_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(events_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._events, 1)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left)
        splitter.addWidget(right)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 1)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        return splitter

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def document(self) -> ProjectDocument:
        return self._document

    @property
    def runner(self) -> SimulationRunner | None:
        return self._runner

    @property
    def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
        return self._report

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self._thread is not None and self._thread.is_alive()

    @property
    def state_text(self) -> str:
        return self._state_label.text()

    @property
    def clock_text(self) -> str:
        return self._clock_label.text()

    @property
    def frames_text(self) -> str:
        return self._frames_label.text()

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    @property
    def exercise_index(self) -> int:
        return self._exercise_index

    @property
    def mission_index(self) -> int:
        return self._mission_index

    @property
    def exercise(self) -> ExerciseSection | None:
        if 0 <= self._exercise_index < len(self._document.exercises):
            return self._document.exercises[self._exercise_index]
        return None

    @property
    def mission(self) -> Mission | None:
        exercise = self.exercise
        if exercise is None or not 0 <= self._mission_index < len(exercise.missions):
            return None
        return exercise.missions[self._mission_index]

    def interval_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы интервалов план/факт."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._interval_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._interval_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._interval_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def stage_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы вклада ступеней."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._stage_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._stage_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._stage_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def event_rows(self) -> list[str]:
        """Тексты событий в журнале."""
        return [self._events.item(index).text() for index in range(self._events.count())]

    # --- документ -------------------------------------------------------

    def rebuild(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
        """Подхватывает новый документ, не сбрасывая выбранные индексы."""
        self._document = document
        self._sync_combos()

    def set_selection(self, exercise: int, mission: int) -> bool:
        """Переключает упражнение и миссию по индексам."""
        if not 0 <= exercise < len(self._document.exercises):
            return False
        missions = self._document.exercises[exercise].missions
        if not 0 <= mission < len(missions):
            return False
        self._exercise_index = exercise
        self._mission_index = mission
        self._sync_combos()
        return True

    def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
        exercises = self._document.exercises
        self._exercise_index = min(self._exercise_index, max(0, len(exercises) - 1))
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._exercise_combo.clear()
        for index, exercise in enumerate(exercises):
            self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
        self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)

        missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
        self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._mission_combo.clear()
        for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
            self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
        self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_exercise_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._exercise_index = index
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._sync_combos()

    def _on_mission_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._mission_index = index

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def start_run(self, duration_s: float | None = None) -> bool:
        """Запускает прогон в фоновом потоке."""
        if self.running:
            self._set_status("прогон уже идёт", error=True)
            return False
        mission = self.mission
        if mission is None:
            self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
            return False
        duration = duration_s if duration_s is not None else self._duration_spin.value()
        config = SimulationConfig(
            scale=self._scale_spin.value(),
            duration_s=duration if duration > 0.0 else None,
            pace=self._pace_box.isChecked(),
        )
        try:
            runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=self._agent(mission), config=config)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._set_status(f"параметры прогона: {exc}", error=True)
            return False
        self._runner = runner
        self._report = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self._events.clear()
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._state_label.setText("подготовка")
        self._set_status("прогон запущен")
        self._start_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._execute, name="simulation", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        self._timer.start()
        return True

    def _execute(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        try:
            self._report = runner.run()
        finally:
            runner.close()

    def toggle_pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза или продолжение; в паузе доступен шаг вперёд."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return False
        if runner.state is RunState.RUNNING:
            if not runner.pause():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Продолжить")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(True)
            self._set_status("пауза")
            self._poll()
            return True
        if runner.state is RunState.PAUSED:
            if not runner.resume():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._set_status("продолжение")
            return True
        return False

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную при паузе."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None or not runner.step_once():
            return False
        self._poll()
        return True

    def stop_run(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает прогон: супервизор переходит в ``interrupted``."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is not None:
            runner.request_stop()
        self._set_status("остановка…")

    def wait(self, timeout_s: float = 10.0) -> bool:
        """Ждёт завершения фонового потока (для тестов и закрытия окна)."""
        thread = self._thread
        if thread is None:
            return True
        thread.join(timeout_s)
        finished = not thread.is_alive()
        if finished:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._poll()
        return finished

    def _poll(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        state = runner.state
        clock = runner.clock
        metrics = runner.metrics
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {clock.sim_time_s:.2f} с · PC {clock.wall_time_s:.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {clock.ticks} · k {clock.scale_factor():.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {metrics.frames_pushed}"
            f" · принято {metrics.frames_consumed}"
            f" · потерь {metrics.frames_dropped}"
        )
        supervisor = runner.supervisor
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"элементов пройдено {len(supervisor.entered)} из {len(supervisor.windows)}"
            f" · очередь {supervisor.queue.depth} (пик {supervisor.queue.peak})"
        )
        self._append_events()
        if not self.running:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._finish()

    def _append_events(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        events = runner.events.events
        for event in events[self._seen_events :]:
            item = QListWidgetItem(
                f"{event.t_monotonic_ns} · {event.kind} · {event.message}"
            )
            self._events.addItem(item)
        self._seen_events = len(events)
        while self._events.count() > _EVENT_LIMIT:
            self._events.takeItem(0)
        if self._events.count():
            self._events.scrollToBottom()

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        self._start_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        report = self._report
        if report is None:
            self._set_status("прогон завершился без отчёта", error=True)
            return
        self._fill_intervals(report)
        self._fill_stages(report)
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {report.state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {report.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · PC {report.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {report.frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · k p50 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f}"
            f", p95 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {report.frames.get('pushed', 0)}"
            f" · принято {report.frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {report.frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
        )
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"событий {len(report.events)}"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · причина: {report.reason or '—'}"
        )
        if report.ok:
            self._set_status(report.summary())
        else:
            self._set_status(f"{report.state}: {report.reason or 'прогон не завершён'}", error=True)

    def _fill_intervals(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        samples = report.metrics.get("samples", [])
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(len(samples))
        for row, sample in enumerate(samples):
            stages = sample.get("stages", {})
            plan = sum(float(item.get("plan_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            actual = sum(float(item.get("actual_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            values = (
                str(sample.get("index", row)),
                f"{float(sample.get('scene_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('wall_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('k', 1.0)):.2f}",
                f"{plan:.2f}",
                f"{actual:.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._interval_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _fill_stages(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        stages = report.metrics.get("stages", {})

    def state_text(self) -> str:

    def clock_text(self) -> str:

        """Строки таблицы интервалов план/факт."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._interval_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._interval_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._interval_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]

    def stage_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы вклада ступеней."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []

                self._stage_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._stage_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]

    def set_selection(self, exercise: int, mission: int) -> bool:
        """Переключает упражнение и миссию по индексам."""
        if not 0 <= exercise < len(self._document.exercises):
            return False
        missions = self._document.exercises[exercise].missions
        if not 0 <= mission < len(missions):
            return False
        self._exercise_index = exercise
        self._mission_index = mission
        self._sync_combos()
        return True

    def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
        exercises = self._document.exercises
        self._exercise_index = min(self._exercise_index, max(0, len(exercises) - 1))
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._exercise_combo.clear()
        for index, exercise in enumerate(exercises):
            self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
        self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)

        missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
        self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._mission_combo.clear()
        for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
            self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
        self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_exercise_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._exercise_index = index
        self._mission_index = 0

    def _on_mission_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def start_run(self, duration_s: float | None = None) -> bool:
        """Запускает прогон в фоновом потоке."""
        if self.running:
            self._set_status("прогон уже идёт", error=True)
            return False
        mission = self.mission
        if mission is None:
            self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
            return False
        duration = duration_s if duration_s is not None else self._duration_spin.value()
        config = SimulationConfig(
            scale=self._scale_spin.value(),
            duration_s=duration if duration > 0.0 else None,
            pace=self._pace_box.isChecked(),
        )
        try:
            runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=self._agent(mission), config=config)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._set_status(f"параметры прогона: {exc}", error=True)
            return False
        self._runner = runner
        self._report = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self._events.clear()
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._state_label.setText("подготовка")
        self._set_status("прогон запущен")
        self._start_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._execute, name="simulation", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        self._timer.start()
        return True

    def _execute(self) -> None:

        if runner is None:
            return
        try:
            self._report = runner.run()
        finally:
            runner.close()

    def toggle_pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза или продолжение; в паузе доступен шаг вперёд."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return False
        if runner.state is RunState.RUNNING:
            if not runner.pause():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Продолжить")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(True)
            self._set_status("пауза")
            self._poll()
            return True
        if runner.state is RunState.PAUSED:
            if not runner.resume():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._set_status("продолжение")
            return True
        return False

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную при паузе."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None or not runner.step_once():

        return True

    def stop_run(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает прогон: супервизор переходит в ``interrupted``."""
        runner = self._runner

            runner.request_stop()

    def wait(self, timeout_s: float = 10.0) -> bool:
        """Ждёт завершения фонового потока (для тестов и закрытия окна)."""
        thread = self._thread
        if thread is None:
            return True
        thread.join(timeout_s)
        finished = not thread.is_alive()
        if finished:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._poll()
        return finished

    def _poll(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        state = runner.state
        clock = runner.clock
        metrics = runner.metrics
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {clock.sim_time_s:.2f} с · PC {clock.wall_time_s:.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {clock.ticks} · k {clock.scale_factor():.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {metrics.frames_pushed}"
            f" · принято {metrics.frames_consumed}"
            f" · потерь {metrics.frames_dropped}"
        )
        supervisor = runner.supervisor
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"элементов пройдено {len(supervisor.entered)} из {len(supervisor.windows)}"
            f" · очередь {supervisor.queue.depth} (пик {supervisor.queue.peak})"
        )
        self._append_events()
        if not self.running:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._finish()

    def _append_events(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        events = runner.events.events
        for event in events[self._seen_events :]:
            item = QListWidgetItem(
                f"{event.t_monotonic_ns} · {event.kind} · {event.message}"
            )
            self._events.addItem(item)
        self._seen_events = len(events)
        while self._events.count() > _EVENT_LIMIT:
            self._events.takeItem(0)
        if self._events.count():
            self._events.scrollToBottom()

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        self._start_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        report = self._report
        if report is None:
            self._set_status("прогон завершился без отчёта", error=True)
            return
        self._fill_intervals(report)
        self._fill_stages(report)
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {report.state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {report.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · PC {report.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {report.frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · k p50 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f}"
            f", p95 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {report.frames.get('pushed', 0)}"
            f" · принято {report.frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {report.frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
        )
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"событий {len(report.events)}"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · причина: {report.reason or '—'}"
        )
        if report.ok:
            self._set_status(report.summary())
        else:
            self._set_status(f"{report.state}: {report.reason or 'прогон не завершён'}", error=True)

    def _fill_intervals(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        samples = report.metrics.get("samples", [])
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(len(samples))
        for row, sample in enumerate(samples):
            stages = sample.get("stages", {})
            plan = sum(float(item.get("plan_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            actual = sum(float(item.get("actual_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            values = (
                str(sample.get("index", row)),
                f"{float(sample.get('scene_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('wall_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('k', 1.0)):.2f}",
                f"{plan:.2f}",
                f"{actual:.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._interval_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _fill_stages(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        stages = report.metrics.get("stages", {})
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(len(stages))
        for row, (name, item) in enumerate(stages.items()):
            values = (
                name,

                f"{float(item.get('overrun_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._stage_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _agent(self, mission: Mission) -> Any:
        for agent in self._document.agents:
            if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
                return agent
        return None

    # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------

    def _set_status(self, text: str, *, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE if error else "")
        self._status_label.setText(text)

    def dispose(self) -> None:

_EVENT_LIMIT = 200

class SimulationView(QWidget):
    """Прогон миссии: состояние, план/факт и журнал событий."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: DocumentStore,
        settings: ApplicationSettings,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._store = store
        self._settings = settings
        self._document = store.document
        self._exercise_index = 0
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._disposed = False
        self._runner: SimulationRunner | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._report: RunReport | None = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self.setObjectName("editor_simulation")

        self._exercise_combo = QComboBox()
        self._exercise_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_exercise_changed)
        self._mission_combo = QComboBox()
        self._mission_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_mission_changed)

        self._scale_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._scale_spin.setRange(0.05, 8.0)
        self._scale_spin.setSingleStep(0.25)
        self._scale_spin.setValue(1.0)
        self._scale_spin.setDecimals(2)
        self._scale_spin.setToolTip("Целевой масштаб времени: 2x — вдвое быстрее плана")

        self._duration_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self._duration_spin.setRange(0.0, 3600.0)
        self._duration_spin.setSingleStep(1.0)
        self._duration_spin.setValue(0.0)
        self._duration_spin.setDecimals(1)
        self._duration_spin.setToolTip("0 — длительность по бюджету миссии")

        self._pace_box = QCheckBox("Выдерживать план")
        self._pace_box.setChecked(True)
        self._pace_box.setToolTip("Снять — прогон на максимальной скорости")

        self._start_button = QPushButton("Запустить")
        self._start_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_run())
        self._pause_button = QPushButton("Пауза")
        self._pause_button.clicked.connect(self.toggle_pause)
        self._step_button = QPushButton("Шаг")
        self._step_button.clicked.connect(self.step_once)
        self._stop_button = QPushButton("Стоп")
        self._stop_button.clicked.connect(self.stop_run)
        for button in (self._pause_button, self._step_button, self._stop_button):
            button.setEnabled(False)

        self._state_label = QLabel("прогон не запущен")
        self._state_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._state_label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        self._clock_label = QLabel("—")
        self._clock_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._frames_label = QLabel("—")
        self._frames_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._supervisor_label = QLabel("—")
        self._supervisor_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._stage_table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self._stage_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Ступень", "План, мс", "Факт, мс", "Перерасход, мс"]
        )
        self._stage_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._stage_table.setColumnWidth(0, 140)

        self._interval_table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self._interval_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["#", "Сцена, с", "PC, с", "k", "План, мс", "Факт, мс"]
        )
        self._interval_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self._interval_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        for column in range(6):
            self._interval_table.setColumnWidth(column, 90)

        self._events = QListWidget()

        self._status_label = QLabel("")
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)

        self._timer = QTimer(self)

        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._poll)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        layout.addLayout(self._build_toolbar())
        layout.addWidget(self._build_splitter(), 1)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)

        self._sync_combos()

    # --- построение -----------------------------------------------------

    def _build_toolbar(self) -> QHBoxLayout:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Упражнение:"))
        row.addWidget(self._exercise_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Миссия:"))
        row.addWidget(self._mission_combo)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Масштаб:"))
        row.addWidget(self._scale_spin)
        row.addWidget(QLabel("Длительность, с:"))
        row.addWidget(self._duration_spin)
        row.addWidget(self._pace_box)
        row.addWidget(self._start_button)
        row.addWidget(self._pause_button)
        row.addWidget(self._step_button)
        row.addWidget(self._stop_button)
        row.addStretch(1)
        return row

    def _build_splitter(self) -> QSplitter:
        left = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left)
        left_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._state_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._clock_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._frames_label)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._supervisor_label)
        stage_title = QLabel("Вклад ступеней")
        stage_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        left_layout.addWidget(stage_title)
        left_layout.addWidget(self._stage_table, 1)

        right = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right)
        right_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        interval_title = QLabel("Интервалы план/факт")
        interval_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(interval_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._interval_table, 1)
        events_title = QLabel("События")
        events_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold;")
        right_layout.addWidget(events_title)
        right_layout.addWidget(self._events, 1)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left)
        splitter.addWidget(right)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 1)
        splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        return splitter

    # --- состояние ------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def document(self) -> ProjectDocument:
        return self._document

    @property
    def runner(self) -> SimulationRunner | None:
        return self._runner

    @property
    def report(self) -> RunReport | None:
        return self._report

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self._thread is not None and self._thread.is_alive()

    @property
    def state_text(self) -> str:
        return self._state_label.text()

    @property
    def clock_text(self) -> str:
        return self._clock_label.text()

    @property
    def frames_text(self) -> str:
        return self._frames_label.text()

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return self._status_label.text()

    @property
    def exercise_index(self) -> int:
        return self._exercise_index

    @property
    def mission_index(self) -> int:
        return self._mission_index

    @property
    def exercise(self) -> ExerciseSection | None:
        if 0 <= self._exercise_index < len(self._document.exercises):
            return self._document.exercises[self._exercise_index]
        return None

    @property
    def mission(self) -> Mission | None:
        exercise = self.exercise
        if exercise is None or not 0 <= self._mission_index < len(exercise.missions):
            return None
        return exercise.missions[self._mission_index]

    def interval_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы интервалов план/факт."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._interval_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._interval_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._interval_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def stage_rows(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]:
        """Строки таблицы вклада ступеней."""
        rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = []
        for row in range(self._stage_table.rowCount()):
            values = [
                self._stage_table.item(row, column)
                for column in range(self._stage_table.columnCount())
            ]
            if any(item is None for item in values):
                continue
            rows.append(tuple(item.text() for item in values if item is not None))  # type: ignore[misc]
        return rows

    def event_rows(self) -> list[str]:
        """Тексты событий в журнале."""
        return [self._events.item(index).text() for index in range(self._events.count())]

    # --- документ -------------------------------------------------------

    def rebuild(self, document: ProjectDocument) -> None:
        """Подхватывает новый документ, не сбрасывая выбранные индексы."""
        self._document = document
        self._sync_combos()

    def set_selection(self, exercise: int, mission: int) -> bool:
        """Переключает упражнение и миссию по индексам."""
        if not 0 <= exercise < len(self._document.exercises):
            return False
        missions = self._document.exercises[exercise].missions
        if not 0 <= mission < len(missions):
            return False
        self._exercise_index = exercise
        self._mission_index = mission
        self._sync_combos()
        return True

    def _sync_combos(self) -> None:
        exercises = self._document.exercises
        self._exercise_index = min(self._exercise_index, max(0, len(exercises) - 1))
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._exercise_combo.clear()
        for index, exercise in enumerate(exercises):
            self._exercise_combo.addItem(exercise.exercise_id, index)
        self._exercise_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._exercise_index if exercises else -1)
        self._exercise_combo.blockSignals(False)

        missions = exercises[self._exercise_index].missions if exercises else []
        self._mission_index = min(self._mission_index, max(0, len(missions) - 1))
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self._mission_combo.clear()
        for index, mission in enumerate(missions):
            self._mission_combo.addItem(mission.mission_id, index)
        self._mission_combo.setCurrentIndex(self._mission_index if missions else -1)
        self._mission_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_exercise_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._exercise_index = index
        self._mission_index = 0
        self._sync_combos()

    def _on_mission_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0 or self.running:
            return
        self._mission_index = index

    # --- прогон ---------------------------------------------------------

    def start_run(self, duration_s: float | None = None) -> bool:
        """Запускает прогон в фоновом потоке."""
        if self.running:
            self._set_status("прогон уже идёт", error=True)
            return False
        mission = self.mission
        if mission is None:
            self._set_status("в упражнении нет миссий", error=True)
            return False
        duration = duration_s if duration_s is not None else self._duration_spin.value()
        config = SimulationConfig(
            scale=self._scale_spin.value(),
            duration_s=duration if duration > 0.0 else None,
            pace=self._pace_box.isChecked(),
        )
        try:
            runner = SimulationRunner(mission, agent=self._agent(mission), config=config)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._set_status(f"параметры прогона: {exc}", error=True)
            return False
        self._runner = runner
        self._report = None
        self._seen_events = 0
        self._events.clear()
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(0)
        self._state_label.setText("подготовка")
        self._set_status("прогон запущен")
        self._start_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._execute, name="simulation", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        self._timer.start()
        return True

    def _execute(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        try:
            self._report = runner.run()
        finally:
            runner.close()

    def toggle_pause(self) -> bool:
        """Пауза или продолжение; в паузе доступен шаг вперёд."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return False
        if runner.state is RunState.RUNNING:
            if not runner.pause():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Продолжить")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(True)
            self._set_status("пауза")
            self._poll()
            return True
        if runner.state is RunState.PAUSED:
            if not runner.resume():
                return False
            self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
            self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._set_status("продолжение")
            return True
        return False

    def step_once(self) -> bool:
        """Один такт вручную при паузе."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None or not runner.step_once():
            return False
        self._poll()
        return True

    def stop_run(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает прогон: супервизор переходит в ``interrupted``."""
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is not None:
            runner.request_stop()
        self._set_status("остановка…")

    def wait(self, timeout_s: float = 10.0) -> bool:
        """Ждёт завершения фонового потока (для тестов и закрытия окна)."""
        thread = self._thread
        if thread is None:
            return True
        thread.join(timeout_s)
        finished = not thread.is_alive()
        if finished:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._poll()
        return finished

    def _poll(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        state = runner.state
        clock = runner.clock
        metrics = runner.metrics
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {clock.sim_time_s:.2f} с · PC {clock.wall_time_s:.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {clock.ticks} · k {clock.scale_factor():.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {metrics.frames_pushed}"
            f" · принято {metrics.frames_consumed}"
            f" · потерь {metrics.frames_dropped}"
        )
        supervisor = runner.supervisor
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"элементов пройдено {len(supervisor.entered)} из {len(supervisor.windows)}"
            f" · очередь {supervisor.queue.depth} (пик {supervisor.queue.peak})"
        )
        self._append_events()
        if not self.running:
            self._timer.stop()
            self._finish()

    def _append_events(self) -> None:
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is None:
            return
        events = runner.events.events
        for event in events[self._seen_events :]:
            item = QListWidgetItem(
                f"{event.t_monotonic_ns} · {event.kind} · {event.message}"
            )
            self._events.addItem(item)
        self._seen_events = len(events)
        while self._events.count() > _EVENT_LIMIT:
            self._events.takeItem(0)
        if self._events.count():
            self._events.scrollToBottom()

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        self._start_button.setEnabled(True)
        self._pause_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._pause_button.setText("Пауза")
        self._step_button.setEnabled(False)
        self._stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        report = self._report
        if report is None:
            self._set_status("прогон завершился без отчёта", error=True)
            return
        self._fill_intervals(report)
        self._fill_stages(report)
        self._state_label.setText(f"состояние: {report.state}")
        self._clock_label.setText(
            f"сцена {report.clock.get('sim_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · PC {report.clock.get('wall_time_s', 0.0):.2f} с"
            f" · тактов {report.frames.get('attempted', 0)}"
            f" · k p50 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p50', 1.0):.2f}"
            f", p95 {report.metrics.get('k', {}).get('p95', 1.0):.2f}"
        )
        self._frames_label.setText(
            f"кадры: отправлено {report.frames.get('pushed', 0)}"
            f" · принято {report.frames.get('consumed', 0)}"
            f" · потерь {report.frames.get('dropped', 0)}"
            f" ({report.loss_ratio * 100:.2f}%)"
        )
        self._supervisor_label.setText(
            f"событий {len(report.events)}"
            f" · интервалов {report.metrics.get('intervals', 0)}"
            f" · причина: {report.reason or '—'}"
        )
        if report.ok:
            self._set_status(report.summary())
        else:
            self._set_status(f"{report.state}: {report.reason or 'прогон не завершён'}", error=True)

    def _fill_intervals(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        samples = report.metrics.get("samples", [])
        self._interval_table.setRowCount(len(samples))
        for row, sample in enumerate(samples):
            stages = sample.get("stages", {})
            plan = sum(float(item.get("plan_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            actual = sum(float(item.get("actual_ms", 0.0)) for item in stages.values())
            values = (
                str(sample.get("index", row)),
                f"{float(sample.get('scene_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('wall_time_s', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(sample.get('k', 1.0)):.2f}",
                f"{plan:.2f}",
                f"{actual:.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._interval_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _fill_stages(self, report: RunReport) -> None:
        stages = report.metrics.get("stages", {})
        self._stage_table.setRowCount(len(stages))
        for row, (name, item) in enumerate(stages.items()):
            values = (
                name,
                f"{float(item.get('plan_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(item.get('actual_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
                f"{float(item.get('overrun_ms', 0.0)):.2f}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                self._stage_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(text))

    def _agent(self, mission: Mission) -> Any:
        for agent in self._document.agents:
            if agent.agent_id == mission.agent_id:
                return agent
        return None

    # --- служебное ------------------------------------------------------

    def _set_status(self, text: str, *, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self._status_label.setStyleSheet(_ERROR_STYLE if error else "")
        self._status_label.setText(text)

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        """Останавливает прогон и отключает таймер у закрытой вкладки."""
        self._disposed = True
        self._timer.stop()
        runner = self._runner
        if runner is not None:
            runner.request_stop()
        thread = self._thread
        if thread is not None:
            thread.join(1.0)

message.content:
Also window close should stop simulation? `dispose` on tabs closed; app close likely closes tabs? Check closeEvent. Not critical; `dispose` handles.

Now test UI smoke in offscreen: instantiate MainWindow, open simulation, start with duration 0.2, wait. But `start_run` doesn't expose duration through UI except `start_run(0.2)`. Test directly.

Before tests, run ruff on new files and mypy. But first, a quick manual smoke via python -c is hard. Let's write the test files now, then run pytest.

Test plan:
1. `tests/test_sim_clock.py` — ticks, scale, k, pause/resume/stop, invalid scale/step, ticks_for_wall, to_dict, step semantics via runner? Clock itself no step. Test `tick` with wall_s.
2. `tests/test_sim_transport.py` — FramePacket checksum stable, with_timing; FrameRing push/pop/drain/order, full behavior, drop_oldest, stats, shared memory name (may be shared or fallback), payload truncation, close idempotent.
3. `tests/test_sim_events.py` — emit monotonic, ordered, kinds, to_payload, clear, injected clock.
4. `tests/test_sim_supervisor.py` — transitions all states, illegal transition raises, windows from budget, advance enters, complete, transactions, queue, to_dict, reset.
5. `tests/test_sim_degradation.py` — inactive pass-through, loss, latency/desync, jitter changes payload, bounds validation, stats.
6. `tests/test_sim_metrics.py` — ScaleRecorder intervals, k, flush, RunMetrics percentile/histogram/stage totals/summary/to_dict, empty.
7. `tests/test_sim_replay.py` — write/read roundtrip, replay ok, tampered checksum mismatch, bad timing, missing file/corrupt → ProjectError, empty stream.
8. `tests/test_sim_runner.py` — virtual time run completes, frames==ticks, loss 0, events ordered, slowdown 3x → k≈3, frames==ticks, degradation reflected, crash → interrupted + stream readable, record+replay, status file semantics, pause/step/resume? Pause in thread is tricky; test step manually:
   - runner.run() in thread, wait until ticks>0, pause, ticks stable, step_once increments, resume, finish.
   Or simpler: create runner, call `run()` in main thread with duration tiny; for step, we need paused state: start a thread, pause after first tick, etc. Doable with polling.
9. `tests/test_cli_sim.py` — use `project_path` fixture? Let's check conftest for project_path/project_document. Then `main(["sim","run",str(path),"--duration","0.2","--no-pace","--json"])` capturing stdout? Existing CLI tests pattern. Let me look at test_cli_mission.py.
10. `tests/test_simulation_view.py` — offscreen view: set_selection, start_run(0.2), wait, report finished, tables filled, state text; stop → interrupted; dispose.

Let me read conftest and test_cli_mission for patterns.

    )

    assert packet.checksum == _packet().checksum

    finally:

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from simorph.core.simulation.degradation import (
    MAX_DESYNC_MS,
    Degradation,
    DegradationInjector,
)

        t_monotonic_ns=2_000,
        camera_id="cam_stereo",
        width=64,
        height=48,
        payload=b"frame",
    )


def test_inactive_degradation_passes_packet_through() -> None:
    injector = DegradationInjector()
    packet = _packet()

    assert injector.apply(packet) is packet
    assert injector.applied == 0
    assert injector.stats()["config"]["active"] is False


def test_full_loss_drops_every_frame() -> None:
    injector = DegradationInjector(Degradation(frame_loss_ratio=1.0))

    assert injector.apply(_packet()) is None
    assert injector.lost == 1
    assert injector.applied == 0


def test_latency_and_desync_shift_monotonic_label() -> None:
    injector = DegradationInjector(Degradation(sensor_latency_ms=5.0, desync_ms=0.25))
    result = injector.apply(_packet())

    assert result is not None
    assert result.t_monotonic_ns == 2_000 + 5_000_000 + 250_000
    assert injector.max_desync_ns == 250_000


def test_jitter_changes_payload_and_is_counted() -> None:
    injector = DegradationInjector(Degradation(exposure_jitter_us=20.0))
    result = injector.apply(_packet())

    assert result is not None
    assert result.payload != _packet().payload
    assert len(result.payload) == len(_packet().payload) + 4
    assert injector.max_jitter_us <= 20.0


def test_seed_makes_injection_reproducible() -> None:

    second = DegradationInjector(config)

    outcomes = [(first.apply(_packet()), second.apply(_packet())) for _ in range(20)]
    assert all(left is None) == all(right is None) for left, right in outcomes
    assert [item is None for item, _ in outcomes] == [
        item is None for _, item in outcomes
    ]

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Degradation(sensor_latency_ms=-1.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Degradation(frame_loss_ratio=1.5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Degradation(desync_ms=MAX_DESYNC_MS + 0.1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Degradation(exposure_jitter_us=-1.0)


def test_stats_report_config_and_counters() -> None:
    injector = DegradationInjector(Degradation(frame_loss_ratio=1.0))
    injector.apply(_packet())
    stats = injector.stats()

    assert stats["lost"] == 1
    assert stats["applied"] == 0
    assert stats["config"]["frame_loss_ratio"] == pytest.approx(1.0)

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from simorph.core.simulation.metrics import (
    IntervalSample,
    RunMetrics,
    ScaleRecorder,
    StageSample,
    histogram_buckets,
)


def test_recorder_closes_interval_at_boundary() -> None:
    recorder = ScaleRecorder(interval_s=1.0)
    recorder.observe_tick({"sensor": (8.0, 8.0)}, queue_depth=1, queue_wait_ms=0.5)

    assert recorder.maybe_close(0.5, 0.5) is None
    sample = recorder.maybe_close(1.0, 1.0)

    assert sample is not None
    assert sample.index == 0
    assert sample.scene_time_s == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert sample.wall_time_s == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert sample.stages["sensor"].plan_ms == pytest.approx(8.0)
    assert sample.stages["sensor"].actual_ms == pytest.approx(8.0)
    assert sample.k == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert sample.queue_depth == 1
    assert sample.queue_wait_ms == pytest.approx(0.5)


def test_recorder_accumulates_and_flushes() -> None:
    recorder = ScaleRecorder(interval_s=1.0)
    recorder.observe_tick({"a": (2.0, 3.0)})
    recorder.observe_tick({"a": (2.0, 1.0)})

    sample = recorder.flush(0.4, 0.4)
    assert sample is not None
    assert sample.stages["a"].plan_ms == pytest.approx(4.0)
    assert sample.stages["a"].actual_ms == pytest.approx(4.0)
    assert sample.stages["a"].overrun_ms == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert recorder.flush(0.4, 0.4) is None


def test_interval_k_is_wall_over_plan() -> None:
    sample = IntervalSample(
        index=0,
        scene_time_s=1.0,
        wall_time_s=3.0,
        stages={"sensor": StageSample(plan_ms=10.0, actual_ms=30.0)},
    )

    assert sample.planned_s == pytest.approx(0.01)
    assert sample.k == pytest.approx(300.0)
    assert sample.to_dict()["stages"]["sensor"]["overrun_ms"] == pytest.approx(20.0)


def _metrics() -> RunMetrics:
    return RunMetrics(
        intervals=[
            IntervalSample(0, 1.0, 0.5, {"s": StageSample(10.0, 5.0)}),
            IntervalSample(1, 2.0, 1.0, {"s": StageSample(10.0, 10.0)}),
            IntervalSample(2, 3.0, 2.0, {"s": StageSample(10.0, 20.0)}),

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from simorph.core.errors import ProjectError
from simorph.core.simulation.replay import (
    STREAM_VERSION,
    RunRecorder,
    read_stream,
    replay_stream,
    write_stream,
)
from simorph.core.simulation.transport import FramePacket


def _packet(frame_id: int) -> FramePacket:
    return FramePacket(
        frame_id=frame_id,
        t_fsin_ns=frame_id * 1_000_000,
        t_monotonic_ns=frame_id * 2_000_000,
        camera_id="cam_stereo",
        width=64,
        height=48,
        payload=f"frame-{frame_id}".encode(),
    )


def _packets() -> list[FramePacket]:
    return [_packet(index) for index in range(1, 6)]


def test_roundtrip_keeps_frames_and_meta(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    write_stream(path, _packets(), meta={"mission_id": "M-01"})

    meta, packets = read_stream(path)

    assert meta == {"mission_id": "M-01"}
    assert [item.frame_id for item in packets] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert [item.checksum for item in packets] == [item.checksum for item in _packets()]


def test_header_contains_version(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    with RunRecorder(path) as recorder:
        recorder.append(_packet(1))
        assert recorder.frames == 1

    header = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0])
    assert header["kind"] == "header"
    assert header["version"] == STREAM_VERSION


def test_replay_matches_recorded_hashes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    write_stream(path, _packets())

    report = replay_stream(path)

    assert report.ok is True
    assert report.frames == 5
    assert report.matched == 5
    assert report.mismatched == []
    assert report.bad_timing == []
    assert report.to_dict()["status" if "status" in report.to_dict() else "ok"] is True


def test_replay_reports_tampered_checksum(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    write_stream(path, _packets())
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    record = json.loads(lines[2])
    record["checksum"] = "0" * 64
    lines[2] = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False)
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    report = replay_stream(path)

    assert report.ok is False
    assert report.mismatched == [1]
    assert report.matched == 4


def test_replay_flags_non_monotonic_labels(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    packets = [
        _packet(1),
        FramePacket(
            frame_id=2,
            t_fsin_ns=10,
            t_monotonic_ns=10,
            camera_id="cam_stereo",
            width=64,
            height=48,
            payload=b"x",
        ),
    ]
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    write_stream(path, packets)

    report = replay_stream(path)

    assert report.bad_timing == [1]
    assert report.ok is False


def test_replay_can_skip_comparison(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    write_stream(path, _packets())

    report = replay_stream(path, compare=False)

    assert report.ok is True
    assert report.matched == 5


def test_missing_file_is_data_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ProjectError):
        read_stream(tmp_path / "absent.jsonl")


def test_corrupt_stream_is_data_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "broken.jsonl"
    path.write_text("{not json}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ProjectError):
        replay_stream(path)


def test_stream_without_frames_is_data_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "empty.jsonl"
    path.write_text('{"kind": "header", "version": 1, "meta": {}}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ProjectError):
        read_stream(path)


def test_unknown_record_is_data_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "unknown.jsonl"
    path.write_text(
        '{"kind": "header", "version": 1, "meta": {}}\n{"kind": "other"}\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ProjectError):
        read_stream(path)

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from simorph.core.factory import build_agent, build_exercise
from simorph.core.models.exercise import Mission
from simorph.core.simulation.degradation import Degradation
from simorph.core.simulation.events import EventKind
from simorph.core.simulation.replay import replay_stream
from simorph.core.simulation.runner import (
    RunReport,
    SimulationConfig,
    SimulationRunner,
    effective_state,
    read_status,
)
from simorph.core.simulation.supervisor import RunState


class _VirtualTime:
    """Виртуальные часы: прогон детерминирован и не ждёт реального времени."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.ns = 0

    def now(self) -> int:
        return self.ns

    def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        self.ns += max(0, round(seconds * 1e9))


def _mission() -> Mission:
    return build_exercise(42).missions[0]


def _runner(
    config: SimulationConfig | None = None,
    *,
    mission: Mission | None = None,
    frame_source: object = None,
    virtual: bool = True,
) -> tuple[SimulationRunner, _VirtualTime]:
    clock = _VirtualTime()
    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
    if virtual:
        kwargs["now_ns"] = clock.now
        kwargs["sleep"] = clock.sleep
    if frame_source is not None:
        kwargs["frame_source"] = frame_source
    runner = SimulationRunner(
        mission if mission is not None else _mission(),
        agent=build_agent(),
        config=config or SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.25),
        **kwargs,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    )
    return runner, clock


def test_headless_run_completes_without_frame_loss() -> None:
    runner, _clock = _runner()
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    assert report.ok is True
    assert report.state == str(RunState.FINISHED)
    assert report.frames["attempted"] == 30
    assert report.frames["pushed"] == 30
    assert report.frames["consumed"] == 30
    assert report.frames["dropped"] == 0
    assert report.loss_ratio == 0.0
    assert report.clock["sim_time_s"] == pytest.approx(0.25)
    assert report.metrics["intervals"] >= 1
    assert report.metrics["stages"]["sensor"]["plan_ms"] > 0.0


def test_frames_equal_ticks_even_with_slowdown() -> None:
    config = SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.1, work_ms=1000.0 / 120.0, slowdown=3.0)
    runner, _clock = _runner(config)
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    assert report.ok is True
    assert report.frames["attempted"] == report.frames["pushed"]
    assert report.frames["pushed"] == 12
    assert report.metrics["k"]["p50"] == pytest.approx(3.0, abs=0.2)
    assert report.metrics["stages"]["sensor"]["overrun_ms"] > 0.0


def test_degradation_is_reflected_in_metrics() -> None:
    config = SimulationConfig(
        duration_s=0.5,
        degradation=Degradation(
            sensor_latency_ms=2.0,
            frame_loss_ratio=0.5,
            desync_ms=0.2,
            exposure_jitter_us=10.0,
        ),
    )
    runner, _clock = _runner(config)
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    assert report.ok is True
    assert report.frames["dropped"] > 0
    assert report.metrics["degradation"]["lost"] == report.frames["dropped"]
    assert report.metrics["degradation"]["applied"] > 0
    assert report.metrics["degradation"]["max_desync_ns"] > 0
    assert report.metrics["degradation"]["max_jitter_us"] > 0.0


def test_events_are_ordered_and_cover_run() -> None:
    runner, _clock = _runner(SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.1))
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    kinds = [item["kind"] for item in report.events]
    assert kinds[0] == str(EventKind.RUN_STARTED)
    assert kinds[-1] == str(EventKind.RUN_FINISHED)
    assert str(EventKind.FRAME_PUSHED) in kinds
    assert str(EventKind.FRAME_CONSUMED) in kinds
    stamps = [item["t_monotonic_ns"] for item in report.events]
    assert stamps == sorted(stamps)


def test_failure_isolated_as_interrupted(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    stream = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    report_path = tmp_path / "report.json"

    def failing_source(frame_id: int, _fsin: int) -> bytes:
        if frame_id >= 5:
            raise RuntimeError("камера отключилась")
        return b"frame"

    runner, _clock = _runner(
        SimulationConfig(duration_s=1.0, record_path=stream, report_path=report_path),
        frame_source=failing_source,
    )
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    assert report.state == str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)
    assert "камера отключилась" in (report.reason or "")
    assert report.ok is False
    assert any(item["kind"] == str(EventKind.ERROR) for item in report.events)
    assert report_path.exists()
    assert read_status(report_path.with_name("report.status.json"))["state"] == "interrupted"
    assert replay_stream(stream).ok is True


def test_record_and_replay_roundtrip(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    stream = tmp_path / "stream.jsonl"
    runner, _clock = _runner(SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.2, record_path=stream))
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    replay = replay_stream(stream)
    assert replay.ok is True
    assert replay.frames == report.frames["pushed"]
    assert replay.meta["mission_id"] == "M-01"
    assert replay.meta["sensor_hz"] == pytest.approx(120.0)


def test_status_file_marks_running_as_interrupted_after_crash(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    report_path = tmp_path / "report.json"
    runner, _clock = _runner(SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.1, report_path=report_path))
    try:
        report = runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()

    status = read_status(report_path.with_name("report.status.json"))
    assert status["state"] == "finished"
    assert effective_state(status, alive=False) == "finished"
    assert effective_state({"state": "running"}, alive=False) == "interrupted"
    assert report.status is not None


def test_pause_step_and_stop() -> None:
    runner, _clock = _runner(
        SimulationConfig(duration_s=10.0, pace=False, work_ms=5.0),
        virtual=False,
    )
    import threading

    thread = threading.Thread(target=runner.run, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2.0
    while runner.clock.ticks < 2 and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.002)
    assert runner.pause() is True
    paused_ticks = runner.clock.ticks
    time.sleep(0.03)
    assert runner.clock.ticks == paused_ticks

    assert runner.step_once() is True
    assert runner.clock.ticks == paused_ticks + 1
    assert runner.resume() is True
    runner.request_stop()
    thread.join(2.0)

    assert thread.is_alive() is False
    report = runner.report
    assert isinstance(report, RunReport)
    assert report.state == str(RunState.INTERRUPTED)
    runner.close()


def test_runner_rejects_second_run() -> None:
    runner, _clock = _runner(SimulationConfig(duration_s=0.05))
    try:
        runner.run()
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            runner.run()
    finally:
        runner.close()


def test_config_is_validated() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SimulationConfig(sensor_hz=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SimulationConfig(slowdown=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SimulationConfig(frame_bytes=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        SimulationConfig(stage_plan_ms={})

Issues:
- `test_config_is_validated`: `SimulationConfig(stage_plan_ms={})` doesn't raise in `__post_init__`; validation happens in runner `_stage_plan`. So that assertion is wrong. Remove or test via runner. Remove.
- `_runner` kwargs typing with `**kwargs` and `# type: ignore[arg-type]` — mypy might complain differently. Better construct explicitly:
```python
if virtual:
    runner = SimulationRunner(..., now_ns=clock.now, sleep=clock.sleep)
else:
    runner = SimulationRunner(...)
```
But frame_source optional. Simplify with explicit branches. Also `frame_source: object` type wrong; use `Callable[[int,int], bytes] | None`.
- `test_failure_isolated`: frame 5 raises inside `_tick` before push; ticks=4; stream has 4 frames; replay ok. status written "interrupted". Good.
- `test_pause_step_and_stop`: `_runner(..., virtual=False)` passes config with `pace=False, work_ms=5`. Each tick sleeps 5 ms; run 10 s = 1200 ticks ×5ms = 6 s, but we stop after ~2 ticks. `step_once` while paused: `supervisor.resume()`, `clock.resume()`, `_tick(paced=False)` → work sleep 5 ms, clock.tick. Fine. But `step_once` calls `self.supervisor.pause()` after tick. Then `resume()` → state paused → true. `request_stop`; `_wait_if_paused` sees stop → exits; loop `if self._stop.is_set(): break`; then `if stop and state RUNNING: interrupt`. State is RUNNING after resume. Good.
- Potential race: pause() might be called while `_tick` running; clock.pause() sets paused; tick already in progress still increments. Then `_wait_if_paused`. paused_ticks read after pause returns; a tick may complete after pause → paused_ticks could be stale and a subsequent tick completes? `clock.tick` checks `running` at call start. If `_tick` is mid-work when pause sets `_paused`, then `clock.tick` at end returns False (not running) — but `_tick` still updates metrics and returns complete. So ticks won't increase. But if pause happens just before `_tick` calls `clock.tick`? Same: tick returns False. So after pause, ticks stable. However `pause()` sets clock.pause() and supervisor.pause(); `_tick`'s `supervisor.advance` returns [] when not running. Fine.
- `test_degradation`: `report.metrics["degradation"]["lost"] == report.frames["dropped"]`. Ring drains every tick, so drops only from injection. Yes. But `metrics.frames_dropped` also increments if push fails; ring never full because drain after push (depth 1 < 3). Good.
- `test_events...`: last event may be FRAME_CONSUMED after RUN_FINISHED? Sequence: tick completes → `_tick` returns complete → loop calls `supervisor.finish()` which emits RUN_FINISHED. The last tick's consume event was emitted before finish. So last is RUN_FINISHED. Good. First is RUN_STARTED (supervisor.start) — yes, emitted before ticks.
- `test_headless`: duration 0.25 at 120 Hz = 30 ticks exactly. `complete` at t=0.25 → true. Good.
- `test_frames_equal_ticks`: work_ms = 1000/120 = 8.3333, duration 0.1 → 12 ticks. actual = work 8.333*3 = 25ms; k per interval: plan 8.333, wall 25 → 3.0. At exactly 12 ticks, interval closes at scene 0.1? `maybe_close` at scene 0.1 → boundary 1.0? No: interval_s default 1.0, so no interval closed; flush at end gives sample with plan = 12*8.333=100ms, wall = 300ms → k=3.0. Good.
- `test_runner_rejects_second_run`: after run, state FINISHED; run raises RuntimeError. Good.
- `test_status`: `effective_state(status, alive=False)` where status finished → finished. Good.

Fix `_runner` and remove empty stage_plan assertion.

CLI test: use `project_path` fixture (demo project has mission M-01 with start/ret). `main(["sim","run",str(project_path),"--duration","0.2","--no-pace","--json"])` → 24 ticks. Assert.

Text output: `--duration 0.1`.

Bad params: `--loss 2.0` → DATA_ERROR with error JSON? `Degradation` raises ValueError caught. Good.

`--scale 0` → SimClock raises ValueError caught. Good.

Replay missing file → ProjectError caught.

UI test:
- fixture window like mission view; document with a mission having dwell 1 s? Demo start/ret budget 0 → runner fallback duration 10, but `start_run(0.2)` overrides. Good.
- `view = window.simulation_view` after `window.open_simulation()`.
- `assert window.tabs.tabText(index) == "Симуляция"`? EditorTabs API? `tabs.index_of`, `currentWidget`. Use `window.tabs.widget(index) is view`.
- `view.set_selection(0,0)`.
- `view.start_run(0.2)` then `view.wait(5.0)`; assert report ok; state_text includes "finished"; interval_rows; stage_rows[0][0] == "sensor"; event_rows non-empty.
- stop: `view.start_run(5.0)` (pace default true), `view.stop_run()`, `view.wait(5.0)`; report state interrupted. Race: `stop_run` sets stop; runner may not have started when request_stop called — `_stop` is set; run() starts supervisor then loop sees stop and interrupts. Good.
- `dispose` after.

One issue: UI `start_run` creates `SimulationRunner` with `pace=True` and duration 0.2 → real 0.2 s; wait 5 s fine.

Another: `_poll` may not run if timer events aren't processed during `wait()` (thread.join blocks the Qt event loop). After join, `wait()` stops timer and calls `_poll()` manually → `_finish` fills tables. Good.

`view.start_run(0.2)` uses `self.mission` — document exercises exist. Good.

Write both.

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterator

import pytest

from simorph.core.factory import new_project
from simorph.core.models.exercise import ExerciseSection, Mission, MissionElement
from simorph.core.models.project import ProjectDocument
from simorph.settings import ApplicationSettings
from simorph.ui.main_window import SIMULATION_TITLE, MainWindow
from simorph.ui.simulation_view import SimulationView


def _exercise() -> ExerciseSection:
    return ExerciseSection(
        schema_version="1.0",
        exercise_id="EX-01",
        seed=1,
        world_id="W-01",
        agents=["NRTC-01"],
        missions=[
            Mission(
                mission_id="M-01",
                agent_id="NRTC-01",
                elements=[
                    MissionElement(id="start", type="start", next=["wait"]),
                    MissionElement(id="wait", type="dwell", duration_s=1.0, next=["ret"]),
                    MissionElement(id="ret", type="return_to_base"),
                ],
            )
        ],
    )


def _document() -> ProjectDocument:
    document = new_project("simulation", seed=1)
    return document.model_copy(update={"exercises": [_exercise()]})


@pytest.fixture
def window(qtbot: object, isolated_settings: ApplicationSettings) -> MainWindow:
    created = MainWindow(isolated_settings)
    created.confirmations_enabled = False
    created.store.apply(_document())
    qtbot.addWidget(created)
    return created


@pytest.fixture
def view(window: MainWindow) -> Iterator[SimulationView]:
    window.open_simulation()
    created = window.simulation_view
    assert created is not None
    yield created
    created.dispose()


def test_tab_opens_with_f9(window: MainWindow) -> None:
    index = window.open_simulation()
    created = window.simulation_view

    assert created is not None
    assert window.tabs.widget(index) is created
    assert window.tabs.tabText(index) == SIMULATION_TITLE


def test_view_starts_on_first_mission(view: SimulationView) -> None:
    assert view.exercise_index == 0
    assert view.mission_index == 0
    assert view.mission is not None
    assert view.mission.mission_id == "M-01"
    assert view.state_text == "прогон не запущен"


def test_run_finishes_and_fills_metrics(view: SimulationView) -> None:
    assert view.start_run(0.2) is True
    assert view.wait(5.0) is True

    report = view.report
    assert report is not None
    assert report.ok is True
    assert "finished" in view.state_text
    assert "кадры:" in view.frames_text
    assert view.interval_rows()
    stages = view.stage_rows()
    assert stages and stages[0][0] == "sensor"
    assert view.event_rows()


def test_stop_interrupts_run(view: SimulationView) -> None:
    assert view.start_run(5.0) is True
    view.stop_run()
    assert view.wait(5.0) is True

    report = view.report
    assert report is not None
    assert report.state == "interrupted"
    assert "interrupted" in view.state_text


def test_pause_and_step(view: SimulationView) -> None:
    assert view.start_run(5.0) is True
    assert view.toggle_pause() is True
    runner = view.runner
    assert runner is not None
    ticks = runner.clock.ticks
    assert view.step_once() is True
    assert runner.clock.ticks == ticks + 1
    assert view.toggle_pause() is True
    view.stop_run()
    assert view.wait(5.0) is True


def test_rebuild_keeps_selection(view: SimulationView) -> None:
    assert view.set_selection(0, 0) is True
    view.rebuild(_document())

    assert view.mission_index == 0
    assert view.mission is not None
    assert view.set_selection(0, 1) is False


def test_start_without_mission_reports_error(
    window: MainWindow, isolated_settings: ApplicationSettings
) -> None:
    document = _document().model_copy(
        update={"exercises": [_exercise().model_copy(update={"missions": []})]}
    )
    window.store.apply(document)
    window.open_simulation()
    created = window.simulation_view
    assert created is not None

    assert created.start_run(0.1) is False
    assert "нет миссий" in created.status_text
